#687. Steelers Keys to Victory vs. Bengals in Week 10 NFL Game

📅 13 Nov 2026

Steelers Keys to Victory vs. Bengals in Week 10 NFL Game

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/steelers-keys-victory-vs-bengals-191531617.html

Berdasarkan laporan, steelers keys to victory vs. Bengals in Week 10 NFL Game originally appeared on SportsNet Pittsburgh. Add SportsNet Pittsburgh as a Preferred Source by clicking here.

The Pittsburgh Steelers will look to take control of the AFC North when they visit the Cincinnati Bengals in Week 10.

Diungkapkan bahwa pittsburgh enters sunday's matchup at 6-2 after a bye week. The Steelers have won four consecutive games and will have an opportunity to move into sole possession of first place in the division with another victory.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, cincinnati also holds a 6-2 record and has won four straight games. The Bengals are coming off a victory over the Atlanta Falcons in Madrid and will look to maintain their momentum in front of their home crowd.

The Steelers defeated Cincinnati 30-27 in their first meeting of the season in Week 3, giving them the opportunity to complete the season sweep.

Here are four keys to victory for the Steelers in Week 10.

Pittsburgh's pass rush will be especially important against a Cincinnati offense that has been one of the most productive passing units in the NFL.

Sebagaimana diketahui, joe burrow has thrown for 2,386 yards and 23 touchdowns through eight games, leading the league in completion percentage while second in passing touchdowns. He also completed 24 of 29 passes for 271 yards and three touchdowns in the Bengals' most recent meeting with Pittsburgh.

Berdasarkan laporan, the steelers have several defensive playmakers capable of making life difficult for burrow, including t. J. Watt and Alex Highsmith. Pittsburgh has recorded 26 sacks this season, tied for the fourth-most in the NFL entering Week 10.

The Steelers also have a history of creating problems for Burrow, having sacked him 24 times in eight career meetings.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, generating consistent pressure without leaving opportunities for cincinnati's receivers downfield will be important. Pittsburgh needs to disrupt Burrow's timing and force him into uncomfortable situations rather than allowing him to operate comfortably from the pocket.

The Steelers also must find a way to contain Cincinnati's collection of offensive weapons.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ja'marr chase and tee higgins give burrow two dangerous options on the outside, while tight end mike gesicki provides another threat in the passing game. All three players have recorded at least six receiving touchdowns through Cincinnati's first eight games.

Diungkapkan bahwa the bengals are averaging 285. 5 passing yards per game, the highest mark in the NFL. Burrow has also completed 74% of his passes this season, making it difficult for opposing defenses to consistently get stops.

Diungkapkan bahwa pittsburgh's secondary will need to communicate effectively and avoid giving cincinnati easy opportunities for explosive plays. The Steelers have been one of the better defenses against the run this season, so forcing the Bengals into uncomfortable situations on passing downs could be an advantage.

If Pittsburgh can limit Chase and Higgins while making Burrow work for every completion, it will have a better chance of slowing down Cincinnati's offense.

Pittsburgh's rushing attack should be a major priority against Cincinnati, particularly with the Bengals struggling to defend the run.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, jaylen warren has been one of the steelers' most productive offensive players this season, averaging 5. 9 yards per carry. He also had 176 yards from scrimmage in Pittsburgh's first meeting with Cincinnati, making him a particularly important player to watch.

Berdasarkan laporan, rico dowdle provides another option in the backfield after returning from his injury absence. The combination gives Pittsburgh multiple ways to attack Cincinnati's defense.

Berdasarkan laporan, the bengals are allowing 5. 0 yards per carry, the highest average in the NFL. Pittsburgh, meanwhile, averages 4. 9 yards per attempt, ranking among the league's best rushing offenses.

Getting Warren and Dowdle involved early could help the Steelers control the clock, create favorable situations on third down and take some pressure off Aaron Rodgers.

Pittsburgh's offensive line will need to provide consistent protection against a Cincinnati defense capable of generating pressure.

Sebagaimana diketahui, rodgers has thrown for 1,871 yards, 13 touchdowns and six interceptions through eight games. While the Steelers have found success with their rushing attack, their passing offense will need to contribute against a Bengals team that can put points on the board quickly.

Sebagaimana diketahui, cincinnati has pressured opposing quarterbacks on 36. 4% of dropbacks this season, giving Pittsburgh another challenge to address up front.

Berdasarkan laporan, the steelers cannot afford to allow rodgers to face consistent pressure or force him into difficult passing situations. Establishing the ground game should help, but the offensive line will still need to hold up when Pittsburgh looks to attack through the air.

Giving Rodgers enough time to find DK Metcalf, Germie Bernard and the rest of his receiving options could be the difference in a matchup that has significant implications for the AFC North.

#688. Troy Aikman engages in potential pre-tampering with Kyle Shanahan

Troy Aikman engages in potential pre-tampering with Kyle Shanahan

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/profootballtalk/rumor-mill/news/troy-aikman-engages-in-potential-pre-tampering-with-kyle-shanahan

If Troy Aikman exits broadcasting after this season (last month, he put the chance at “50-50”) and if Aikman lands a key position in a front office, the name at the top of his head-coaching wishlist will already be known.

Sebagaimana diketahui, via brandon contes of awful announcing, aikman said during a thursday appearance on 96. 7 The Ticket in Dallas that, if he were running an NFL team, he would try to hire 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan.

Diungkapkan bahwa “i’ve been asked a lot of questions here, certainly over the last several weeks, about any aspirations that i may have of going in a front office,” aikman said. And yes, I’ve always believed this, but coaching matters and it has an impact on an organization. “Or ‘Who would you hire as your head coach?’ If I was in a position to hire someone as a head coach, [the] first call I’d make is to the 49ers and say, ‘How much is it going to take to get Kyle Shanahan? Because I think he’s that good. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s not tampering because aikman currently isn’t running a team. (It could technically be “tampering light” if he’s still working for the Dolphins. ) And the information gives Shanahan plenty of leverage in his dealings with the 49ers, if Aikman joins the likes of Matt Millen, John Lynch, and John Elway as former players with little or no front-office experience who find themselves working in high-level jobs with a team.

Aikman has previously made similar comments about Shanahan, in the context of the Bears’ latest coaching vacancy.

Berdasarkan laporan, “there has been discussion about, ‘do you give up some picks and see if you can maybe make a deal for a guy like kyle shanahan?’” aikman said during a game in 2024. But can you pull that off? That’s a better question. Because he would develop a quarterback, and he’s a hell of a head coach. “I would be all in on that. And who might you hire that has no head-coaching experience as an offensive guy? You never know the answer to that, as to how good they’re gonna be. ”.

While it seems to be working out pretty well for the Bears and their head coach who had no head-coaching experience, the point remains that Aikman would try to hire Shanahan, if Aikman is ever in a position to hire a coach.

Berdasarkan laporan, and there’s one last twist to this story that currently isn’t known. M. When Aikman was consulting with the Dolphins during their latest search for a G. and head coach, did Aikman advise Miami to call about Shanahan? If so, did they?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, shanahan is in his 10th season with the 49ers. He’s taken the team to two Super Bowls. Barring the franchise’s first championship since 1994 (which could come this year), there could be a point where Shanahan reaches an Andy Reid-style mutual expiration date.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if that ever happens, shanahan will have options. Especially if Aikman ends up getting hired to be someone’s G. M.

#689. After Jensen Huang’s exit, what top financial advisors are doing with Nvidia: Exclusive CNBC poll

📅 13 Nov 2026

After Jensen Huang’s exit, what top financial advisors are doing with Nvidia: Exclusive CNBC poll

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-stock-advisors-jensen-huang-exit-exclusive-poll.html

Diungkapkan bahwa shares of nvidia continued to slide after the market open on friday after declining 4% on thursday following news of co-founder jensen huang's resignation as chief executive, amid reports about his personal relationships and national security concerns. The news has raised questions for investors about what comes next for a company at the center of the artificial intelligence boom.

Berdasarkan laporan, to gauge how wealth managers are responding, cnbc polled members of its financial advisor 100 and financial advisor council. m. 12. m. and 5 p. Thirty of the 122 firms and professionals contacted responded to the online, multiple-choice flash poll, conducted between 11 a. EST on Nov. The poll is a snapshot of respondents' views, not a measure of all financial advisors.

Diungkapkan bahwa most respondents, 19, said they are holding their nvidia positions steady. Another four said they are increasing their stake, while seven said they do not own the stock. None said they were selling at the time of the poll.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "most of our clients are in a position to hold; the reason is because it makes up a smaller percentage of an overall diversified portfolio," winnie sun, managing director and founding partner of irvine, california-based sun group wealth partners, said in an interview. Sun is a member of the CNBC Financial Advisor Council.

Read coverage of CNBC's 2026 Financial Advisor 100 list, including stories featuring ranked firms and their advisors:.

In open responses, several advisors wrote that they are taking a "wait-and-see" approach before changing their investment strategy with Nvidia, and are telling their clients to do the same.

Berdasarkan laporan, "don't react to short-term headlines," wrote certified financial planner peyton jamison, president of jamison private wealth management in alpharetta, georgia. "The company's valuation is extremely attractive, and the focus should remain on its underlying fundamentals and long-term investment potential. " His firm is ranked No. 78 on the 2026 CNBC Financial Advisor 100 list.

Diungkapkan bahwa asked what factors could change their approach to nvidia, 13 respondents cited the outlook for ai demand, 11 pointed to valuation and 10 mentioned company leadership or governance. Some said the decision depends on the client, with eight citing risk tolerance and seven mentioning portfolio concentration. Seven said they do not expect to change their approach.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nvidia is scheduled to report its third-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results on tuesday, after the market close. In poll remarks, advisors said the company's fiscal third-quarter earnings will help determine their course of action.

Advisors said that for investors, what to do may depend on how much Nvidia stock they already own, when they expect to need the money and how comfortable they are with volatility.

"If this is a company that's going to keep you up at night and you just feel really uncomfortable with these unknown risks, then there was always the option to sell and move that capital to another stock or another portfolio," Sun said.

Diungkapkan bahwa nvidia exposure can also come through mutual funds and etfs. Nvidia's large market value makes it a significant holding in many broad-market funds, including funds that track the S&P 500, as well as target-date funds in retirement-plan options.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, investors can check their nvidia exposure by reviewing the fact sheets for the funds in their 401(k) or brokerage accounts, which typically list a fund's largest holdings. A stock's decline does not translate one-for-one into a fund's decline.

However, investors with dedicated technology, semiconductor or growth funds may have more Nvidia exposure than they realize, advisors say.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "nvidia is a big part of virtually everyone's portfolio whether they take an active or passive index approach," wrote andy pratt, a partner and director of investment strategy at burney wealth management in reston, virginia, which is ranked no. 34 on the 2026 CNBC Financial Advisor 100 list.

He said he advises clients not to overreact to short-term news and to let the dust settle before making decisions.

CNBC's Stephanie Dhue contributed reporting to this article.

#691. The Lakers are starting to find their way

📅 13 Nov 2026

The Lakers are starting to find their way

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/lakers-starting-way-162400834.html

Berdasarkan laporan, simply looking at the lakers 11-2 record tells you they've been playing really well to start the season. Irrespective of the competition, you simply don't win at this rate — including seven games in a row after Wednesday's victory in Milwaukee — without doing way more things right than wrong.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that said, one of the benefits of watching a team on a day-to-day basis is that you gain perspective on what you're watching, are better able to contextualize the results and can speak to the differences between, say, an 11-point win against the bucks vs. a 10-point win against the Hawks against a six-point win over the Raptors.

Diungkapkan bahwa the details from any one of those games matter and help provide the arc and narrative of where the team has been and, maybe more importantly, where they could be going. You can also find the themes that help you, even this early in the year, establish what the team actually is.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for example, the numbers tell you the lakers are the best offense in the league and that luka dončić is on the sort of start to the season that forgest mvp campaigns. These things are related and are easily the top data point for why the Lakers have the record that they do.

Diungkapkan bahwa again, though, watching this team every day gives you access to more than what a visit to the nba stats page or cleaning the glass would tell you about the team. Those tools help contextualize what you watch, but they cannot replace what you observe with your own eyes. They also cannot prove the nuance of and aforementioned details that go into the progression — or in some cases, regression — that comprises the march through what is a marathon of an 82-game campaign.

Which leads me back to why I'm here in the first place.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while the lakers are 11-2, i'd argue they are just now starting to find their way of what they are and who they can as a team. Because their record is what it is, I think it would be easy to conflate their success with them hitting the ground running, but that would be a mistake. It's not that the team isn't playing well — of course they are, look at their record! — but it's more that the version of well they're playing is just now beginning to become more well-rounded.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for example, when the lakers' winning streak started seven games ago, luka was in full destroyer of worlds mode, scoring 45, 42, 40, and 53 points in consecutive games. If we're being honest, the Lakers wouldn't have needed much beyond Luka playing to that level for them to win, but they were still getting complementary performances from Austin Reaves and Walker Kessler — both of whom scored in double digits in all those games too — as well as other role players stepping up on any given night.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, over the last three games, however, things have started to diversify more, with luka and austin taking turns sitting out in the sunday and monday back-to-back games in detroit and atlanta. Add in Quentin Grimes missing the contests against the Hawks and Bucks, and the rotation has been stress-tested with different players needing to absorb usage while stepping into larger roles.

And, with those opportunities for others to step up, we have seen the Lakers begin to better establish the team they can actually become rather than simply rely on Luka going nuclear while fueling the NBA's best offense.

Berdasarkan laporan, sandro mamukelashvili's uptick in production the past two games is a perfect example of this. Mamu was not necessarily playing poorly before these past two games against the Hawks and Bucks, but he was most helping the team by being a connective passer whose ability to drive and attack closeouts was helping grease the wheels of the team's offense.

Diungkapkan bahwa against the hawks and the bucks, however, mamu showed an uptick in offensive aggression, looking for his own shot more often and paying off those attempts with made baskets. After scoring a total of 16 points in wins over the Kings, Blazers, and Pistons, Mamu erupted for 23 points in both Atlanta and Milwaukee, bested by only Luka on both nights.

Following the win in Milwaukee, Mamu spoke about playing with more confidence and how it's taken time to grow into believing in himself to the same degree the coaches and organization have believed in him by signing and putting him into the role he's occupied.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, beyond mamu, we've also seen a better play from collin sexton, both individually and in reestablishing his connection and chemistry with walker kessler. After missing all of training camp, Sexton has been up and down to begin the year, but the recent uptick in touches and playing as the lone lead guard on the court with Luka and Austin both missing games has not only given him more chances to lead the team's offensive attack, but his placement into more units where he's gotten to play with his former Jazz teammate, Kessler, has given him a familiar partner who he clearly has a feel for playing with.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in the last three games, the 42 minutes sexton has played with kessler is the most he's been paired with any teammate. While their plus-minus together is only plus-six in those minutes, when you consider Sexton's season-long plus-minus is a -22, this recent trend upwards is a huge shift from how his year began.

Much of this is fueled by them flashing an understanding of how to play off of each other, with Sexton seeking out and feeding Kessler for easy baskets on one end of the court and Kessler helping to insulate Sexton defensively by patrolling the paint and protecting the back line on the other.

When you add in that on any given night the team is also getting strong performances from Ziaire Williams offensively, well-rounded floor games from Jake LaRavia, defensive playmaking and shot making from Matisse Thybulle, hard-nosed defense and rebounding from Jarred Vanderbilt and mostly mistake-free minutes boosted by elite athleticism from Adou Thiero, the Lakers are looking more and more like a full team that is complementing each other instead of a one- or two-man show of Luka and Reaves that just so happens to be supported by a mostly anonymous group of role players.

Diungkapkan bahwa to what degree the lakers' record can keep up with their great start remains to be seen. 800+ winning percentage all season. I absolutely do not think nor believe they'll maintain an. But that's sort of the point here.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the lakers may not ultimately be as good as their record through 13 games, but they've also been winning without playing nearly their best basketball. They've only very recently started to resemble a group that understands how to play together and what to do in the various scenarios different opponents offer with their specific game plans tailored to their own personnel.

#698. Scouting New York Jets offensive tackle Blake Freeland

📅 13 Nov 2026

Scouting New York Jets offensive tackle Blake Freeland

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/scouting-york-jets-offensive-tackle-190000656.html

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the jets recently signed former colts offensive lineman blake freeland to their active roster from the bengals' practice squad. Today, we break him down in detail.

Diungkapkan bahwa the 25-year old freeland is listed at 6'7" and 302 pounds and was a fourth round pick out of byu in 2023. He has started nine games in his career, all of which were for the Colts in his rookie year.

Sebagaimana diketahui, freeland was a three-star high school recruit but headed to byu with zero experience of playing on the offensive line having been a quarterback for two years before moving to tight end and defensive end as a senior. He also played basketball and represented his school in shot put and javelin throwing.

Diungkapkan bahwa on his arrival at byu, freeland converted to offensive tackle but didn't see the field until the middle of his freshman season. However, he ended up starting the last seven games and held up reasonably well, as he only allowed one sack.

He didn't begin his sophomore year as a starter, but ended up making a total of eight starts in 2020, during which he showed promise by not allowing a sack all year.

Berdasarkan laporan, in 2021 and 2022, freeland started all 26 games and was twice named to phil steele's all-independent conference first team. He was also a third team AP all-American in 2022.

Berdasarkan laporan, heading into the 2023 pre-draft process, freeland was being touted as a possible day two pick. However, his rawness was exposed during Senior Bowl week. Even so, he managed to stablize his stock with good workouts at the combine and his pro day.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the colts eventually drafted freeland in the fourth round and he started off his rookie year on the bench. He soon made his first start due to a week four injury, and by the end of the year had started nine games.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in 2024, he failed to earn a starting role and spent the first half of the season as a healthy scratch. He played in the last eight games, although he only played 23 offensive snaps, 22 of which were in the season finale.

In year three, a serious leg injury during preseason forced Freeland to spend the entire year on injured reserve and then he faced an uphill battle to make the team out of training camp this summer.

After being released in final cuts following preseason, Freeland signed to Cincinnati's practice squad before being poached by the Jets last month following Max Mitchell's concussion.

Let's move onto some more in-depth analysis of what Freeland brings to the table, based on in-depth research and film study.

Diungkapkan bahwa freeland is extremely tall, with excellent length, but was not strong enough when he entered the league so has no doubt been trying to add weight and is almost certainly heavier than his listed weight of 302. He managed 25 bench press reps at his pro day.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the rest of his workout numbers are impressive as he ran the 40-yard dash in under five seconds at the combine, then broke the combine record for offensive linemen with a 37-inch vertical jump. His broad jump of 120 inches was also impressive.

Having posted underwhelming agility numbers at the combine, Freeland did those drills again at his pro day and improved them dramatically.

Sebagaimana diketahui, freeland has extensive experience of playing at both tackle positions. He started two seasons of each in college and has played both during his preseason appearances. At the NFL level, his first two starts were on the left but the other seven were on the right.

He would not be suitable for an interior role and has never played there at any level.

Berdasarkan laporan, freeland only allowed two sacks in his entire college career, with a low pressure rate. However, BYU's system operates with a lot of screens and RPO's so he didn't play as many true pass sets as you'd like to see from an incoming prospect.

Not surprisingly, he struggled during his nine starts as a rookie, giving up four sacks.

Talented NFL level players were always going to be able to exploit his lack of experience, and it didn't help his confidence that he faced Aaron Donald in his first NFL start.

Despite his athletic numbers, Freeland can sometimes be slow to get into his stance and susceptible to being beaten by speed rushers around the edge.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, his biggest concern is his anchor. He can really struggle to repel bull rushers and speed-to-power moves.

Sebagaimana diketahui, freeland's run blocking grades according to pro football focus were very good when he was in college, but he was less consistent at the nfl level. The 2023 season when Freeland played extensively for the Colts was Jonathan Taylor's least productive of his career and he only had one 100-yard game which came on a day when Freeland didn't play.

Once again, play strength is an issue here, as he will get stood up on the edge and allow his man to fight off his block in the trenches.

He does give a good effort though, and his athletic ability means he can get out in space to good effect.

Sebagaimana diketahui, freeland had some decent moments on short yardage plays, even though he's not much of a drive blocker. It may suit him that effort is arguably more important than technique in such situations.

Freeland obviously has the athleticism to get out in front of a screen and, as noted, it was something BYU did regularly when he was there.

Berdasarkan laporan, here's a play where he was at right tackle. On this one, rather than leaking out, he has an initial responsibility to prevent the upfield rush but then finds someone to block so the play doesn't get bottled up.

Considering his speed and agility numbers, it is disappointing to see that Freeland is sometimes stiff and mechanical in his movements.

Diungkapkan bahwa one other obvious area that needs work is his hand placement. He can be slow to get his hands up and defensive players will take advantage of this.

Berdasarkan laporan, his other big issue is pad level. This was always going to be an issue for someone as tall as him and he can tend to play with a narrow base so is often overpowered.

Freeland had seven penalties in seven games as a freshman but improved his on-field discipline over the course of his college career with just nine penalties in the last three seasons.

Sebagaimana diketahui, at the nfl level, he's been flagged six times. Four of these were false starts and two were for illegal man downfield. He has zero holding penalties.

Berdasarkan laporan, freeland's only role on special teams in college was as a blocker on the placekicking unit and that has been the case in the nfl too. He has had no issues or penalties within this role.

Freeland displayed good patience on stunts as a college player, and has shown he can handle those at the NFL level too.

However, it's in those one-on-one battles – especially as a pass rusher – where his lack of experience can be detrimental as he can be slow to react to or anticipate counters.

Diungkapkan bahwa freeland is a player who is known for his toughness and a relentless work ethic. He also has good leadership traits, having been a three-time high school captain – he played two years as a quarterback, remember – and also a captain at BYU.

To miss your entire third season having entered the NFL as someone who was considered a raw developmental prospect is rough luck and Freeland's fractured leg in 2025 has obviously hurt his career.

Prior to this, injuries weren't an issue as he played in 44 games in his college career despite being a healthy scratch for the first seven weeks.

Diungkapkan bahwa as noted, byu's scheme used a lot of screens and rpo's and, as such, probably wasn't ideal preparation for entering the nfl. However, Freeland has since had four camps with the Colts and spent a couple of months in Cincinnati this year.

Although current Jets offensive coordinator Frank Reich left the Colts in 2022 and Freeland was drafted by them the following season, there would presumably have been some overlap between his scheme and that of the incoming offensive coordinator Jim Bob Cooter, given that most of the key personnel was the same, so the Jets should have some concepts he's familiar with.

He was a teammate of current Jets cornerback Mory Bamba at BYU and his fellow practice squad members Jimmy Morrissey and Samuel Womack with the Colts.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the jets picked up freeland after mitchell's concussion forced him to go on injured reserve. This meant that they only had three healthy tackles on their active roster, causing them to have to elevate Brant Banks from the practice squad a few times.

Diungkapkan bahwa once freeland is up to speed, he'll likely be active on gameday and could eventually challenge chukwuma okorafor to be the swing tackle, given how unimpressive okorafor has been seen leaving the steelers. One of them might need to be cut when Mitchell can return, though.

Berdasarkan laporan, jets fans will, of course, hope that armand membou and olu fashanu remain healthy, in which case freeland wouldn't get a chance to play. However, he could still be brought back as a project player next year.

#703. Why the data center slowdown concern is overblown. Two stocks to buy amid the fear

📅 13 Nov 2026

Why the data center slowdown concern is overblown. Two stocks to buy amid the fear

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/data-center-slowdown-utility-stocks.html

Sebagaimana diketahui, the demise of data centers has been greatly exaggerated. So says every utility CEO and energy-focused investor we spoke with at the Edison Electric Institute's annual conference in Arizona. Here's why.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there is a lot of misleading, misdirected, or straight-up incorrect information floating around about data centers and the ai buildout. I'm not going to dive into the old water-use story — you can do your own research on that — but rather focus this week on what the insiders know: Some newly elected politicians either don't have the power to stop the buildouts or, if they do, the buildout will likely just continue somewhere else.

Ohio and Georgia are important states to watch with their new incoming political class, but for the sheer importance in size and scope, I'll focus on the energy and data center capital: Texas.

Berdasarkan laporan, incoming governor gina hinojosa and incoming senator james talarico both campaigned on promises to go after what they believe to be affordability issues around data centers. I say "what they believe to be" because it's unclear how much data centers may raise your electricity bill, if at all.

Diungkapkan bahwa first and foremost, data centers are largely a state issue, meaning officials elected to federal office have little control over outcomes, at least for now. Also, in Texas, the Governor has less direct power than in some other states. That's where current Governor Greg Abbott has already, and rather quietly, put his own "pause" on data center permitting. In Texas, any cancellations or moratoriums on new builds will come from the statehouse in Austin. That delay has been underway for a few weeks. The power the governor does have largely derives from the authority to appoint those in charge of the all-important permitting process.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the lone star state, that power lies with two agencies: the public utility commission of texas (puct) and the even lesser-known texas commission on environmental quality (tceq). It helps oversee growth of anything electricity-grid-related. Its chair — a pro-growth chap named Thomas Gleeson —is also on the board of Texas' electric grid powerhouse ERCOT and will serve his term with the utility commission through September 2029. So if a data center wants to connect to the public utility grid, it needs the commission's approval. The PUCT regulates Texas' electricity, telecom, and water industries. Yes, three years from now.

Berdasarkan laporan, that agency gets involved when a data center or power provider wants to connect to the electricity grid. It's not exactly the Alamo, but this obscure group — run by a regulator named Brooke Paup — is largely the "last stand" for permitting on those new builds. That said, it does have to authorize certain environmental permits, and that responsibility largely lies with the TCEQ. Abbott and serves through next year. The TCEQ was "BBI" (my own little term for "boring, but important") until data centers came along. Paup was also appointed by Gov. But what about facilities that are off the grid and have their own dedicated power sources? Texas has less control over what happens then. In other words, unless she and Gleeson step down or there is some way to oust them, the regulatory environment in Texas may not change much.

The bottom line in this brief foray into the Texas regulatory swamp is to highlight that there are things for investors to consider around the data center/energy world that may not be at the top of the headlines.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, important note → be mindful that i am an east coast-based financial broadcaster and journalist, not an expert on texas regulation or how the state operates. There may very well be things I don't know, things my sources aren't aware of, or other ways in which the new Governor and state House can assert power. For one, she recently said she may try to freeze electricity rates. Hint: that would be a terrible idea unless you want to damage the growth of badly needed new power sources like wind and solar.

Diungkapkan bahwa disclaimer is done. Conversations with some pretty smart people lead me to believe that if those facilities aren't built in that state, they will be built in another: Louisiana, Oklahoma, or another state. Let's assume I am wrong on Texas and there is a larger push to slow or stop data center growth in the state. Same for Oklahoma. Sources tell me that Louisiana Governor Jeff Landry and his team are already working the phones, telling companies that his state would love to welcome new business. Both are gas-rich, have plenty of power, and are only too happy to grab any data center dollars.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, let's acknowledge that not all data centers are going to be built… and never were. Some others may soon be canceled, either for reasons of public pushback or otherwise. Some DCs were shelved before the election. There are way too many plans to make them all happen. It's also not clear if we even need all the planned compute. There will be a time when companies realize they have enough — or at least enough for now — and turn off the spending taps.

Goldman Sachs lays it out in a new note late this week:.

Berdasarkan laporan, "the midterm election results pose only modest risks to ai investment, for now. However, these will likely only impact projects not yet permitted, leaving the vast majority of planned 2027 construction unaffected. We expect newly elected Democratic governors in states that account for over a third of planned US data center capacity to impose moratoria on new data centers. We therefore expect data center construction spending to remain strong next year, though moratoria that are stricter or longer-lasting than we expect pose downside risks. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the firm adds that it still sees spending on ai-related hardware coming in around $1. 4 trillion by the end of next year. In other words, the spending boom is going to keep going, at least for now.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, another key point for all you energy- or utility-focused investors out there: while data centers are one huge driver of electricity demand, they aren't the only one. Not one hinted at a downturn. And not Drew Maloney, head of EEI. Electric cars, reshoring manufacturing, and the "electrification of everything" will also grow the need for more gigawatts. Not Exelon's Calvin Butler. This is why we asked every utility CEO we spoke with at the EEI conference if they saw any slowdown in their internal electricity growth estimates. Not Entergy's Drew Marsh. All gave the same answer: no. Of course, power demand is about more than just data centers, but it's still important for investors to hear it from the top.

Berdasarkan laporan, in an interview on cnbc, bernstein analyst bob brackett says he likes exxonmobil (xom), calling it a great "barbell" play between natural gas and refined products. Sebagaimana diketahui, brackett also likes the lesser-known expand energy (exe). It's a natural gas behemoth, and Brackett says the gas story is a "great long-term story" that's trading below a "midcycle price," and Expand fits right into it. He has a $139 target on the stock, making him one of the more bullish analysts on the Street. The company is the combination of Chesapeake Energy and Southwestern Energy. If you're not familiar with Expand Energy, don't worry; it's still relatively new. Brackett also notes that Expand has a new CEO. Expand has a median price target of $123. 54.

Sebagaimana diketahui, meanwhile, the chart looks tasty on another energy name: cheniere energy (lng). Cheniere — along with Venture Global (VG) — is a pure play on why I was just in Europe: the worsening European energy crisis. S. Cheniere exports massive quantities of U. Johnson likes Cheniere in part because it recently broke out of a "very big base," and he wants to buy stocks that are on the upswing.

Diungkapkan bahwa cheniere is a well-run, rather quiet company with a fantastic ceo in longtime energy executive jack fusco. Jack has forgotten more about running an energy business than most will know, and the company continues to expand production. It's not hyperbole to say that American natural gas is — literally — keeping the lights and the heat on across Germany, Italy, and other countries.

Berdasarkan laporan, remember this incredible stat: just one tanker of lng can produce a year's worth of power for over 100,000 average-sized european homes. Next year, Europe is still planning to stop buying LNG from Russia. That means demand for American natural gas is only going one way: up.

#713. 2026 NFL QB Rankings: Midseason Edition

2026 NFL QB Rankings: Midseason Edition

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/2026-nfl-qb-rankings-midseason-190000026.html

Berdasarkan laporan, we are roughly halfway through the season, and it's time to update our qb rankings once again. I thought this season was going to be a fascinating season to rank quarterbacks because I felt that the back half of the top 10 was wildly in flux. I felt that the top 5 was pretty well established, and with Father Time catching up to Matthew Stafford, there's even a spot in the top 5 up for grabs.

Diungkapkan bahwa but the biggest news is that we have knocked the king from the top spot. Patrick Mahomes has always been first on this list over the last two seasons, but it's time to acknowledge a fact: Josh Allen is now the best QB in the NFL.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, here's a list of the updated rankings, and as a reminder, these rankings are my opinion based on how the qb is playing this year, but also looking at their full body of work. Justin Herbert is not one of the top 30 QBs this season in isolation, but it's tough to rank him that low based on his previous seasons of success.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the king is dead. Mahomes is still great, but he doesn't impact the game as Allen does, and Allen has been at this level for the last couple of years. It's time to make the switch up top.

Diungkapkan bahwa i think many of us keep wondering if we are ever going to get back to that peak mahomes 2018 to 2022 version. He seems to be gone, but the 2023-2026 version is still very, very good.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, burrow is headed towards his first mvp, and it's one he absolutely deserves. Elite play without question.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in 2024, lamar had 45 touchdowns and 4 ints. That wasn't that long ago, but the injuries have slowed him down significantly the last two seasons. If Lamar has another injury-riddled season next year, he may start tumbling in 2027.

Berdasarkan laporan, brock purdy has earned this spot with his play, but i also don't think he's truly a top 5 qb at the nfl level. Top 10? Yes. But I don't think Purdy is in this tier, and there are guys biting at his heels that could easily jump him before the 2026 rankings are finalized in January.

Diungkapkan bahwa caleb's play from week one and his three-game stretch returning from injury was better than anyone else's in the league. But 4 INTs, even if it's a blip, certainly has to be considered, and between that and the injury, it keeps Caleb out of the top 5 (for now).

Sebagaimana diketahui, i've been fairly critical of love, but it's hard to argue with what he is doing with a suspect offensive line and no running game. The Packers have the best deep-ball passing attack in the league, and it's not particularly close.

After what Lawrence has done in the back half of last season and the first half of this season with Liam Coen, he has cemented Lawrence as a top-10 QB; now it's time to see how far he can climb.

Berdasarkan laporan, dak has led a maddeningly inconsistent and underperforming offense. He's still an excellent player, but he's most accurately considered a borderline top-10 QB, and that's where he's sitting midway through the season.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, stafford's season has been fine, but it has vibes quite similar to tom brady's final season in tampa. The numbers are down across the board. They're still good, but not MVP-level like last year, and you have to wonder if this might be Father Time knocking at the door.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there may be nobody better operating from a clean pocket than goff. Unfortunately, there are many QBs that operate far better under pressure. If Goff ever managed chaos well, he could climb as high as the top 5, but at this point in his career, that's probably not happening.

Patriots fans will probably see this ranking and be annoyed, but until Maye starts performing at a much better level against better teams, for me, it's going to be hard to push him into those elite spots on the rankings.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, he's playing the best football since his rookie season, and he's leading a texans team that we thought would be carried by their defense. If the Texans make the playoffs, it's going to be behind Stroud's right arm.

Berdasarkan laporan, daniels still shows flashes of who he was as a rookie, but a messy offense, injuries, and really poor decisions late in games are keeping daniels down. He's going to need to string together a solid couple of months of football while staying healthy if he ever wants to get out of this middle group.

Berdasarkan laporan, i still don't trust nix, but maybe i should start. When the game is on the line, Nix makes the plays; he just doesn't do it for the first 50 to 55 minutes of the game. If Nix starts putting together a more complete game on a consistent basis, he can surge towards the top 10.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, herbert entered the season with a chance to finally break into the top 5 with a big season; instead, he's playing at a level that makes him the worst starting qb in the nfl. Tough to drop him all the way down with his history of regular season success, but he's playing at a level that nobody can consider him one of the league's top 10 QBs until he proves otherwise.

Berdasarkan laporan, darnold is another guy who had a chance to start changing the narrative around his name after two great seasons and a super bowl championship, but he has struggled this year and arguably looked worse than his backup, drew lock. If Seattle is going to get back into the playoff hunt, Darnold needs to return to form.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's tough to have hurts much higher than this point when the eagles are clearly stocking up to potentially replace him. Hurts being out for the year with blood clots is awful for him, but based on where Hurts was prior to the issue, the writing does seem to be on the wall here in Philly.

Sebagaimana diketahui, young had really started stringing together some good games where you had to potentially consider him being in the top half of the league's qbs, but in the last three games, he has 5 tds, 4 ints, has completed less than 60% of his passes, and a y/a of 6. 1. He's reminded us who he is as a QB.

Sebagaimana diketahui, shough had a brutal game against the vikings but has been pretty darn good in all his other games. He needs to start leading the Saints to some wins (which he could) down the stretch to start pushing his way out of the 20s.

Berdasarkan laporan, cousins has done a nice job winding the clock back and playing some pretty darn good football. He doesn't have a high ceiling in Minnesota, but he does have a much higher one than their other QBs, and he helps this Vikings team tremendously.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, rodgers isn't playing as well as some are hyping him up to be, but he's playing a lot better than most thought he could. He's quite limited at this point, but he can still deliver the football when he needs to.

Dart awaits his chance next year to show that he's ready to leap an NFL QB.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, baker is certainly showing signs of slipping. He's 31, has been dealing with injuries, and doesn't look like the guy Tampa has had the last three years. The Baker extension that he signed in September may age like warm milk for Tampa.

Diungkapkan bahwa i think the question for this point with penix is whether he is truly a low-end qb1, or a high-end qb2. He's the best QB on Atlanta's roster, but that QB room doesn't exactly have Joe Montana and Steve Young in it.

Geno is playing much better this year in New York than he did last year in Vegas, but he's still quite limited and not going to be anything more than a bridge QB for whatever team he's with.

Diungkapkan bahwa brissett lost his job in arizona and is now going to try and keep the ravens afloat while they hope lamar can get back in december. Brissett has shown he's an excellent QB2 but really shouldn't be starting anywhere, and I'm curious if this is who Penix ends up becoming.

Sebagaimana diketahui, watson continues to play better than what many thought he was capable of at this point in his career, but it's also safe to say that cleveland is winning despite watson, not because of him. Cleveland needs to find something better at QB; if they do, Monken could really take off in Cleveland.

Sebagaimana diketahui, jones is the best qb2 in the nfl. He hasn't needed to play this year, but when he had to fill in for Purdy last year, he ran Shanahan's system fantastically. It'll be curious if Jones gets a chance somewhere to be a starter again in the next couple of years.

Diungkapkan bahwa this is probably a little too high for jameis, but when pressed into duty, he's been giving the giants a lot more good than bad. It'll be curious what the Giants do next year. His contract is guaranteed, but they'll have JJ McCarthy and Jaxson Dart as well.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the titans offense isn't exactly a juggernaut, but they have a pretty good offensive line, tony pollard, carnell tate, and a couple of other decent weapons. It's definitely getting to the point where the Titans have to wonder if Ward was the right call at QB. He just isn't taking that next step.

Berdasarkan laporan, murray was a better option for minnesota than carson wentz or jj mccarthy, but there's a reason they went out and got kirk cousins. The team wasn't going anywhere with Murray as their QB1.

Diungkapkan bahwa lock has really played well, all things considered, for seattle this year. He's won all 3 games that he's had to play; meanwhile, Darnold is 2-4 when he's under center. Lock has established himself as one of the top 5 QB2s in the league.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it made plenty of sense for the dolphins to give willis a shot, but he's not the answer at qb. The Dolphins are going to have a top-5 pick (maybe first overall), and they'll need to look long and hard at the QBs available.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, he has officially turned back into a pumpkin. The Giants gave Jones a big contract, and it blew up in their face. Those who do not learn from history are doomed to repeat it. And that's why Chris Ballard doesn't have a job.

Burrow has been as good as anyone in the league, but he does have a tendency to get injured, and having a capable backup like Flacco is a great spot for Cincinnati if he's called upon.

It's time to see what Mendoza can do and have an actual idea of where he should actually be ranked on this list.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, another very capable qb2 who unfortunately has joined lamar jackson on ir. It would have been interesting to see how Huntley would look in extended time.

Berdasarkan laporan, mariota has settled nicely into his role as qb2. With a guy like Daniels who can easily get banged up, like the Bengals, Mariota is a nice guy to fall back on.

Berdasarkan laporan, sanders definitely looked better than watson did in his opportunity. It'll be curious to see if Monken makes the switch in the next couple of weeks to see if Sanders can spark the Browns, who have lost two straight and 3 of their last 5.

Diungkapkan bahwa wentz's performance on monday night football was one of the worst by a qb we've ever seen. He's lucky he's still this high on the list.

Berdasarkan laporan, mccarthy has certainly looked better in new york than he did in minnesota, but we need to slow down on the praise. His overall numbers still aren't great, and he threw a crippling interception to end Thursday Night Football. He still isn't showing that he's a starting-caliber QB.

Berdasarkan laporan, daniels has played better this season than mayfield; not sure if that's praise for a udfa rookie qb or criticism for a veteran qb who just got handed a second extension from tampa. Either way, he remains a really nice story this season.

Diungkapkan bahwa minshew probably should have been in the top 50 despite not really playing because he is exactly what you need out of your qb2. He had a nice moment in Arizona, but his season is over due to injury.

Remember when Davis Mills hit the game-winning touchdown for Lovie Smith and that gave the Bears the first pick in the 2023 draft, which led to the Bryce Young trade, which led to the Bears drafting Caleb Williams? Good times.

Berdasarkan laporan, keenum still rides on the list thanks to his performance against the eagles this year. It's still one of the feel-good stories of the year.

I still think Taylor is a solid QB2 even if he hasn't seen the field for the Packers.

Bagent is still clinging to his top 50 spot on the list, but it won't take much to bump him off with guys like Justin Fields tumbling off the list completely; Bagent could easily be next.

I would suspect Mitch is actually a better QB than Cam Ward is at this moment, but the Titans need to see if Ward can become their guy, so Mitch continues to hold the clipboard and be a veteran presence in the QB room.

#716. Broncos have no comment as to Jim Harbaugh's complaints about Daiyan Henley trade

📅 13 Nov 2026

Broncos have no comment as to Jim Harbaugh's complaints about Daiyan Henley trade

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/profootballtalk/rumor-mill/news/broncos-have-no-comment-as-to-jim-harbaughs-complaints-about-daiyan-henley-trade

The failed Daiyan Henley trade has exposed a previously unknown (by many) loophole in the trade deadline, which could be used by an unscrupulous team to leverage better terms after a deal is otherwise done — and the time for negotiating trades has otherwise ended.

Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh essentially accused the Broncos of being unscrupulous by taking the position that Henley had failed his physical but that the physical would magically be un-failed if the compensation for Henley was reduced from a fourth-round pick and a fifth-round pick.

In response to an inquiry from PFT, the Broncos had no comment on the situation.

Berdasarkan laporan, during a normal week, broncos coach sean payton would be meeting with reporters on friday. Because Denver has a Week 10 bye, Payton won’t speak to the media again until Monday.

At that point, it will be interesting to see whether he shares the Broncos’ position, or whether he makes it clear that Denver is moving on.

Berdasarkan laporan, of course, that doesn’t stop the broncos from pushing their position on an off-the-record basis to one of the reporters who routinely covers the team. And their position seems to be that the Broncos believe the Chargers weren’t candid about the condition of Henley’s knee during the discussions that preceded the trade.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the broncos also contend, not on the record (yet), that the goal was to acquire henley (who is in the last year of his contract) not as a rental but as a long-term addition. (They would have acquired exclusive negotiating rights with Henley through the opening of the legal tampering period in March. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, still, with harbaugh making his case on the record, the broncos should do the same. While there’s surely some sensitivity to the impact of the chatter about Henley’s knee on his future earning potential, the options (in our view) should be to address the situation on the record or say nothing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, through it all, the more important point is that the league’s procedures allow things like this to happen. And, apparently, deadline deals have indeed been tweaked in the past based on concerns about a player’s physical.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it shouldn’t be that way. m. For any deal done before 4:00 p. ET on the day the trade window closes, there should be two possible outcomes: The player passes the physical and the deal goes through as negotiated, or the player fails the physical and the player reverts to his prior team.

#717. Apple, Alphabet and Uber survived major founder transitions. Nvidia will be a harder test

📅 13 Nov 2026

Apple, Alphabet and Uber survived major founder transitions. Nvidia will be a harder test

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/nvidia-jensen-huang-founder-ceo-transition.html

Jensen Huang is not the first CEO to leave a company he helped build.

But experts told CNBC that his sudden resignation from Nvidia at a critical juncture is unique and leaves his eventual successor with challenges in leading the company that's powering the artificial intelligence boom.

Berdasarkan laporan, in 33 years, huang, who resigned on thursday amid reports of extramarital affairs, including with a woman u. S. intelligence believes is a spy for China, made the company he co-founded the world's most valuable.

Former Goldman Sachs CEO Lloyd Blankfein wrote on X that he was "indispensable" but "the graveyards are filled with indispensable men," referencing a quote attributed to French leader Charles de Gaulle.

While the board looks for a new CEO and CFO Colette Kress does the job temporarily; analysts say Huang's charisma and bullish drive will be hard to replicate.

"I'm not sure we've seen a situation quite like this, where the founder and CEO of one of the world's largest companies faces such a sudden departure amid scandal," Michael Withers, professor of management at the University of Notre Dame's Mendoza College of Business, told CNBC.

Whoever follows will "face challenges that go well beyond those of a typical CEO replacing a founder," he added.

Berdasarkan laporan, apple's image was inseparable from steve jobs when he resigned in 2011. But unlike Nvidia, the company had had other CEOs — and an internal successor.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, tim cook invested in apple's chip strategy and services business and became a key corporate diplomat in dealings with the u. S. and Chinese governments. He was known as an operator who controlled Apple's supply chain.

Diungkapkan bahwa cook had "considerable preparation" for becoming ceo, withers said. Apple's market cap went from about $350 billion to $4 trillion in his 15-year tenure.

Larry Page and Sergey Brin left their executive roles at Alphabet in 2019, 21 years after founding Google.

Sebagaimana diketahui, page and brin's departures were expected. Page said at the time that it was the "natural time" to simplify the company's management structure. Alphabet shares are up more than 300% since then under Sunder Pichai.

Travis Kalanick left Uber in 2017 after mounting pressure over a series of scandals and governance concerns.

But his departure "unfolded over several months, and while it certainly attracted attention, it pales in comparison to what Nvidia is currently facing," Withers added.

Former Expedia CEO Dara Khosrowshahi repaired the organization and found a path to profitability.

Withers said successor CEOs often struggle "under normal circumstances" to juggle maintaining what made a company successful while establishing their own leadership.

"It becomes considerably more difficult when the transition follows such a high-profile scandal involving the company's founder," he added.

Huang had an extraordinary 60 direct reports, as part of a flat structure that favored fast communication over layered hierarchies.

Withers told CNBC Nvidia did not appear to have a succession plan for Huang, who is also often described as inextricably linked to the company.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we're talking about a company that was, until recently, the largest in the world by market capitalization. That's a pretty remarkable situation," he added.

As well as having to "step out of his shadow," the new CEO will have to deal with the "scandal" arising from Huang's conduct and "the extent to which it sticks with Nvidia," Withers said.

Huang's successor will also have to tackle the longer-term business strategy, while picking up the relationships he managed.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, huang cultivated a close relationship with u. S. Huang consistently pushed for the U. S. President Donald Trump and accompanied him to China in May. to relax export restrictions that prevent Nvidia from selling its chips to the world's second-largest economy.

He also managed close relationships with the bosses of the company's key suppliers, from SK Hynix to Samsung.

Storm Uru, co-head of the Global Innovation team at Nvidia investor Liontrust Asset Management, said two key priorities were changing company culture and managing the supply chain.

Berdasarkan laporan, the supply chain was "where jensen was able to provide a vision for the future and able to bring people to the table and to expand capacity to enable the build-out of this technology," uru told cnbc, adding it mattered especially "when supply chains are already so tight. ".

Nvidia continues to face rising competition from rivals such as AMD and hyperscalers, which are ramping up efforts to develop their own chips.

Investors noted that the new CEO will have a roadmap of products for the next few years, unaffected by Huang's removal.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we have to look beyond jensen. there are thousands upon thousands of engineers," Joanne Feeney, partner and portfolio manager, Advisors Capital Management, told CNBC on Thursday, as pressure was mounting on Huang to go.

#718. Must-See 65: The plan to kill the NBA back-to-back and re-energize the sport's biggest stars

📅 13 Nov 2026

Must-See 65: The plan to kill the NBA back-to-back and re-energize the sport's biggest stars

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/nba/article/must-see-65-the-plan-to-kill-the-nba-back-to-back-and-re-energize-the-sports-biggest-stars-162947766.html

Diungkapkan bahwa it was well past midnight when the philadelphia 76ers touched down in charlotte. Then Saturday: an early 6 p. m. ET. ET national TV game against the defending champion New York Knicks. " Friday night in Philadelphia: a 7:30 p. The star-studded team was in the middle of a back-to-back prepping for its league-high seventh game in just 12 days. m. At the earliest, lights out at 2 a. Shower, bus, shuffle onto the team plane for a nearly 500-mile trip down the coast. m. You could call it an NBA "short night. ET tip against the Hornets on Halloween.

Of the 426 back-to-backs on the NBA schedule, this was the second-shortest turnaround with travel: 22 1/2 hours, with an overnight flight in between.

Sebagaimana diketahui, fans in charlotte saw the cost. LeBron James and Joel Embiid jerseys filled the stands, but both James (sciatica) and Embiid (plantar fasciitis) were ruled out managing injuries on the second night of the back-to-back. Fans paid good money for tickets and TV packages, not to mention parking and concessions and merch, and expected to see them.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but don't blame the players. Blame the schedule.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in my decade-plus covering the nba, i have written about back-to-backs many times before. Hundreds more still litter the schedule. And it was only October. But as the 76ers sideline reporter for NBC Sports Philadelphia this season, I hadn't experienced one quite like this. With injuries sweeping through the league's stars — Stephen Curry (oblique) is now out multiple weeks — and fan trust at stake, the fix is overdue:.

Ban back-to-backs and move to a 65-game schedule.

Diungkapkan bahwa the nba has always sold its stars. Right now, the league is breaking that promise.

Diungkapkan bahwa anthony edwards used to be a loud critic against load management. At his first All-Star appearance in 2023, the 21-year-old star responded to a question about the league's hot-button issue.

Berdasarkan laporan, "just play, man," edwards said. These people might have enough money to come to one game. "If you 80%, you gotta play. And that might be the game they come to and you sitting out. I don't like all the sitting, missing games stuff. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa edwards walked the walk. Edwards played in nearly every game of that Timberwolves season, the first of three straight seasons playing 79 games. No All-Star played more than Edwards, per Stathead tracking, and the fans loved it.

Edwards was a box-office hit and seemed invincible, the face that could stem the tide of load management.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and then in march last season, his knee started barking. His coach Chris Finch praised his Ironman courage and noted Edwards had played in 95% of his games in his career, "which is extremely rare. One pressing issue: He needed to play in seven of the 15 remaining games to qualify for postseason awards, which, until the OKC game, seemed easily attainable. He looked limited against OKC in his 58th game and the medical team sidelined him. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but the game finally caught up to edwards. This week, he was seen still on crutches. This season, after just four games, Edwards was shut down with issues in the same knee that he tried to play through last season. The team hopes he's back in two months after knee debridement surgery. He fell short of the 65 games needed for all-league awards and missed more time in the playoffs. The health problems have only continued. He missed 11 of the team's next 14 games and hobbled through the worst postseason of his precocious career. A league and its fans may wonder: Will he ever be the same?.

Diungkapkan bahwa maybe edwards saw this coming. The same week he was shut down, Adidas unveiled its latest commercial captioned "65 games one way or another" for its flagship player. In the pre-taped ad, Edwards is holding auditions for his stand-in when he misses time. In the spot, Edwards, arguably the NBA's most marketable American star and once-crusader against load management, is seemingly surrendering to the reality of the 82-game grind. The timing of its publication sliced like a knife. "If I gotta sit out this season, you gotta act like me, you gotta talk like me, most importantly you gotta hoop like me," Edwards cracked.

Berdasarkan laporan, edwards' body couldn't hold up and now his shoe company is mocking the whole thing. But it's no laughing matter for the players, fans and the league's business.

Diungkapkan bahwa injuries have dominated headlines in the early going. Less than 10 games into the season, Edwards was one of nine star players — as defined by the league's Player Participation Policy of having been named to at least one All-Star or All-NBA team in the previous three seasons — who have already suffered a significant injury. You can add Curry to this list.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the oklahoma city thunder, with dreams of being the league's next dynasty, have been decimated by the reality, with major injuries to stars jalen williams (broken fibula and dislocated ankle) and chet holmgren (knee), not to mention key player cason wallace, who is shelved indefinitely with a shoulder injury. Tyrese Haliburton, Jalen Duren and Kawhi Leonard are also injured on championship contenders.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the game is faster and more taxing than it was in previous generations. Steve Kerr told me during the 2025 playoffs that it's a young man's game, the sheer velocity making it tougher for vets in the playoffs. About a month after that, Haliburton tore his Achilles in Game 7 of the NBA Finals. Even the young players aren't immune to the harsh demands of the sport.

Berdasarkan laporan, in 2023, when the nba rolled out its player participation policy, the nba commissioned a 57-page study on load management. (Science is hard. From 2019-20 through 2022-23, however, that number jumped to 23. It didn't find evidence that load management affected injury rates in either direction. ) One chart, though, told a clear story that demands wholesale reform: The average star missed 10. 4 in the 2010s. 4 games a season in the 1980s, growing gradually to 10. Last season, I ran the numbers and it hit 27. 9 in the 2000s and 17. 6 games a season in the 1990s, 13. 9. 7, more than two-and-a-half times the 1990s rate.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that's a lot of stars missing in action, and even more potential lifelong fans who are now looking elsewhere with their eyeballs and dollars. Fans waking up to find the news of another star getting hurt has become routine, even if, by my count, star injury rates are slightly down overall year over year. (Those Damian Lillard, Tyrese Haliburton, Kyrie Irving and Jayson Tatum DNPs last season added up quickly. ) Even excluding last season's season-scrapping injuries, the overall trend line is unmistakable.

Berdasarkan laporan, so, how do we get back to the pre-2000 dnp rates? small tweaks haven't worked. A 40-minute game doesn't address the biggest problem: The sport is too taxing for so many games with crosscountry travel. We need to invest and protect the stars that make the NBA what it is. A 65-game season that rejuvenates fan trust and interest is the answer. We need to think about Felipe.

For the 76ers' back-to-back ending in Charlotte, what got me was seeing the kids in the stands, the ones who brought posters and chanted their favorite players' names only for the schedule to let them down.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this happens all too often. Butler was a late scratch with lower back tightness. In 2023, an Argentinean boy named Felipe flew over 4,000 miles to see Jimmy Butler play in Miami. (Butler felt terrible and met with the family the next day with merch. TNT cameras showed the devastation when the kid dropped his poster in shock when he learned Butler wasn't playing. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, the nba has a real opportunity to further invest in delivering to families and younger fans who build core memories at games. Studies show that lifelong sports fandom is typically inherited by family ties and most were hooked by age 14. The Felipe story went viral and he got taken care of, but I worry that most just go home and think twice about buying tickets next time, turning on their Nintendo Switch instead of the big game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when i think about improving an already great league, a 65-game season that eliminates these zero-rest nights is key. Part of that is the stakes, but part of it, I suspect, is the schedule-makers keeping Cup games off dreaded back-to-backs. I've shown that star players suit up for more than 90% of Cup games, higher than the regular-season norm. Why am I targeting back-to-backs? The link to injuries is murky, but it's the clearest way to get stars on the floor, and that's what keeps fans coming back. In the playoffs, where there are no back-to-backs, stars don't sit for rest and play almost every game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, james and embiid join a host of stars who have already missed the second night of a back-to-back this season. Curry, Luka Dončić, Paul George, Pascal Siakam and Kyrie Irving have all sat a zero-rest game in 2026-27. This season, stars have played in 73. 5% of games on the second night of a back-to-back, compared with nearly 80% of all other games.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the product is also better without back-to-backs. That's no fluke. Wembanyama is dunking 40% more when he isn't playing on the second night of a back-to-back, continuing last season's trend where, according to Stathead tracking, he dunked 25% more with at least one day of recovery. Victor Wembanyama's Wilt impression last Wednesday — 52 points, 24 rebounds and 8 blocks — came on a day of rest. League-wide, dunks go up when players' bodies aren't run down on back-to-backs.

So with all that considered, here's my proposal.

Diungkapkan bahwa every team plays 65 games in the regular season. The league and the players union agreed that 65 games makes a star's season count. I'm calling it Must-See 65. Let's make it real with a 65-game schedule and let's make it must-see TV.

Berdasarkan laporan, say goodbye to the 82-game schedule and bring back appointment viewing. Continue to market the stars and deliver more on that promise. Restore trust among fans and make advertisers more confident with their investments.

Berdasarkan laporan, the most common rebuttal is money: critics claim that owners and players will never agree to give up that much revenue. Owners are warming up to the idea that fewer games can mean more valuable ones. But baseball's owners just proposed cutting eight games without cutting player salaries. NBA owners have a possible cushion, too: Each stands to collect a reported $650 million or more in upcoming expansion fees.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for players, the upside is health. Fewer games and no back-to-backs mean fewer nights playing banged up, and potentially longer careers, which can be worth millions in future earnings.

Diungkapkan bahwa with expansion on the horizon, the time is now. Ten months ago, I campaigned for a 58-game schedule as part of Adam Silver's New Year's Resolutions. But with expansion imminent, I wasn't thinking big enough. Two more teams unlock a new billion-dollar revenue stream in my Must-See 65 proposal.

Diungkapkan bahwa let's get into it. Here are some key points of Must-See 65 that will help keep revenues neutral:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, • with the expected expansion to seattle and las vegas, the emirates nba cup turns into a 32-team single-elimination tournament midseason, seeded by record. Capture some of the magical dust of March Madness, a tournament that reels in more than $1 billion a year. (Before expansion, the top two teams receive a bye. ).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, • this year, the emirates nba cup championship game will be played at hinkle fieldhouse in indianapolis. You want an NBA team? Show us. Double down on that. Break the 32 teams into four regional sites in cities that have dreams of having an NBA team: Nashville, Louisville, Kansas City and Mexico City. With lots of money and fans, of course.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, • some schedule housekeeping: in the regular season, play each team twice — one home, one away — for 60 non-cup regular-season games. With Seattle and Las Vegas added, each team skips one game against two non-conference opponents on an eight-year rotation basis. The Cup will take care of the remaining five games, with makeup games at regional sites for those who are eliminated. (Before expansion, the NBA can add two regular-season games to reach 65. Maybe package a rivalry miniseries of three intradivision games?).

Berdasarkan laporan, • here's the best part: the winner of the 32-team tournament gets to decide their playoff opponent until the conference finals. Yes, that means if you win the NBA Cup, you're guaranteed a playoff spot. The Opponent Selection Show becomes a sponsored TV revenue driver.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, banning back-to-backs could be the nba's version of the pitch clock in baseball: a fix that fans can feel immediately. No more need to wait until game day to see if the star is ruled out. Packaged the right way, a new season format without back-to-backs could lead to a similar bump in eyeballs and youth engagement. Baseball's attendance has grown in three straight years since it was added and the fan base got younger. No more sad Felipes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, will fewer games raise ticket prices? maybe. But tickets are already expensive and star absences can hurt the fan experience. Fans will pay more for Hamilton tickets if Lin-Manuel Miranda is on the bill and they have a better chance of leaving happy.

Berdasarkan laporan, the sleep-deprived halloween game was notable for another reason. Fans in Charlotte saw a shorthanded Sixers team stumble its way through the game, eking out a victory in the closing minutes. Jaylen Brown was the only Sixer to dunk in the game.

Berdasarkan laporan, two days later, with a day off, the sixers' star-studded lineup of tyrese maxey, vj edgecombe, brown, james and embiid returned to the floor. The dunk count that night? Nine. With more recovery for its stars, the team put on a show in a home win against the Bulls. That's the NBA that fans pay to see.

Berdasarkan laporan, the wbo and ring super lightweight champion shakur stevenson is undoubtedly one of the most talented fighters in the sport. It didn't last long, and Shakur is now a free agent. When talking to Fight Hub TV, Eddie Hearn made it clear that Matchroom are in the running to re-sign Shakur Stevenson.

Diungkapkan bahwa shakur was often criticised for not being the most fan-friendly fighter in the sport, but wins over william zepeda and teofimo lopez took stevenson to a new level, putting the undefeated 29-year-old southpaw at the top of many pound-for-pound lists. After Stevenson's departure from Matchroom, he eventually ended up signing for Zuffa, and it appeared to be the move he wanted and needed:.

Diungkapkan bahwa "line them up, one by one, and i'll beat all the top guys once i get them in front of me. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa "shakur is one of the best pound-for-pound fighters in the world," said ufc president dana white in the same press release. "He's 29 years old, undefeated and already a four-division world champion. This is a massive signing for Zuffa Boxing, and I'm looking forward to promoting this next fight. ".

It looked like a perfect match for both, but following failed negotiations to make a fight, Shakur has departed.

Explaining his departure in a post on YouTube, Shakur said:.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i'm here to tell you all about the wild journey that i've been on the last couple of months. I've been working my as* off, staying focused, staying in shape.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i'm not mad at anyone or pointing any fingers, but upon all of these issues and things that have been going on, i requested to be released from zuffa boxing. Over the weekend my request has been granted and I am officially a free agent. ".

Photo by Mikey Williams/Top Rank Inc via Getty Images.

Speaking to Fight Hub TV, Eddie Hearn was asked if Matchroom are trying to re-sign Shakur Stevenson (25-0, 11 KOs), having previously worked with the current WBO and Ring Magazine super lightweight champion.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "of course. I felt for a long time, since we started working together. So, we'll have to see. He's got a good team of people around him. Everybody's gonna be in the race. Who wouldn't? I think there's a lot of people trying to sign Shakur Stevenson, and he's gonna talk to everybody, as he should. Hopefully they feel like we're the best direction for them.
