Ravens announce Lamar Jackson had surgery on broken and dislocated thumb, will be out 6-10 weeks

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/ravens-announce-lamar-jackson-surgery-broken-dislocated-thumb-out-6-10-weeks/

If not listed, please contact your TV provider.

Baltimore Ravens head coach Jesse Minter announced on Friday morning that quarterback Lamar Jackson will be out 6-10 weeks after undergoing surgery on a broken and dislocated thumb.

Diungkapkan bahwa "lamar is doing well as he recovers from the broken and dislocated thumb injury he suffered in week 8," minter said in a statement released on social media. He is doing everything he can to get back, and we will let his progress guide the timing of his return. We are committed to playing our best football over the second half of the season. "Recovery timelines are challenging to predict, but injuries like this that require surgery typically take about 6-10 weeks to heal. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa jackson injured his thumb on the first snap of the ravens' week 8 game against the buffalo bills, which was billed as a showdown between two of the most recent nfl mvps (jackson and josh allen). He missed the previous 3. 5 games with a high ankle sprain suffered at the end of the first half of the Ravens' Week 4 win against the Tennessee Titans before returning against Buffalo, only to see his return cut short.

Diungkapkan bahwa with jackson out, tyler huntley filled in early in the season, going 1-2 in his three starts. (Huntley is out for the season. Huntley also got injured in the same game against the Bills, though, leaving undrafted rookie free agent Joe Fagnano as the only healthy quarterback on the roster. ) Fagnano also suffered an ankle injury during that game, but played through it last Thursday night against the Jaguars and struggled badly.

Diungkapkan bahwa prior to his injuries, jackson went 68-of-97 for 967 yards, six touchdowns and one interception while rushing 19 times for 144 yards and an additional score. The Ravens' offense looked efficient and explosive, with Jackson targeting Zay Flowers all over the field and Derrick Henry running between the tackles, but we only saw that version of the offense for about two full games. (Flowers was injured in Week 1, missed Week 2 and played only a third of the snaps in Week 3, while Jackson missed the second half in Week 4. ).

Sebagaimana diketahui, in the wake of the various quarterback injuries, the ravens traded for former cardinals starter jacoby brissett, who is expected to take over under center for the remainder of the season. Now they will have to hope Brissett can guide them to enough wins to make it worth Jackson's potential late-season return to the lineup for a potential playoff push in the AFC.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, jackson currently sits at a pivotal point in his current contract with the ravens. While Baltimore still has one year of control on the two-time MVP's five-year contract, the 2027 contract year is currently structured as an $84. 3 million cap hit with zero guaranteed money attached. This number, which would take up more than a quarter of Baltimore's 2027 cap space at present per Over the Cap, all but forces a contract renegotiation next year. Jackson does not have an agent and represents himself in contract and business dealings.

#734. Failed Daiyan Henley trade exposes a flaw in the NFL's trade deadline

📅 12 Nov 2026

Failed Daiyan Henley trade exposes a flaw in the NFL's trade deadline

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/profootballtalk/rumor-mill/news/failed-daiyan-henley-trade-exposes-a-flaw-in-the-nfls-trade-deadline

Diungkapkan bahwa the trade deadline is the trade deadline. Except when it’s not the trade deadline.

The strange situation involving the failed trade of Chargers linebacker Daiyan Henley to the Broncos reveals a major flaw in the NFL’s deadline-day machinery.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, adam schefter of espn has provided the details (which we have confirmed to be accurate) in the most nonchalant, innocuous terms possible: “it is not uncommon for one team to have some medical concerns about a player while another does not. The deal was off. In the end, no agreement was reached. Even then, the Broncos still wanted Henley with Denver and LA discussing revised trade alternatives throughout the day, taking into account those concerns. In this case, Denver had concerns about Henley following his physical. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, here’s what it means. The Chargers and Broncos struck a deal for Henley and independently communicated the terms to the NFL before the trade deadline of 4:00 p. ET on Tuesday, November 10. m. Like all trades, the Henley deal was subject to the player passing a physical.

Diungkapkan bahwa the broncos discovered an issue with henley’s knee. It has, we’re told, arthritis. (As one source with neither the Chargers nor the Broncos told PFT, most if not all starting linebackers in the NFL have some degree of arthritis in their knees. ).

Sebagaimana diketahui, the nfl allows trade terms to be revised after the deadline, to an extent. They would not be able to add a player or trade a different player. Per a league spokesperson: “We would permit them to change the pick compensation. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, instead of concluding that the physical had been failed and canceling the deal (like the ravens did with the trade for raiders defensive end maxx crosby in march), the broncos were willing to proceed with revised terms. In other words, for something less than a fourth-round pick in 2027 and a fifth-round pick in 2028, they’d still do the deal.

Diungkapkan bahwa that’s not how it should work after the deadline. m. The window has closed. The deals are done, or they’re not. After 4:00 p. ET on November 10, the only question left to answer is whether the player passes or fails the physical.

As one source explained it, deadline-day deals have gone through in the past with terms that were revised after the deadline.

Diungkapkan bahwa based on schefter’s reporting, that’s what happened here. The Broncos had “medical concerns,” but not enough to reject the player. The Broncos and Chargers discussed “revised trade alternatives” on Wednesday — the day after the window for doing trades ended.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the chargers could have taken less in order to get the deal done. They chose not to do so. The fact that the rules allow trade terms to be renegotiated after the deadline opened the door for the Broncos to squeeze the Chargers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the situation creates an opportunity for shenanigans. Then, when the physical is performed after the deadline, Team C can say, “Well, we have medical concerns. If, for example, Team A is preparing to trade a player to Team B at the deadline for a fourth-round pick and a sixth-round pick, Team C can swoop in and offer a fourth-round pick and a fifth-round pick. If we don’t agree to reduce the package to a fourth-round pick and a sixth-round pick, we’re going to fail the player on his physical. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that’s not to say the broncos did it deliberately. Obviously, however, they remained interested in Henley (who has started all eight games this year and has participated in 89 percent of the snaps) at something less than the agreed terms.

Diungkapkan bahwa the point is that this little-known ability to extend the trading period by giving the acquiring team the ability to use the physical to leverage better terms shouldn’t exist. When a deal is done at the deadline, the trade should either go through for the agreed terms or it shouldn’t.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it opens the door to gamesmanship. The team that has traded the player has no alternatives. It can’t trade the player to someone else. It either has to accept reduced terms or try to put the toothpaste back in the tube.

Diungkapkan bahwa the vikings, for example, could have tried to do that to the raiders regarding quarterback kirk cousins. “Well, we found something in Kirk’s leg that we don’t like. We’re not comfortable giving up a third-round pick. How about a fifth-round pick instead?”.

What would the Raiders have done at that point? They’d already turned the page to Fernando Mendoza, and they spent Tuesday and Wednesday getting him ready to play.

Berdasarkan laporan, the rule needs to change. The ability to revisit trade terms after the deadline has passed should be eliminated. Either the deal gets done as negotiated, or it doesn’t.

Sebagaimana diketahui, hovering over all of this is the subjectivity that can result in a team failing a player on a physical if it wants that outcome. (The Bengals, for example, could have determined that Eagles defensive end Arnold Ebiketie failed his physical, if the Bengals hadn’t realized until after the trade terms were finalized that the Bengals would lose a 2027 third-round compensatory pick if the trade became official. It’s an easy way out for a team that has buyer’s remorse. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, at some point, it makes sense for the physicals not to be conducted by team doctors but by an independent, unaffiliated physician. But that’s for another day. For now, the immediate problem that needs to be solved is the ability of teams to renegotiate trade terms after the trade deadline.

No one benefits from that, and unscrupulous teams could use it to their advantage.

#736. The Grizzlies are way ahead of schedule, but still have a long way to go

📅 13 Nov 2026

The Grizzlies are way ahead of schedule, but still have a long way to go

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/grizzlies-way-ahead-schedule-still-145303764.html

Diungkapkan bahwa every season comes with its own unique twists and turns. If it wasn't that way, all of our offseason prediction pieces would be perfect and there would be no point in playing any games.

Sebagaimana diketahui, fortunately, this year has been no different. Chief among all the unexpected outcomes are the Memphis Grizzlies, who, in what was supposed to be the first year of a rebuild, sit at 7-4 with the 10th-best net-rating in the entire association.

Berdasarkan laporan, with teams like the oklahoma city thunder and minnesota timberwolves enduring significant injuries, and others like the denver nuggets looking too old for their own good, it is plausible that the west is more wide-open than we initially believed. But is it possible for the Grizzlies to be this ahead of schedule? Or is this just a flash of what they will eventually become?.

It feels cliche to say this given how much this team has permeated the NBA zeitgeist since they won it all, but this Grizzlies group really does resemble the 2013-14 Beautiful Game San Antonio Spurs.

Berdasarkan laporan, the spurs were an incredibly deep team that reached the platonic ideals for decision-making speed, spacing, and ball movement. Head coach Tuomas Iisalo has the Grizzlies on this current trajectory.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, iisalo basically load manages his team to ensure that they are as fresh as possible. The only other teams that can say that are the Indiana Pacers, Golden State Warriors, Oklahoma City Thunder, and Utah Jazz  – all of whom have had to deal with their fair share of injuries. This year, 13 Grizzlies have played at least 70 total minutes. So, their digging deep into their bench is more out of necessity than it is a tactical decision.

Berdasarkan laporan, under this new regime, the grizzlies are deploying a multi-layered, ball-screen continuity attack predicated around the pick-and-roll and side-to-side ball movement. Iisalo quite literally refers to the concept as "flow," which is poetic considering the way the offense softly cascades from action to action. The intricacies of their futuristic style are outside of the scope of the current discussion, but if you want to learn more, be sure to check out this deep dive from Coach Gibson Pyper:.

Diungkapkan bahwa as any coach will tell you, strategy will only take you so far. You need the players who can execute your vision or else it doesn't matter how smart you are. This offense requires skilled operates (Ty Jerome and Cam Spencer), strong screeners (Zach Edey, Cam Boozer, and Isaiah Stewart), shooters/closeout attackers (Cedric Coward, Jaylen Wells, Jerami Grant, and Quentin Post), and speedy court mappers (Boozer may be better than any rookie at this in all of NBA history).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the bottom line is that this team has a litany of legit players. When he's out there, the Grizzlies are in the 99th percentile in defensive rating (per Cleaning the Glass). That's in a league that features Victor Wembanyama. It starts in the middle. This also shows on the defensive side of the ball, where the Grizzlies currently rank fifth (just like on offense). Prior to the start of the season, I called Stewart one of the best defensive bigs in the league, and the only thing stopping me from doing the same with Edey were his lingering injury concerns. Edey, in particular, is looking like a fringe Defensive Player of the Year candidate. Between him and Stewart, that's an excellent defensive foundation.

Berdasarkan laporan, wells and coward are a pair of rangy wings, with powers that perfectly compliment each other (wells is better at defending the ball, coward has more of a presence off-ball). Grant and GG Jackson have size and length. Boozer moves better than anyone with his muscle mass should reasonably be expected to. Kris Murray would get more buzz for his defensive prowess if his offense wasn't so damaging.

Berdasarkan laporan, iisalo's theory about keeping bodies fresh has come to fruition. An abundance of youthful vigor (the Grizzlies are the third-youngest team in the league) certainly helps, too. While many teams are operating at half-speed, conserving themselves for the 82-game grind, the Grizzlies are moving like it's the first round of the postseason. Look at the way Wells and Boozer are sliding their feet in this first clip, or the diligence from Spencer to x-out and kill the advantage created by Braden Smith:.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you're a fan of the team or in any way affiliated with the organization, you should feel very excited about what you are building. Boozer, Coward, Edey, Wells, Jackson, and Stewart are all 25 years old and younger. The future is bright in Memphis, but for right now, there are some indicators that tell us negative regression is coming.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the grizzlies are second in 3-point percentage and eighth opponent 3-point percentage. Opponent 3-point percentage is almost exclusively contingent on variables outside of a defense's control, and, on the flip side, I doubt this group will remain the second-best shooting team in the association for the entirety of the marathon.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dunks & threes has a metric which ranks a team's strength of schedule from the games they've already played (sos). According to that, the Grizzlies have had the second-easiest schedule this year, with their best win coming against a Warriors team that had yet to hit its stride.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in their recent loss against the indiana pacers, we got front row seats at their biggest shortfall: guard play/ball handling. Outside of Ty Jerome, Cam Spencer, and Scottie Pippen Jr. (who is hurt right now), the Grizzlies don't have much in terms of pressure breakers, and none of those three gentlemen is a black belt in this art form. The Pacers' token fullcourt pressure hounded the Grizzlies all night, to the tune of 20 turnovers and their lowest offensive rating output of the season.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this could be remedied if iisalo started playing two of these three together more frequently, but in that case, it would weaken their formidability on the other side of the ball. Patching up one whole leads to another. A telltale sign of a flawed unit.

Diungkapkan bahwa if i was a prospective general manager, who could pick a ten-year gig with any team in the league, it would take one hand to count off the places i'd pick over the grizzlies. What they have here is real, and it seems more bulletproof than the last generation (no pun intended, I swear). But right now, in 2026-27, I find it difficult to see the Grizzlies as anything more than a fringe playoff team.

#750. Joel Embiid’s aggressiveness was a welcome sight for Sixers

📅 13 Nov 2026

Joel Embiid’s aggressiveness was a welcome sight for Sixers

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/joel-embiid-aggressiveness-welcome-sight-143653528.html

Sebagaimana diketahui, the sixers losing two out of three games wasn't necessarily cause for much concern, but the way they lost those games raised some alarm bells. Particularly with Joel Embiid, who has yet to find his shot this season. His defense also began to deteriorate over the past couple of games as he dealt with plantar fasciitis in his right foot.

Diungkapkan bahwa through his first 10 games of the season, embiid shot just 37% from the field and a career-low 55% from the rim. That included a game where he went 0-for-9 from the field in Cleveland against the Cavaliers, one of the worst performances of his career.

After being blown out by the Boston Celtics, Embiid admitted that he might be in his own head.

Diungkapkan bahwa "[i'm] probably overthinking it too much," he said, "and then i think the rhythm of the game is different. I'm so used to having to create for myself, so it's a little bit different. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the toronto raptors coming to town provided a good opportunity for a get-right game. Not only were they down multiple key starters and on the second night of a back-to-back, but their starting center, Jakob Poeltl, has struggled mightily all season.

Sebagaimana diketahui, embiid didn't completely snap out of his funk. His 20 points came on 7-of-17 shooting. Toronto was able to get into the lane with relative ease all night, but anyone watching the game could tell that Embiid was moving around the floor much better than he had in recent outings as the Sixers got back in the win column. That fact was capped off by Embiid dunking not once but twice.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i think it's a really, really big positive," said head coach nick nurse. "I think that he's just moving better, and I'm not sure that was the case for a couple games here recently. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, embiid was able to do all of this after scaring every sixers fan at the beginning of the game. Early in the first quarter he bumped knees with Ja'Kobe Walter as he was setting a screen and went down in a heap of pain. He went back to the locker room but was able to return three minutes later of game time.

Diungkapkan bahwa nurse said that embiid was "very, very motivated" to play once he had returned to the locker room — so much so that nurse had trouble subbing him out for his scheduled rests. Nurse did say that's a good problem, sometimes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, embiid didn't talk after the game, but he told reporters at shootaround before the game that he needed to be more aggressive. While he still didn't hit as many midrange jumpers as he's used to, that aggression was visible in his shot selection — 10 of his 17 attempts came from the paint and it looked like he really started to hunt dunks. He nearly had another self-lob off the backboard, but Collin Murray-Boyles got in the way, forcing Embiid to kick the ball out to Kentavious Caldwell-Pope for a three.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "it's nice to see the kind of movement spark come back," nurse said. When he's driving the ball, he's feeling pretty good. "You've heard me say this a lot too. ".

#755. U.S. seizes $1.2 billion in cryptocurrency stolen from Binance

📅 13 Nov 2026

U.S. seizes $1.2 billion in cryptocurrency stolen from Binance

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/us-seizes-binance-hack-crypto.html

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, u. authorities have seized around $1. S. 2 billion in virtual assets stolen from cryptocurrency exchange Binance last month, the Department of Justice said Thursday, as it vowed action to tackle cyberscams originating from North Korea.

Berdasarkan laporan, over $6 billion was stolen from industry giant binance on oct. 29, which the DOJ attributed to actors linked to the North Korean military.

Diungkapkan bahwa collective efforts between the u. government and private sector have resulted in more than $2. S. 7 billion of that amount being frozen.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the fbi blames the attack, which shook confidence in crypto market security, on members of the north korean military it refers to as "tradertraitor. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the doj said it was taking coordinated action against what it called the north korean government's "schemes to fund its regime through the massive theft of cryptocurrency. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that includes "the court-authorized seizure and restraint of more than $1. 2 billion worth of cryptocurrency recently stolen from Binance," it said.

DOJ units, law enforcement partners and virtual asset service providers have been working to intercept the stolen assets.

But efforts to track and freeze the assets are ongoing, as TraderTraitor actors continue to launder them through various cryptocurrency channels.

Authorities have also seized cloud-based infrastructure used in a massive identity impersonation scam known as "FaceStealer," which has seen more than $400 million worth of cryptocurrency stolen over 18 months, the DOJ said.

Berdasarkan laporan, the scheme sees hackers set up fake video meetings using stolen accounts and recordings of people known to the target by using ai-generated deepfakes. The hackers then say a technical problem requires a fix, install malware on a computer and take over the victim's communications, steal their cryptocurrency and target their contacts — sometimes months or more than a year after the initial compromise.

Individuals working in the cryptocurrency and web3 industries are prime targets.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, assistant director in charge patrick grandy, of the fbi's los angeles field office, called facestealer "a highly effective social engineering scheme capable of deceiving even the most experienced technical and security conscious computer user. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, "it exploits our trust in ubiquitous video conference platforms and valued personal relationships. If you can't imagine a scenario where you might fall prey to it, you are not thinking creatively enough," Grandy added.

Diungkapkan bahwa "north korea's government bankrolls its rogue regime and illicit weapons program through cryptocurrency theft," principal deputy assistant attorney general for national security m. Scott Proctor said in a statement.

Berdasarkan laporan, "america will fight back against that corrupt regime's effort to profit through cybercrime. The National Security Division will use every tool at its disposal to seize and return North Korea's ill-gotten gains. ".

He has that respect because Rivers has a wealth of football knowledge and experience from his days as a top-notch college and professional quarterback.

That knowledge will be invaluable to his players, and his ability to relate to them as a former player himself will also be a huge plus.

Then, there's the extra attention this will bring to NC State, which will now have a lot more eyes on it simply because Rivers is roaming the sideline.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, overall, the pros of hiring rivers far outweigh the negatives, so we're on board. But we won't know for sure just how good of a decision this is for at least a few years.

#763. The Mavericks are reaping the benefits of what Dusty May calls the trust factor

📅 13 Nov 2026

The Mavericks are reaping the benefits of what Dusty May calls the trust factor

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/mavericks-reaping-benefits-dusty-may-140000977.html

Sebagaimana diketahui, the winds of change. The transformation of the Dallas Mavericks from last year to this is astounding. Everyone watching can feel it – something major has changed. It's not just the leadership, a lot of staff and some of the roster. There's more to it.

It is, however, all those new people, and what they brought along with them, that started the winds of change.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the palpable energy shift. Even through the screen. The intangible vibe change and the excitement around the team, on the team, for the team. In the AAC, I bet it's even more evident.

Sebagaimana diketahui, everything has changed in dallas. How the basketball looks on the court, how the players move (most of the time when they don't revert back to bad habits), how they communicate, how the bench acts, even how the admin works and how the fans respond to it. But most importantly, how the coaches act, react and interact.

Dusty May has, along with his staff and new GM's Masai Ujiri and Mike Schmitz, brought a culture change to Dallas that everyone is talking about.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nov 9, 2026; dallas, texas, usa; dallas mavericks head coach dusty may talks with guard kyrie irving (11) during the second half against the indiana pacers at the american airlines center. Mandatory Credit: Jerome Miron-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect.

From what I see, it's a culture change founded on one of the most important aspects of leadership and sports: trust.

Berdasarkan laporan, the power of trust and all it entails and doesn't entail. It means trusting that the ball will come back to you if you move well off-ball, and it means trusting your teammates to score, as well. Building trust on a sports team means a higher rate of passing, which creates a more dynamic offense and easier scoring, which we see in the increased number of assists this season, among other things. That is healthy for a team as a whole, and wouldn't ya know – it helps create a winning mindset and a winning team.

Diungkapkan bahwa trust also means that you don't fear making mistakes as much, because you trust your coach and teammates won't punish you for it, and they trust you will make up for it (perhaps on defense). Being fearful of making mistakes is the number one killer of creativity and joy. And what happens when you don't have that? Last season happens.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and trust means that you know that your coach will make the right decisions for the team and yourself, you trust that they're not out to get you and you trust that you are liked on our team. On Dusty May's team, the players know he has their best interests at heart.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dusty may is a relationship-led or based coach. He coaches his players so well, because he knows them and they trust him. I wrote more about my early impression of his coaching recently in this piece.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dusty may has talked about trust a lot. Recently, he showed us how to talk a team up, and how he puts an emphasis on trust:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "what a problem, where you're in a pickle, where two guys like that (cooper flagg and kyrie irving) just got it going and you just gotta rotate between putting the ball in each other's hands and knowing that they're going to make the plays. So obviously, what a luxury for us. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "and once again, they both trust their teammates. They continue to trust and trust and trust, and then those reps and that experience, those guys handled it better… and that's a sign of the trust factor that Coop and Kyrie have with their teammates. When Houston put two on the ball and they were determined to take it out of their hands. ".

It's not a stretch to say that the Mavs have had more exciting and promising wins already than the entirety of last season, while the vibes have been all the way up to 2024 Finals run levels at times.

Diungkapkan bahwa oh, the 2024 playoffs energy, do you remember? the power of trust and the power of a winning culture is back in dallas. Back then, a lot of it was based on Luka Doncic and Kyrie Irving leading and establishing a culture, where everyone trusted them and each other. Now, Kyrie Irving being back has helped tremendously – and Dusty May, his coaching staff and the new leadership has done the rest, while the players came in with all the right intentions and energy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to put in perspective how well the dallas mavericks actually are looking when it comes to creating this culture needed for winning, let's take a look at what is happening on another nba team right now. The best in the world. NBA teams are all full of good players. So why do some collapse on themselves or crash and burn, despite often having stars, superstars and so-called good coaching?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in cleveland, we have an example of what happens when trust is lacking. Here, things are looking quite differently compared to Dallas. And it's not just about who has the best players. The opposite, actually.

Diungkapkan bahwa in this first example from a couple weeks ago, mario hezonja, an actual superstar from the euroleague, who's also a leader and very high-iq player, was open for a corner three, which would have been the best look in this possession. A great look actually, considering the fact that he's an elite threepoint shooter.

Berdasarkan laporan, donovan mitchell, however, the guy who's supposed to be the leader of this team, looks like he decides that it's his shot now, and cuts it off to take – or steal – the shot. Which he misses.

Diungkapkan bahwa do you see any trust here? i don't think so. It's obstruction. But this is worse than that. It's about your own ego over the team.

This is not just a show of bad vision and basketball IQ, it's also poor leadership and probably a way to try and dominate Hezonja in the hierarchy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, because what happened just a few days earlier exposed mitchell in a way he is clearly not used to. Whether this "steal" was retaliation for that, we will never know. So back to the play: he waves Mitchell away to punish a mismatch a few days before. To explain the background a little, Hezonja is accustomed to being the leader and superstar, it is something he has earned through the years. On top of that, he understands basketball at a high level, which becomes clear after this game. But it was not a good look for anyone.

Hezonja showed his intelligence and basketball knowledge with this and explained matter-of-factly afterward that Mitchell should not bring the ball up, a humble stance to take from a European superstar – who is also more direct (as we are wont to be).

Diungkapkan bahwa "i told him you're not supposed to bring the ball up under pressure. I spoke to James and Donovan, there's five of us on the court and you need to read those mismatch situations. I waived JT out to go 1-on-1 against my mismatch. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this completely exposed the lack of awareness on this team, however. And it may explain some animosity. A winning mindset on a team with no trust can be disruptive. But by media and especially fans in the comments, though, it was widely heralded as something that needed to be done to address the issues on that team. But sometimes that's what's needed.

Sebagaimana diketahui, back to dallas, where we see a stark contrast in play style. Good energy and vibes bring trust (and the other way around), and that translates to better looks and eventually – winning basketball.

"There's a lot of trust there knowing, if I give it up to you, you're going to give it back," Devin Harris of the Mavs broadcast crew said in this clip, hitting the nail on the head.

Berdasarkan laporan, and it was this possession in particular that had me excited about what the mavs can do this season. Ya, there are superstars and they can all iso and score at turn. But can they play together? Can they trust each other to make the right read?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when a team trusts each other, special things start happening. That's where the magic shows up. We know what it looks like, and we know what it feels like, because we saw it in the 2024 Finals run. The Dallas Mavericks had something special brewing then, something that made them better as a whole than their individual parts.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that feeling seems to slowly return to dallas these days. And maybe that's what happened in Dallas last season. Sometimes we need a reminder of what not to do, before we realize what to do instead. The struggles of Mario Hezonja and the Cleveland Cavaliers as a contrast is a great reminder of how well things are going.

Berdasarkan laporan, the winds of change. Trust in Dallas is back.

#778. Buccaneers have more rushing yards than passing yards, a rare feat in today's NFL

📅 13 Nov 2026

Buccaneers have more rushing yards than passing yards, a rare feat in today's NFL

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.nbcsports.com/nfl/profootballtalk/rumor-mill/news/buccaneers-have-more-rushing-yards-than-passing-yards-a-rare-feat-in-todays-nfl

With the 2026 NFL season at the midway point, one of the bigger statistical oddities belongs to the Buccaneers, who are the only team in the league with more rushing yards than passing yards.

Sebagaimana diketahui, through nine games, the buccaneers have 1,475 rushing yards and 1,277 passing yards. Every other team has gained more yardage passing than running, and no other team is even close to having more rushing than passing yards.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the last time an nfl team finished a season with more rushing yards than passing yards was 2022, when the bears finished with an nfl-high 3,014 rushing yards and an nfl-low 2,219 passing yards. That Bears team was led by Justin Fields, who rushed for 1,143 yards himself, but netted just 1,883 passing yards. With running back David Montgomery chipping in 801 rushing yards and Khalil Herbert gaining 731, the Bears were a team that could run effectively but couldn’t pass for anything.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the buccaneers’ yardage totals come from some fairly unique circumstances. That has led the Bucs to rely more on their running game. Baker Mayfield has played some of the worst football of his career when healthy, and he was also injured and missed three games, replaced by undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels. And the weather contributed a huge portion of the Buccaneers’ run-pass yardage differential in Week 8, when the Bucs gained 322 yards rushing and minus-2 yards passing in a downpour against the Falcons.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, despite their one-dimensional offense, the buccaneers are still playoff contenders, thanks to the nfc south’s status as the worst division in football. It won’t be surprising if there’s a playoff game in Tampa in January. If that happens, Bucs fans may be praying for another downpour.

#784. Women are taking pay cuts and 'white-knuckling it' to manage menopause and work: 'I feel like I'm sitting on the sidelines'

📅 13 Nov 2026

Women are taking pay cuts and 'white-knuckling it' to manage menopause and work: 'I feel like I'm sitting on the sidelines'

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/make-it/2026/11/13/menopause-career-setbacks.html

Around 2020, Amy Terry noticed she didn't feel like her usual self.

Diungkapkan bahwa the 50-year-old michigander was working as a director of programming at a health association when she says she began experiencing symptoms like memory loss, low energy, mental processing difficulties — or, as she describes it, "waking up every day feeling like you were slogging through mud. ".

"I went from being this highly competent professional person to barely being able to get through phone calls," Terry says.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as the healthcare system strained under the weight of the covid-19 pandemic, terry, like many other people, struggled to get care. When she finally did, she found out it wasn't Covid-19. It was perimenopause.

Sebagaimana diketahui, terry got through a few more years juggling her symptoms with her job, but by 2023, she couldn't hold out any longer. She quit to start independent consulting.

Berdasarkan laporan, women, and some trans and non-binary people, often experience career setbacks stemming from menopause that can hurt them financially and professionally. Four in 10 women who have experienced menopause or perimenopause say it has negatively affected their life or work, according to a recent survey of over 3,800 U. S. women from Gallup and Melinda French Gates' Pivotal, a group of organizations focused on social progress for women and young people.

Of them, roughly 28% felt limited in the effort they could give at work, 15% decided against pursuing a promotion or leadership role, 12% reduced their hours, and 10% took an extended leave from work or didn't return.

Diungkapkan bahwa "this isn't just a health issue," says jasmine escalera, career expert at resume builder site livecareer. "It's a workplace issue. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a 2023 mayo clinic study estimated menopause symptoms drove $1. S. 8 billion in lost work time per year in the U. alone.

Diungkapkan bahwa perimenopause, the transitional period before menopause, typically begins in one's 40s and can last several years, often bringing symptoms like hot flashes, sleep issues, irritability and lower energy, according to the office on women's health. Menopause typically occurs in one's 50s and marks 12 months since a person's last period, but is often used colloquially to include the preceding perimenopause as well.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the timing of menopause can create a perfect storm. It frequently comes at a time in many women's careers when they're breaking into leadership or approaching their peak earning years, which is often between the ages of 35 and 44 for women, according to data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics. It also typically happens when many are caregiving for aging parents or raising children. This can make for an impossible choice for many women.

Berdasarkan laporan, "women have fought so hard for their place in the workforce," says mimi wied, who began perimenopause around a decade ago. "They don't want to lose it by looking like they can't handle it. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the career consequences for women "may increase the gaps we're trying to decrease," escalera says, referring to disparities such as those in women's pay and senior-level representation relative to men. "That is a definite talent breakdown. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for terry, becoming an independent consultant cost her employer-sponsored healthcare at the time she most needed it. It also drastically changed her income: She says she took around an 85% pay cut in the transition.

Diungkapkan bahwa "these are supposed to be my highest-earning years," terry says, "and i feel like i'm sitting on the sidelines. ".

Many women are unprepared for menopause because of social stigma around discussing it, poor health education and dismissal of women's health issues.

"I've been in the healthcare environment for 30 years; if I can't figure this out, I don't know how anyone can," says Terry.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, wied also says she didn't know what to expect. The answer quickly became apparent: The 48-year-old from Brenham, Texas, says she experienced everything from night sweats and sleeplessness to anxiety and rage.

"Sometimes I didn't feel in control of my own mouth and my body and my actions," she says.

Diungkapkan bahwa wied left her job as a museum docent for a secretarial role paying roughly $20,000 less when she worried her irritability would affect her capacity to help visitors, she says: "if i could have quit working, i would have. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, when women do scale back at work because of menopause, they may struggle to regain that professional ground later. Terry's job switch wasn't just downshifting to a part-time role: "It's an entire change in the trajectory of your career," she says.

Factors like ageism in the job search for those of menopausal age, as well as the high cost of healthcare, particularly for common menopause treatments like hormone replacement therapy, may keep some women silently struggling through their symptoms at work.

Sebagaimana diketahui, erin levin is currently working through perimenopause. As a high school English teacher, the 41-year-old from San Jose, California, needs to stay on her A-game because "there is no down moment in teaching," she says.

Diungkapkan bahwa but since starting perimenopause around two years ago, she's experienced brain fog, difficulty sleeping, and heightened anxiety and stress that make her work difficult sometimes, she says. She sometimes struggles with tasks that "were not an issue" for her a few years ago.

"Now I'm just like, God, why does it just feel so exhausting all the time?" Levin says.

Berdasarkan laporan, her parents help with childcare some evenings, and she tries not to schedule big tasks first thing in the morning, but it's been an adjustment. Scaling back at work isn't an option financially, she says, as a single mother sharing custody of her child.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i still have to maintain the same appearance of having all the same skills and energy level as other people who aren't in my medical position," levin says. "I just have to white-knuckle it. ".

Some women see hope in coming legislation and employer benefits offerings.

Diungkapkan bahwa last year, rhode island became the first state to enact workplace protections for women experiencing menopause. In September, Sens. , held the first congressional hearing devoted to menopause. , and Rick Scott, R-Fla. Y. Kirsten Gillibrand, D-N. Illinois and the city of Philadelphia have also adopted legislation taking effect in 2027 providing accommodations and protections for those in menopause.

In September, a nongovernmental organization, the International Organization for Standardization, published the first standard for developing workplace policies and practices supporting people through menstruation and menopause.

Many organizations have a ways to go in providing menopause-related benefits for their employees.

Diungkapkan bahwa in a 2026 study from the society for women's health research and workplace menopause research organization the fuchsia tent, fielded among 1,100 people, around one-third of decision-makers said menopause support is currently in place or actively planned in their workplace. Fewer than 10% of employees said their organization offers menopause-specific support.

Respondents said some broader benefits, like flexible scheduling, remote options, and confidential telehealth or virtual care, would also be helpful for menopause.

Terry, Wied and Levin said they had to meet with multiple doctors before finding one who'd take their concerns seriously and who'd prescribe them hormone replacement therapy.

Berdasarkan laporan, levin and wied each have a daughter. They hope better support and women's healthcare are available for their daughters when they begin menopause.

"I'm hoping that by the time my daughter goes through this, we'll have a lot more information, a lot more resources, because as it stands, it makes you super angry," Wied says.

Berdasarkan laporan, "it's a cost on my energy, it's a cost on my stress levels, it's a cost on my bank account," levin adds. "I don't want my daughter to have to face any of that. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, as for terry, she says she was part of a study examining potential mental health impacts of hormonal fluctuations in perimenopausal women; she hopes the research can help future generations of women. Meanwhile, her switch to independent consulting has offered her greater flexibility and a more manageable workload. But it's not perfect.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i'm worried about retirement, i'm worried about having enough money, i'm worried about being able to continue healthcare," she says. "But I also feel like I have to take the time to feel like I'm on solid ground again. ".

#786. One fatal flaw of every Super Bowl contender from 49ers depth to Packers run game

📅 13 Nov 2026

One fatal flaw of every Super Bowl contender from 49ers depth to Packers run game

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/fatal-flaw-super-bowl-contenders-49ers-bears-packers/

If not listed, please contact your TV provider.

Diungkapkan bahwa normally, when i write, i deal in optimism. Giving fans a reason for hope, something to look forward to when their favorite team takes the field.

Berdasarkan laporan, the nfl trade deadline has come and gone, and while most teams have improved their chances at winning a super bowl, i'm here to pour a little bit of cold water on the excitement. No team is perfect, especially this year, when it feels like there's much more parity across the board. While there are obvious Super Bowl contenders, even those teams have flaws that could stop them from hoisting the Lombardi Trophy come February. Let's break down the fatal flaw of every contender at midseason, and if it comes true, then you can blame me.

*Contenders chosen using DraftKings Sportsbook midseason Super Bowl odds.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i'm convinced the 49ers are living their own separate version of the movie "groundhog day. " Every year they come in as legitimate contenders, then it all unravels because of injury. Well, this year is no different, with their depth already being tested.

Sebagaimana diketahui, on the defensive side of the ball, standout rookie dt gracen halton is going to miss the rest of the season with a broken ankle, and cbs deommodore lenoir and renardo green are both nursing foot injuries (but those are more day-to-day, according to kyle shanahan). They've gotten by with playing WRs Jordan Watkins, Brandin Cooks and Demarcus Robinson , but that's not a Super Bowl-winning trio. Offensively, WR Mike Evans hasn't played since week 6, and WR Deebo Samuel hasn't played since week 5. However, they did recently trade for Keenan Allen.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the spin zone here is that the cavalry is coming for reinforcements. Adding DT DeForest Buckner before the trade deadline was a huge move for the defensive line, helping them get more pressure without blitzing (the 49ers are 30th in the NFL in blitz rate and 20th in sack rate without blitzing). I've been a fan of what DC Raheem Morris has been able to get out of this defense, playing to the speed at the second and third level, and adding Buckner to that group should let the secondary play even faster (losing Halton sucks, though).

Sebagaimana diketahui, the more worrisome part is evans, who is still more than likely not going to play against dallas next week. Achilles tendinitis is scary, especially at Evans' age. He was such a critical part of why the Niners offense was back to the face-melting unit they've been in previous years, and if he can't go for the long haul, I worry about how this team can win the Super Bowl.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, despite adding safety amani hooker at the trade deadline, i still think the bills' pass defense overall is the weakest part of the unit. As long as they don't get to play Carson Wentz every week, the Bills' pass defense is going to be what holds them back.

Berdasarkan laporan, the bills' defensive line has been a revelation this season; with the growth of edge greg rousseau and dt deone walker, the bills are eighth in the nfl in pressure rate. 9% havoc rate when recording a pressure. According to TruMedia, when they get pressure, they have a 69. When they don't get pressure, their defensive success rate drops to 45. However, their splits when they're under pressure versus when they're not are staggering. 31 defensive EPA per dropback, and that havoc rate? Yeah, it drops to 11. 15 defensive EPA/dropback. 5% defensive success rate and 0. 4%. 5% (only above the Raiders), -0. Combine all plays where they force a PBU, INT, TFL and sack together when they get pressure, and you get a 21. Not a great look for their coverage unit.

Diungkapkan bahwa the biggest problem is that they give up explosive plays, and while some of that should be ironed out by adding hooker, i worry that dc jim leonhard just doesn't have the guys to prevent explosive plays in the middle of the field. If you just whittle it down to passing attempts between the hashmarks in the middle of the field, they've given up the second most completions of 20 or more yards in that area in the NFL. If they can't limit big plays, I worry about how much will be on the offense to keep cleaning up the defense's mistakes.

Berdasarkan laporan, the jacksonville jaguars have arrived. After starting the season 6-2, the Jaguars made a massive splash at the trade deadline, acquiring S Jessie Bates and DT Jordan Davis to shore up two of their bigger issues on the defensive line. However, if this team falls before winning a Super Bowl, it'll be because of their pass protection.

Berdasarkan laporan, on the surface, the jaguars' offensive line looks good. They're tied for the fifth-lowest sacks allowed this season and eighth-lowest pressure rate allowed. On top of that, the Jaguars' ability to grind games down by running the football has been evident this season. However, digging into those numbers and watching the Jaguars play tells a different story.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the passing game, trevor lawrence has been incredible this season at mitigating pressure and getting the ball out (a major part of his mvp case). 40, 6th in the NFL). 68 (their yards after contact per carry are 3. Then, in the run game, the Jaguars are only above the Raiders in average yards before contact per carry, at 0. The offensive line has been overwhelmed by interior pressure, with rookie LG Emmanuel Pregnon and RG Ezra Cleveland up and down in pass protection. Starting LT Anton Harrison has been lost for the season, and while Walker Little has performed admirably in his absence, it'll always be a worry for the Jaguars.

Berdasarkan laporan, lawrence has, like i said, been amazing at mitigating pressure and making plays around it. But in order to get out of the AFC, they'll have to face guys like Zach Allen, Dexter Lawrence, Cameron Heyward and more. If this team doesn't get to the Super Bowl, it'll be because the offensive line fell apart.

Diungkapkan bahwa the bears and the jaguars back-to-back in super bowl contender stories — what a beautiful world we live in. The Bears look like one of the most complete teams in the NFL, with an offense that can score at will or grind teams into dust. To complement that offense, the Bears added a nitro boost to the defense by trading for DT Jeffrey Simmons, and that trade already looks like it paid off. However, if this team doesn't win the whole thing this year, it'll be because of a secondary that has been…volatile to say the least.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this isn't to say the bears' secondary isn't talented. Kyler Gordon is an awesome nickel, and I've been impressed with the play of rookie Malik Muhammad on the outside. I was of the belief that the Bears should've added another corner at the deadline to just give them some more insurance, but by not adding anyone, it shows a lot of belief in that group. However, Muhammad has missed the last two games with a toe injury, leaving the Bears thin in the secondary. The mainstay of the group, CB Jaylon Johnson, has been inconsistent this season as well. I wouldn't believe in that group as much, and if they don't win it all, it'll be because the secondary fell apart.

Berdasarkan laporan, i never thought i'd say this about a patrick mahomes-led unit, but the chiefs' passing game isn't very explosive. Kansas City is only 21st in the NFL in completions of 20 or more yards this season, despite having a high rate of explosive passes. 4% of Patrick Mahomes' passing attempts this season are between 11 and 20 air yards, and only 8. That is probably because only 14. 4% are over 20 air yards, both near the bottom of the NFL.

Berdasarkan laporan, without wr tyquan thornton on the field, there's nobody who can win on passes downfield. Xavier Worthy leads the team in targets in that metric, but he only has two catches at that range. Among all the Chiefs receivers this season, Thornton still leads the team in receptions of at least 16 or more air yards, despite going down in Week 4. Not being able to hit any explosives makes the offense so much more congested, leaving the run game too little space to breathe and allowing opposing defenses to squat on all the crossing routes Kansas City likes to run.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the chiefs did add a receiver at the deadline, trading for indy's josh downs. But this team is still missing that third gear downfield. Where Downs will help is in creating separation against man coverage and loosening up the offense in the intermediate game so Rice can be the over-the-top and YAC guy. Worthy hasn't been consistent and is now out with a hamstring injury, so adding someone with size and speed in free agency could be key (Darius Slayton could be fun).

Berdasarkan laporan, maybe the hope is that the run game provides the explosives, which is definitely possible. But if the Chiefs fail to win the Super Bowl for the third straight year, it'll be because they can't create any explosive passes.

Berdasarkan laporan, this bengals team feels like a warm hug, a truly vintage burrow-era bengals unit. One of the most face-melting offenses the NFL has seen (doing it without even wanting to run the ball or getting under center), and a field-tilting defensive lineman who can absolutely take over. However, if this team isn't raising the Lombardi at the end of the season, it'll be because of some real shoddy linebacker play.

Diungkapkan bahwa the trio of barrett carter, demetrius knight jr and oren burks doesn't exactly inspire confidence, especially when it comes to pass coverage. All three guys are better at flowing fast downhill and creating negative plays in the run game, but their eyes can be manipulated in coverage. The Bengals are tied for the fifth-most plays of over 20 yards allowed on play action in the NFL this season, and in both of their losses, the Bengals linebackers have been poor in coverage. Because they are fitting the run so aggressively, they leave themselves susceptible to explosives in the middle of the field off play action, which is where every team is trying to hunt in the NFL.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you look at all the teams in the afc, they're all incredible at manipulating linebackers via play action and getting wires crossed. For the Bengals to beat teams like Buffalo, Jacksonville, Kansas City and Pittsburgh, their linebacker play needs to improve in pass coverage. I'm a little surprised they didn't try to add to the linebacker room at the trade deadline, but given how their first trade went down, it makes sense they bowed out after that. Either way, their linebacker play hasn't been up to par this season, and it could be their downfall.

Berdasarkan laporan, if i had a nickel for every time an nfl "superteam" was unraveled by injury and poor play, i'd have two nickels. That's not a lot, but the fact that it happened twice is relevant. The Rams have gone from being everyone's Super Bowl favorite to being on the brink of missing the playoffs entirely, a cataclysmic drop that will have many people asking what happened.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, aside from the obvious caveat that everyone important on the team has been hurt at some point this season, i think the biggest reason this team hasn't been the same unit is that they can't hit explosive passes. 9% explosive pass rate last season, good for sixth in the NFL. Take this as a comparison: According to TruMedia, the Rams had a 15. In 2026, that number has dropped to 10. 8%, below teams like the Miami Dolphins and Pittsburgh Steelers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, now, part of that has legitimately been due to injuries to players like wr davante adams, te terrance ferguson and now wr puka nacua, but matthew stafford just hasn't been accurate outside the numbers this season. A large part of their explosive offense last year was Stafford catching fire on those passes, drilling corners and out routes to stop defenses from congesting the middle of the field.

Berdasarkan laporan, overall, trumedia has stafford's off-target rate jumping up three percentage points this season, but when you specify passes on the sideline or outside the numbers, his off-target rate has jumped from 15% in 2025 to 28. 6% this season. If he can't drill those passes, the offense becomes much more difficult. If the Rams want to make the playoffs, they need to get healthy. That's an alarming uptick in inaccuracy, one that is telling for an older QB like Stafford. If they want to win a Super Bowl, Stafford has to hit those passes more often.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as it currently stands, the broncos have a 37. 2%. 1% passing success rate, 28th in the NFL. Since 2010, the worst passing offense to win a Super Bowl by that metric is the 2015 Denver Broncos…who were at 42. It would be historically unprecedented for a team with as bad a passing offense as the Broncos to win the Super Bowl, and it's by far the Broncos' biggest flaw.

Berdasarkan laporan, now, i will add that every year the broncos' passing game starts off slow and then picks up by the time the playoffs roll around, and so far this season that's proven to be the case. However, I still think the passing offense is far too inconsistent for me to trust them in close game scenarios.

Berdasarkan laporan, for the broncos to win the super bowl, nix has to consistently hit the designed passes in the middle of the field. He's done a better job of that recently than in previous weeks, but against healthy secondaries I worry that the offense will turtle back on itself and not allow Sean Payton's well-designed offense to click. Everything is in position for this offense to once again hit their late-season surge, but if they want to win a Super Bowl, the passing game needs to start clicking.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, everyone is wondering what's wrong with the seahawks' offense this season. Is it a decline from QB Sam Darnold? OC Brian Fleury doesn't pull the same levers as Klint Kubiak did? Is it just general regression? In a way, all of these are correct, but the root of the problem is that they aren't an explosive running team this season.

Berdasarkan laporan, last year, while the seahawks' run game wasn't "great" (-0. 5% rushing success rate on all designed runs), they had a 7. Even last season when the Seahawks' run game wasn't exactly the most efficient, you could count on at least a few explosive runs from their offense to keep the thought in defenses' heads and make the game easier on Darnold. 5% rushing success rate and a 6. 20 EPA per carry, 33. 3% explosive rushing rate. 04 EPA per carry, 39. 2% explosive rushing rate. This season, the Seahawks' run game has fallen off a cliff, putting up a putrid -0. Without any explosive runs AND being inefficient, the Seahawks consistently put themselves behind the sticks and in obvious passing situations, where Darnold doesn't thrive.

Diungkapkan bahwa there is a solution to this problem: quenton nelson. The Seahawks traded for the LG before the deadline, and he looked as advertised before going down with an injury. Once he and LT Charles Cross get back, the run game could improve. But if the Seahawks fail to repeat, you can blame the lack of explosive runs.

Diungkapkan bahwa remember earlier when i said the bills have a problem preventing explosive plays? ditto for the lions, who have been hit by the injury bug once again. Despite getting S Brian Branch back, the secondary still has issues with defending the pass.

Berdasarkan laporan, per sumer sports, the lions are 22nd in the nfl in passing success rate allowed and 28th in epa/pass allowed. The biggest issue has come when they play man coverage, leaving their cornerbacks on islands. CB DJ Reed has made the occasional big play, but CB Rock Ya-Sin has been targeted often, as has Roger McCreary. The back-end coverage play has undone what has been a very good season for their defensive front, preventing them from getting home and making plays.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the lions' offense is super bowl caliber, and i think their defensive line can play up to that level as well. But the depth on this team continues to be tested, and now without LB Jack Campbell and S Kerby Joseph, getting by in the secondary will just have to do.

Diungkapkan bahwa i'm not joking when i say the packers' rushing offense is one of the worst units in football this year. Through nine games, the only three teams worse than Green Bay on the ground based on rushing success rate are the Miami Dolphins, Las Vegas Raiders and Cleveland Browns (per TruMedia). If we use EPA per rush, the Packers are dead last.

Sebagaimana diketahui, now there are multiple symptoms for this, and they're all bad. The offensive line can't get enough push to run the gap scheme runs the Packers want to get into (29th in yards before contact per carry), and the Packers' RBs have also given the team next to nothing when it comes to making people miss. As a team, the Packers are 30th in yards after contact per carry and 27th in percentage of tackles avoided.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the offensive line has been unsettled since losing rt zach bako-bewele to injury, and because they haven't had a chance to find their best five, the run game has been awful. Combine that with the running back room not having any form of juice, and you get needing WR Savion Williams to be your best threat running the football.

Diungkapkan bahwa with qb jordan love and the defense playing as well as they are right now, it should be easy to call the packers a super bowl team. But if they don't make it there, it'll be because they can't run the football and make it easier on themselves.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, since 2000, there have been 379 teams with winning records through nine games. The 2026 Minnesota Vikings rank 379th in offensive success rate.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, we could end this right there, but let's dig into why every time the vikings offense takes the field, it feels like a win for the other team. First of all, the accuracy of any QB under center has been erratic. The Minnesota offense doesn't have a lot of built-in easy buttons for throwing the football; much of it is about attacking vertically and pushing the ball to hunt explosives. This season, among QBs with at least 50 dropbacks, both Kyler Murray and Carson Wentz are in the top 10 in off-target rate per TruMedia. So when these plays are missing, you dig yourself into a lot of second/third and longs.

Sebagaimana diketahui, you can offset this by using your run game, always staying ahead of the sticks and freeing your qb to take downfield shots because you know you can get 4-5 yards on the ground. Well, the Vikings sit at 29th in rushing success rate and average the second-lowest yards after contact per carry in the NFL. So if you're not accurate and you can't run the ball either, you get an easy recipe for one of the worst offenses the NFL has ever seen (no exaggeration!).

Sebagaimana diketahui, here are the worst nfl offenses since 2010 based on offensive success rate in general, through weeks 1-9. twitter. The Minnesota Vikings are 6-2 https://t. co/DBiFNooUNh pic. com/Uugm9L7VnR.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the vikings traded for qb kirk cousins on tuesday, and while i think he'll definitely help by throwing fewer inaccurate passes, i do wonder if he is enough to get this team over the hump. Cousins isn't a spring chicken and has already thrown a lot of passes this season, so his arm might just be shot at this point. If the Vikings can't get a run game going, Cousins might not matter at all.

Berdasarkan laporan, it's unfortunate that wrs aj brown and romeo doubs went down with multiple injuries this season, because if any team has needed both of them, it's the new england patriots. After seemingly finding their groove, the music fell to a screeching halt against Green Bay. Drake Maye had another game of multiple interceptions, and the Patriots lost by 30 points.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, their receiver group has been subpar to this point in the season, leaning on mack hollins and pop douglas once again. Because there are no easy buttons in this offense, it's all on Maye to keep the offense afloat, and that hasn't gone well this season. They were never going to be in the receiver market this trade deadline, but I wouldn't be surprised if they made a move in free agency, just to give Maye some more help.

Diungkapkan bahwa i'm sometimes confused by the steelers' offense. They're at their best when they play through the offensive line, RBs Jaylen Warren and Rico Dowdle, and the mammoths they have at tight end. This doesn't work because the Steelers lack separation on offense, especially at receiver. WR DK Metcalf has been wildly inconsistent this season, mixing in explosive receptions and great blocking with the most baffling drops you've ever seen. But then they try to spread teams out and shred them that way. WR Michael Pittman Jr. has been on IR since October, and even when he comes back, you don't expect him to be a separator in the offense.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nobody in the steelers' receiving room is a big enough threat against man coverage to be a problem, and it shrinks the rolodex of options the offense can get to in third down or obvious passing situations. Swinging and missing on a receiver at the deadline is brutal, and if they don't win a Super Bowl this year, the skill position group will be why.

#794. If You'd Invested $1,000 in ExxonMobil 1 Year Ago, Here's How Much You'd Have Today

📅 13 Nov 2026

If You'd Invested $1,000 in ExxonMobil 1 Year Ago, Here's How Much You'd Have Today

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/11/13/if-invested-1000-exxonmobil-year-ago-how-much-have-today-xom/?source=iedfolrf0000001

Oil prices helped lift ExxonMobil's earnings, but there's more to its growth story than expensive crude.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, since the start of the year, the conflict in iran has disrupted oil and gas markets, created supply bottlenecks, and driven oil prices higher. These disruptions have been a tailwind for oil and gas producers.

Diungkapkan bahwa as a result, if you had invested $1,000 in exxonmobil (xom +0. 11%) stock one year ago, that investment would be worth $1,432 today.

This year has been volatile for the oil and gas industry, as the Iran conflict has disrupted the Straight of Hormuz, through which over 20 million barrels per day of crude oil, condensate, and refined petroleum products pass.

Diungkapkan bahwa for exxonmobil, the disruptions have been a boon. Brent crude oil has traded as high as $120 per barrel and has stayed above $70 per barrel since the conflict began.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this has driven strong upstream growth, but an even bigger driver is downstream refined fuels, where margins (crack spreads) have surged. For ExxonMobil, the world's largest non-state-owned refiner, this translates into significant downstream profits.

Diungkapkan bahwa through sept. 8 billion, driven by higher crude oil prices. 30, Exxon's upstream earnings jumped 16% to $20. Meanwhile, its downstream energy products earnings have surged 181% to $11. 4 billion, driven by strong refining margins.

Sebagaimana diketahui, exxonmobil has taken steps over the past several years to invest in cost-efficient, "advantaged assets" that help drive down the cost per barrel for oil. By focusing on these highly profitable assets, the company aims to lower its breakeven cost per barrel to $35 by 2027 and $30 by 2030, so even if oil prices retreat from their current highs, Exxon can keep profiting.

All that suggests this is a stock worth a closer look for potential addition to your portfolio.

#805. Feeling Is The Human Superpower AI May Never Learn

📅 13 Nov 2026

Feeling Is The Human Superpower AI May Never Learn

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.forbes.com/councils/forbestechcouncil/2026/11/13/feeling-is-the-human-superpower-ai-may-never-learn/

Regan Peng is an AI founder and former senior tech executive, focused on personal AI, privacy-preserving systems, and edge AI.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ​imagine an old voicemail from someone you have lost. You know every word. You listen anyway.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, an ai might eventually explain every mechanism behind that attachment. It could recognize the voice, reconstruct the relationship and predict your response. None of that would, by itself, establish that it knows what it is to miss someone.

Berdasarkan laporan, humans are feeling machines that can think. AIs are thinking machines that try to feel.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the second half describes an engineering aspiration, not an established inner life. Intelligence and subjective experience are not interchangeable concepts.

Diungkapkan bahwa my argument is that feeling is our deepest power: the capacity for existence to matter to us. It should never become something we apologize for as machines grow more capable.

Berdasarkan laporan, the human half of that contrast owes a debt to neuroscientist antonio damasio. His account locates feelings in the relationship between the nervous system and the body it helps regulate. Hunger, pain, comfort and attachment belong to a biological history shaped by evolution. They sustain life, rather than merely decorating our thoughts.

Diungkapkan bahwa millions of years stand behind this inheritance. Yet it takes on a particular history in each of us: This place becomes home; this person becomes irreplaceable. I see feeling as one of evolution’s most extraordinary achievements—life becoming significant to itself.

Diungkapkan bahwa a recent philosophical account of consciousness develops a related argument: experience may depend on being a subject for whom things can genuinely go well or badly. On this view, processing information is insufficient without the internal organization that makes outcomes matter to the system itself.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this changes how we might regard our evolutionary origins. Explaining love through the history of survival and reproduction does not establish that love is merely a reproductive strategy. An account of where something comes from cannot, on its own, decide what it is worth.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nor does calling feeling a superpower mean our feelings are always right. Reason helps us examine both. Fear can imprison us; affection can distort judgment. The argument is against confusing freedom from error with freedom from caring.

Diungkapkan bahwa in a september 2026 paper, geoffrey hinton and his coauthors examine how automating ai research could create an accelerating cycle: capable systems help build still more capable successors. An intelligence explosion is a possibility they take seriously, not an established outcome.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, even if it happens, the question of feeling survives. Greater ability to explain the world does not, by itself, establish that a machine experiences being in it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, physical ai sharpens the distinction. Robotic touch sensors can register pressure and heat. Whether holding someone’s hand brings comfort is another question.

Diungkapkan bahwa some researchers argue that consciousness may depend on properties of living systems, rather than computation alone. Others allow that artificial systems could acquire the organization and relationships needed for experience. The issue remains unsettled.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ai may never learn to feel simply by becoming better at thinking. We should take that possibility seriously instead of assuming that an inner life arrives automatically with sufficient scale.

Berdasarkan laporan, and should machines eventually feel, our feelings would not become obsolete. Another being’s capacity to love does not diminish yours. Human worth should never have depended on possessing a capability nobody else could acquire.

Diungkapkan bahwa perhaps feeling is a kind of password to an interior dimension of existence. I mean this as a philosophical image, not a claim about hidden physics: Through feeling, the universe becomes something we inhabit intimately.

Diungkapkan bahwa we need not invoke another world to recognize how extraordinary that is. Within this one, we can be moved by a voice, overwhelmed by beauty or changed by someone else’s suffering.

Berdasarkan laporan, consider time. An hour waiting for someone carries something a clock cannot record: hope that they will arrive. Perhaps part of our wish for immortality comes from wanting that encounter with existence to continue. We still want to feel more.

For those of us building AI, this changes what progress should mean.

Berdasarkan laporan, a tool that saves an hour and immediately fills it with more work has not necessarily enriched a life. An assistant that recognizes loneliness should help strengthen a person’s relationships, not make the product harder to leave. Emotional understanding should serve the person who feels, rather than make that person easier to influence.

The point of building more capable machines should be to give people more room to live.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that asks something of us, too. We should resist using intelligence to insulate ourselves from every uncertainty. Preventable danger deserves safeguards. But a relationship whose future is unwritten, an unfamiliar idea or a discovery that unsettles us is not merely a prediction problem waiting to be solved.

Diungkapkan bahwa curiosity means remaining available to what we have not yet experienced. We can welcome a universe that becomes more intelligible without demanding that it stop surprising us.

Sebagaimana diketahui, perhaps this is what each generation can leave the next: better ways to understand the world, and more freedom to encounter it. Future artificial minds may join that inheritance. They need not become the standard against which every human life is judged.

We do not have to remain the most intelligent beings imaginable for our lives to matter.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the voicemail is not precious because we cannot explain it. It is precious because we still want to hear the person’s voice.

#806. CFTC Chair Selig tells CNBC crypto industry is embracing agency rules as legislation hopes fade

📅 13 Nov 2026

CFTC Chair Selig tells CNBC crypto industry is embracing agency rules as legislation hopes fade

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/cftc-chair-selig-crypto-industry-opting-into-agencys-crypto-rules-.html

The Commodity Futures Trading Commission is already seeing demand from crypto exchanges planning to opt in to its newly proposed rules governing digital assets, according to Chairman Michael Selig.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the commodities regulator in october proposed rules aimed at preventing abuse in crypto markets and codifying crypto transaction rules under a federal rulebook. In the announcement, Selig said the move was a "critical step" in ensuring the United States remains the crypto capital of the world.

Speaking this week at Cantor Convergence, an annual FinTech conference held in Miami Beach, Selig told CNBC in an exclusive interview that many of the major crypto exchanges are already registered with the CFTC because they offer financial derivatives, including perpetual futures, on their platforms and would now be able to add spot trading.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we're also getting interest from new entrants who say, 'look, signing up with 50 different state regimes is tough. We'd rather come to one regulator and get a license at the CFTC' so those new entrants are lining up to come register with us as well," he added.

After the Clarity Act, a comprehensive market structure bill that established a regulatory framework for digital assets, stalled in the Senate in September, the CFTC and the SEC moved to establish federal frameworks using their existing statutory authorities.

"We need to protect our markets and protect our customers using those markets so we'll continue to do exactly that in the wake of the Clarity Act failing to get the votes it needed to get to the president's desk during the current Congress," Selig said.

"Our statute does provide for authority of the agencies to register exchanges that want to offer margined, leveraged, or financed crypto assets or other types of commodity trading so we're utilizing that authority to allow our existing exchanges to begin offering these products under a regulated framework," he said.

Selig added that the oversight is opt-in for exchanges that are not currently offering margin leveraged financing, which is not permitted under existing state regimes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but the cftc's new rules could face new scrutiny and oversight in 2027, with democrats set to take control of the house and senate after the midterms. Selig told CNBC he hopes the U. S. won't see a wave of software developers moving offshore, as many crypto businesses threatened to do under the Biden administration.

"I really hope that we learned lessons from the last several years in this space," he said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, crypto firms were at odds with washington during the biden administration, asking for clear operating rules, while also facing lawsuits brought by the sec under former chair gary gensler's leadership. That shifted after President Donald Trump's 2024 victory.

"I do hope that we can work together with both sides of the aisle to protect software developers who want to do the right thing," Selig said, adding that those looking to commit crimes and engage in fraud should be held accountable.

Berdasarkan laporan, when asked whether he's prepared for increased scrutiny from congress in 2027, selig said, "congress will do its job investigating where it needs to investigate. ".

"I'm happy to answer any questions that Congress has for me just as I would answer Congress' questions today as I've done before hearing committees several times already," he said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, selig has also faced heat from democrats for his handling of prediction markets. In February, 23 Democratic senators sent a letter to Chairman Selig urging him to reverse the agency's greenlighting of prediction markets.

Berdasarkan laporan, selig has argued that prediction platforms are federally regulated as more states try to rein them in. The CFTC has sued several states to defend what the agency views as its exclusive jurisdiction to regulate event contracts, which it classifies as swaps.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we're going to fight this up to the supreme court if that's where it's going," selig said. "Our view on the statute is that we have exclusive jurisdiction over these markets, and I will not allow for states to go bring lawsuits against our exchanges, claiming that they're unlicensed gambling. ".

CNBC's Tanaya Macheel contributed to this report.
