#851. How To Make The Shift From Tech Executive To Board Director

📅 13 Nov 2026

How To Make The Shift From Tech Executive To Board Director

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.forbes.com/councils/forbestechcouncil/2026/11/13/how-to-make-the-shift-from-tech-executive-to-board-director/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dr. Greg Ombach, CEO-Level Deep-Tech Operator & Board Member, Senior Vice President at Airbus.

Berdasarkan laporan, ​after years in executive roles, i naturally start thinking about the solution when i understand a technical or business problem. My natural instinct is to assess what needs to change, identify the missing resources and move forward.

Sebagaimana diketahui, serving on a board of directors has required a closer look at when that instinct helps and when it gets in the way. ​.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, during deep-tech scale-ups, the temptation to intervene can be strong. An experienced director may recognize the problem quickly and see a possible solution. A technical delay can affect financing and customer commitments while a small management team is already stretched. But once that director starts directing the work, the CEO’s responsibility becomes less clear.

One of the biggest challenges facing directors supporting the move from technology development to a growing business is learning to contribute without becoming another person running it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, directors need to look beyond lab test results and successful demonstrations. A working prototype is an important step. They must understand what it will take to turn the technology into a reliable solution customers will buy and use, whether it is software, hardware or a combination of both. Making it work reliably for customers, at a price they will accept, requires much more.

Berdasarkan laporan, operating experience helps a director examine this gap. In a scale-up, the next stage may require capabilities that the company has yet to build. Does the technical result justify moving forward? What work remains? Who can deliver it? Can the company fund it? These questions bring technical progress into the same discussion as commercialization and financing.

Berdasarkan laporan, a further question is whether the proposed work supports a clear business choice. Directors should understand which of these management is pursuing and what capabilities are needed. Better technical performance matters when it gives customers a reason to buy, reduces costs or lets the company serve more customers. This keeps the discussion focused on the business case, the importance of which I’ve written about previously, rather than letting technical progress become an objective in itself.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in my own board work, difficult circumstances led to more frequent meetings and more detailed technical discussions. Diagnosing problems and suggesting actions seemed useful, but sometimes pulled me toward execution.

Berdasarkan laporan, giving management room to explain its recommendation before offering a solution is crucial. Examining the assumptions and evidence made it easier to identify where further challenge was needed, rather than moving straight to an answer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if a recommendation is incomplete or unconvincing, the board should say so and explain what is missing. Directors still have to exercise judgement and make decisions. Asking questions does not remove that responsibility.

Berdasarkan laporan, a recovery plan is a useful example. An experienced executive may immediately consider how to organize the work. The non-executive director’s responsibility is to assess whether management’s approach addresses the problem and whether the team has the resources to carry it out.

Berdasarkan laporan, the purpose of the discussion should also be clear from the start. Is management asking for advice, seeking approval or reporting progress against an earlier decision? Each calls for a different contribution from directors. Without that distinction, a technical update can turn into a working session where board members start assigning operational tasks. Agreeing what the board must decide helps everyone understand where its involvement should end.

Berdasarkan laporan, this can require detailed discussion. Questioning whether a testing program provides enough evidence helps the board judge whether the company is ready to proceed. Choosing how the team should run the tests, allocating work or directing advisors puts the director in an operational role. Reviewing the plan independently also becomes harder when a board member has helped direct it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the wording of a question matters, too. A question that includes a preferred solution can sound like an instruction. Management needs to understand whether a director is asking for information, offering an idea or expressing a judgement on the recommendation.

Sebagaimana diketahui, finally, each discussion should end with a clear agreement on what management will do, who is responsible and when the board will review progress, as i’ve broken down in another earlier article. In my own board work, I learned that staying out of execution was not enough. These expectations also had to be made explicit.

Based on my experience, this simple question deserves more attention: What help does the CEO need from the board?.

Berdasarkan laporan, in some situations, i’ve found i hadn’t asked this question consistently enough. Advice, an introduction or an approval may be more useful than another proposed solution. Asking gives the CEO a chance to identify where a director can contribute, rather than leaving the board to assume what would help.

Diungkapkan bahwa sometimes urgency or limited management capacity may require a director to take on additional work. The board should agree what that person is being asked to do, what authority they have and how long the arrangement will last. Management and relevant advisors should understand it, too. Otherwise, temporary help can become an informal executive role without anyone having deliberately agreed to it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this change also requires attention after the meeting. A director can review which contributions clarified the issue and which became instructions. CEO feedback can help: Did the discussion strengthen management’s recommendation, or did it leave uncertainty about who was in charge? Understanding the boundary in principle is easier than respecting it consistently under pressure.

Before intervening, ask three questions: Is this a board issue? Am I improving the decision or taking over the solution? Who should own the next action?.

Diungkapkan bahwa the urge to act remains strong when an answer seems clear. That experience is most useful when it helps the board make sound decisions and gives the CEO clear expectations and practical support as the business grows. Deep-tech scale-ups need directors who can connect technical evidence with commercial judgement and financing needs. ​.

Sebagaimana diketahui, forbes technology council is an invitation-only community for world-class cios, ctos and technology executives. Do I qualify?.

Have the Celtics established themselves as legitimate contenders through 12 games?.

Boston ranks 26th in strength of schedule.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the best teams each season tend to take care of business at home and feast on inferior competition. You can only play the schedule as it's drawn up. We'd feel better if Boston hadn't fumbled away a 22-point lead in Detroit on opening night, or shown a little bit better in Houston despite playing on the second night of a back-to-back.

Sebagaimana diketahui, basically, we'd sum it up like this: if you said the celtics were going to be 10-2 after 12 games to start the season, particularly with three sets of back-to-backs and some crazy early season travel, we'd probably have taken it. Can we revisit the contender/pretender talk around Christmas?.

What should be on Brad Stevens' early-season shopping list?.

One thing we do think is really important to keep in mind when we get closer to December 15 and the unofficial start of NBA trade season: The Celtics have heavy motivation to remain under the luxury tax for a second straight season, which would reset pesky repeater penalties and give Stevens an opportunity to potentially splurge a bit next summer.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the celtics currently sit less than $2 million below the tax line, meaning something as simple as filling the vacant 15th roster spot would stress their budget. There's still pathways to bigger tinkering, but it would likely require sending out some of Boston's non-minimum salaries to add an impact player.

We do think that, given the glut of wing talent and only so many minutes to go around, even in instances where the Celtics prioritize rest for veteran players, there should be consideration of consolidating if a particular need exists elsewhere on the roster closer to February.

Diungkapkan bahwa the roster, otherwise, is about as balanced as the celtics have been in recent seasons. Alas, those players routinely command salaries that Boston would struggle to absorb, even if willing to move on from core talent.

The bigger priority right now should be getting Mitchell Robinson comfy here, and figuring out the youngest players the team should lean into.

The Celtics have heavy motivation to remain under the luxury tax for a second straight season.

Sebagaimana diketahui, good teams narrow your margin for error. So the Celtics might be able to survive their miscues and steal an overtime win against the Nets, but lose your way for six minutes against Detroit, then you've fumbled away a 22-point lead and the game.

Diungkapkan bahwa we could playfully distill it down to boston thriving whenever there's not a thompson twin on the other side of the court. But what that probably suggests is that, when there are defenders that can challenge Tatum, it certainly puts a greater stress on the supporting cast to shoulder the scoring load.

In those instances, the Celtics need Payton Pritchard and Derrick White to be great, even against teams that might have the size and physicality to make both guards uncomfortable.

Berdasarkan laporan, that said, boston acquitted itself well in wins over new york and philly, two teams with incredibly skilled starting fives. The schedule gets a bit more challenging through the end of November, though Boston might benefit from the fact that opponents will be dealing with some schedule difficulty or managing injuries.

Berdasarkan laporan, a little end-of-the-month nba cup showdown with atlanta should be fun, and there's a visit to wemby and the spurs right after. If the Celtics qualify for Cup quarterfinals (or beyond), we'll learn a bit more about how this team fares against top-level competition.

If you could lead the league in "being in the right spot on both ends of the floor," Baylor Scheierman would be among the league leaders.

If a playoff series started tomorrow, which young wing would you trust most?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the answer here is baylor scheierman. If you could lead the league in "being in the right spot on both ends of the floor," we think he'd be among the league leaders. If you could quantify a higher-level hustle play — breaking up an alley-oop attempt with a deflection out of bounds, or starting a fast break by passing from the floor after recovering a loose ball — then Scheierman's stat line would pop a bit more. You can make a strong case that Boston should continue to accelerate Gonzalez's development by carving out even more minutes for him.

Diungkapkan bahwa jordan walsh has benefited from his starting minutes, and the confidence is growing on the offensive end. The Celtics have a real luxury with their wing depth but, when the games really matter in the postseason, we'd probably yearn to see Scheierman and Gonzalez dominating those minutes.

Who's getting to the rim when Jayson Tatum sits?.

Diungkapkan bahwa the celtics rank dead last in the nba with only 51. This is not wholly unexpected. 1 drives and 25 drive points generated per game. You trade away Jaylen Brown, and you've got Tatum still learning to trust his body to attack the basket, and that number was always going to project low with a roster built heavy on 3-point shooting.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the celtics don't need to drive just to drive. It's something to monitor, especially if the team downshifts and settles for perimeter looks when the offense sputters. But we know how important paint touches can be to creating opportunities for shooters. That's when they need to embrace attack mode a bit more.

Berdasarkan laporan, can paul george be the no. 2 on a contending team at age 36?.

Diungkapkan bahwa george is putting together an all-defense-caliber season as one of the league leaders in deflections and steals. He's 11th in the East in scoring at 22 points per game. Would it be wild to suggest he's an early All-Star candidate based on Boston's hot start and the way his two-way impact has helped fuel it?.

Berdasarkan laporan, we'll see how his body holds up over 82 games. George surely was one of the best players on the floor when Philly rallied out of a 3-1 series hole against Boston last season, though the late-game suspension likely aided his body in being ready for that grind. It's slightly ambitious to ask him to do that over multiple rounds.

Diungkapkan bahwa the positive outlook would be that the celtics know full well how to bring their veterans along. Even if he's not on the full Al Horford plan in terms of rest, the Celtics will give George every opportunity to keep the body fresh over the regular-season grind.

Paul George has been outstanding so far for the C's.

Biggest concern(s) through the early portion of the Celtics schedule?.

We're admittedly nitpicking here given the strong start, but it's pretty undeniable that the Celtics have to figure out how to get the best version of Mitchell Robinson on the floor.

Whether Robinson is simply ramping himself up after New York's long championship season, or if it's simply navigating some bumps in the acclimation process, Robinson just hasn't been as impactful as even in smaller bursts through camp and preseason.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the fact that neemias queta and luka garza have both put up some of the best on-court numbers for the team so far this season has given the team some ability to figure things out with robinson. Teammates gotta get better at lobs — though they've looked good when they work. We have to think he won't smoke as many close-range putbacks as he has through the early portion of the schedule.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it goes back to the overarching conversation here: the celtics are built to be regular-season monsters. The question is, how do they transition that success and thrive in the postseason?.

Diungkapkan bahwa some of that might simply be tatum being great on the big stage. Some of it is making sure that players in the top six of the rotation — from Robinson to White to Pritchard — are playing their best basketball on that stage, too. There's a lot of time to work it all out.

#855. ​Your Holiday Fraud Rules May Be Turning Away Your Best New Customers

📅 13 Nov 2026

​Your Holiday Fraud Rules May Be Turning Away Your Best New Customers

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.forbes.com/councils/forbestechcouncil/2026/11/13/your-holiday-fraud-rules-may-be-turning-away-your-best-new-customers/

Wayne Hamilton is CEO and co-founder of pmtbox, a payments and risk platform built to get ahead of fraud instead of reacting to it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, every fall, i watch merchants get ready for the holidays by tightening up on fraud. Risk teams adjust their rules, lower their decline thresholds and add verification steps at checkout to get ahead of the attacks they expect between Thanksgiving and New Year’s. In the process, many end up turning away legitimate customers along with fraudsters.

Diungkapkan bahwa the instinct makes sense, especially since merchants know the chargebacks from those sales won’t land until january and february, when returns come back and sales slow. Nobody wants to start the year with that kind of hangover on their books.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i’ve spent my career in payments, first running a merchant processing company and now building technology that brings payments, risk and data together for merchants. 4% of U. S. While more fraud attempts do occur during peak season, legitimate volume grows so much faster that fraud usually makes up a smaller share of total transactions. TransUnion’s analysis of the 2023 holiday period found that 2. Over that time, I’ve seen how different holiday fraud looks once you measure it as a rate. e-commerce transactions from Thanksgiving through Cyber Monday were suspected fraud, compared with 4% for the rest of that year.

Diungkapkan bahwa when merchants tune their tools for a threat that is larger in raw numbers but smaller as a proportion of sales, their good customers absorb the cost. Here’s how I’d encourage merchants to approach holiday risk this year. ​.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, seasonal fraud headlines focus on how many attacks merchants will face, and that count almost always climbs. Before reacting to it, merchants should check what share of last holiday season’s transactions actually turned out to be fraudulent and compare it with the rest of their year.

If the rate held steady or dropped, as it often does when volume surges, there’s little reason to treat the season as a special threat that calls for stricter rules.

Berdasarkan laporan, a false positive, often called a false decline, is a legitimate order that gets rejected because it looks risky. Merchants hear about fraud through chargebacks, fees and processor warnings. A declined good customer generates none of those signals, and in my experience, many of those customers never come back.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, datos insights estimates the industry average false decline rate at 1. 51% of annual sales, based on its survey of U. e-commerce merchants. S. Few merchants track that number with the attention they give their fraud rate.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the holiday season brings in customers who don’t look like your usual buyers. Many have never purchased from you before, and some shop with you only once a year.

Diungkapkan bahwa gift buyers often ship to addresses that don’t match their billing information or place larger orders than they normally would. Those are the same patterns tightened fraud rules are built to catch, so the customers most likely to be flagged are often the new and seasonal shoppers a merchant spent its marketing budget trying to attract.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a good holiday season also brings in customers who keep buying the following year. When a first-time customer gets declined, the merchant loses that order and, very likely, any future orders from that customer. Holiday results come in lower than they should, and customer lifetime value takes a hit that carries into the new year.

Before the holiday rush, I would encourage merchants to take a few practical steps:.

• Compare last year’s holiday fraud rate against the rest of the year before changing any rules.

• Set a target approval rate for the season and review it weekly, the same way you would review chargebacks.

• Review how your fraud tool treats first-time customers, gift orders and mismatched shipping addresses.

• Ask your fraud provider how its model accounts for seasonal volume, and whether it can tell a busy day from an attack.

• Avoid reacting mid-season to raw attempt counts without checking what they mean as a percentage of sales.

Sebagaimana diketahui, fraud will always be part of the holiday season. So will first-time customers who could become regulars, and a merchant’s fraud rules should be set with both in mind.

And now, with Boerkircher ranked among the NFL's 15 highest-graded rookies, the Jaguars have another reason to feel confident in a draft pick that few outside the organization initially supported.

#862. The Endpoint: Where Security Breaches Still Thrive

📅 13 Nov 2026

The Endpoint: Where Security Breaches Still Thrive

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.forbes.com/councils/forbestechcouncil/2026/11/13/the-endpoint-where-security-breaches-still-thrive/

Kevin Greenway, CTO at 10ZiG, has 25+ years in IT and leads technology and product strategy, with a focus on VDI and End User Computing.

Berdasarkan laporan, ​despite billions spent on workspace cybersecurity, the endpoint remains one of the most vulnerable targets. Enterprises are contending with AI-driven threats and costly data breaches that begin with human error, shadow AI, social engineering and other elements. Cybercrime costs are projected to exceed $15 trillion in the same year. Forrester analysts project that cybersecurity spending will continue to rise, reaching more than $300 billion in 2029. ​.

Berdasarkan laporan, these threats capitalize on endpoint activities like clicking a link in a phishing email, using an unvetted ai application or sending sensitive data via unsecured and unpatched devices. ​.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, edge computing and hybrid work, with many people using multiple devices during a workday, have heightened the role of the endpoint. It isn’t just a device but the main computing hub and a critical control point in securing enterprise workloads. CISOs and cybersecurity and IT teams now must defend an endpoint environment that can change daily. Unprotected devices and applications a worker chooses to use off the radar are now a common threat.

Diungkapkan bahwa endpoint security, however, is losing ground to a focus on ai and detection rather than prevention. That means they inherit the same risks. They use the same paths, identities, permissions, and connectivity that humans use. That’s a mistake, Forrester senior analyst Paddy Harrington says: “Agentic systems are ultimately taking actions on endpoints, applications, networks, and operational systems. ”​.

Sebagaimana diketahui, refocusing on endpoint security as a preventative strategy—what harrington calls “foundational protections”—makes sense. ​.

Berdasarkan laporan, vulnerabilities show the need to refocus on prevention. Attackers thrive on endpoints that lack critical patches. They access poorly protected applications and data, setting up a path to network infiltration and a data breach.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, although patching is the never-ending story of needed updates, it’s a vital security practice. Verizon’s 2026 DBIR report notes that exploitation of vulnerabilities, rising to 31%, is now the most common initial breach access point. At the same time, critical vulnerability remediation fell from 38% in 2024 to 26% in 2025. Attackers benefit from a combination of the slowdown in patch resolution (43 median days to 32) and a 50% increase in critical vulnerabilities. ​​.

Beyond keeping up with patching updates, enterprises need to ensure data security through effective user privileges and access control, and an OS that supports clean reboots to avoid application persistence, a weakness attackers favor.

Diungkapkan bahwa user privileges continue to be a challenge for enterprises and an opportunity for attackers to infiltrate networks. Granting users privileges beyond their job requirements, weak password and MFA management, and leaving privileges open after someone leaves the company are main culprits. All of these create fertile ground for credential theft that can lead to a data breach.

Security challenges look different in two main endpoint categories: PCs and thin clients.

Diungkapkan bahwa pcs typically store applications, software and current workload data for local, quick access. However, if access privileges are weak or a user, via social engineering, allows access, it opens the door to data exfiltration, malware, ransomware and network disruption. Local storage can also be an issue if files are left open and another person can access the device without authorized privileges.

Diungkapkan bahwa conversely, thin clients are read-only hardware devices that don’t locally store data. A user signs on, and the thin client begins a secure reboot from a known good state. This non-persistent runtime, with each sign-on starting with a clean data environment, reduces the possible attack surface. Thin clients also support read-only mountable file and application packages that enable localized computing but aren’t permanently stored. Data and applications don’t leave the data center, or the secure, controlled environment where they’re stored. Instead, they function as a conduit to cloud-based and VDI-delivered applications. In industries where an endpoint device is often shared, such as healthcare, call centers and manufacturing facilities, all of which feature shift work, thin clients are a popular choice.

Diungkapkan bahwa another critical element in endpoint security is the os. By far, the dominant OS in enterprise PCs is Windows. Windows’ large install base makes it a constant cyberattack target. For thin clients, the preferred choice is Linux. If an attack succeeds, the computing damage can be widespread. This is also why related patching and security updates need to be addressed quickly.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unlike general-purpose operating systems, a thin client’s linux os is intentionally designed as a closed, purpose-built platform for access to vdi, daas, saas and web environments. Linux OS is non-persistent, reverting to a clean reboot, thereby thwarting ransomware and other threats that exploit data persistence on the device. ​.

Diungkapkan bahwa as ai threats march on, enterprises need to give security basics more attention. AI attackers rely on weakly protected endpoints and human error. Strengthening access privileges, patching and user authentication are a good start. Enterprises must get tougher. AI threat actors will get smarter. ​.

#864. Young Cowboys linebacker has taken advantage of opportunities

📅 13 Nov 2026

Young Cowboys linebacker has taken advantage of opportunities

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/young-cowboys-linebacker-taken-advantage-180000923.html

Diungkapkan bahwa there have been very few bright spots for the dallas cowboys in 2026. With the defense struggling for the second-straight year and the Cowboys offense having more bumps than we're used to seeing, Dallas fans are gearing up for yet another disappointing season.

One of the few unheralded bright spots for the Cowboys defense this season has been second-year linebacker Shemar James.

James played quite a bit as a rookie under Matt Eberflus, but was viewed as more of a role-player and special teamer, but since being named a starter and given the green-dot two weeks ago, James has been one of the better players on defense for the 2026 Dallas Cowboys.

Berdasarkan laporan, with dee winters and demarvion overshown battling injuries in the first part of the season, james was thrown into a heavier role in christian parker's defense. After performing well during his uptick in snaps, Parker handed James the green-dot role for the Cowboys defense and through two weeks he's handled that responsibility well for a young player.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the last two weeks, james has registered 14 tackles, one forced fumble, one fumble recovery, and one interception. James, a smaller-built linebacker, is not quite the force against the run as a player like Jaishawn Barham, but his ability to play on all three-downs and his understanding in coverage has been a nice boost for the Cowboys defense that has struggled mightily through their first nine games.

Berdasarkan laporan, james is by no means on his way to making the pro bowl or receiving all pro votes, but the cowboys have really struggled to hit on day three picks in recent drafts. With James proving to be a solid player on defense, and his play earning him more playing time and responsibility on defense, the Cowboys may have found an impactful player on day three of the draft.

Diungkapkan bahwa it's still early and it's been limited action, but the early returns in year two for james is one of the rare bright spots for the cowboys defense in recent memory. James will have his hands full this Sunday with a difficult San Francisco 49ers offense coming to town, but his impact was felt on the field against the Arizona Cardinals and Indianapolis Colts, and we will see if he can carry the momentum into Week 10.

You look at the play in the game on Tuesday night against Florida State, but when he gets the ball in front of their bench, he just skips it on the line right to Denzel's shooting pocket, knocks down a 3. And then he drives the middle off the right wing, drops it to Ruben for a layup.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i mean, he is six-eight-and-a-half, six-nine, making point guard plays out there. Having again that skill set, him playing with that level of confidence, it really raises the level of our team. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, "i played overseas for a couple years in israel. At San Francisco, a big part of our success was international players. I think we had eight on our last team at San Francisco. And a big part of my conversation with Scott Stricklin and the administration here when I was interviewing was I wanted to do a good job in the state of Florida, up and down the East Coast, and then wanted to supplement our roster with international players.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i felt like we would be able to get even better international players here than we did in san francisco because of the level of school. But again, my job is to build the best team possible. My job isn't to get the 15 most-talented players and just throw them in there and see what happens. We have 15 roster spots. Diungkapkan bahwa "so we really do try to take our time and put all these pieces together. But I do think my experience playing over there, as well as our experience recruiting internationally at San Francisco, is a big part of that. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa "yeah, we had a bunch of aussies there for sure, and they have since started recruiting a lot of europe as well. ".

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/houston-astros-manager-brad-ausmus-191048037.html

There's a portion of the Houston Astros fanbase that became accustomed to nothing worse than trips to the American League Championship Series and has felt completely underwhelmed recently by a team that has gone three years without winning a playoff game.

That ho-hum attitude carried over for some after a managerial search landed this week on Brad Ausmus, who also hasn't won a playoff game in his previous five seasons as manager with the Detroit Tigers and Los Angeles Angels.

The 57-year-old Ausmus, who sat in front of the media for his introductory press conference Friday morning, has a plan to win over those folks.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i'd say let's go win," the former astros catcher said. My goal is: Any doubters, we bring them back in and we make them full-time Astros fans again. I'm going to go out there, we're going to win. We're going to do our work in spring training and hopefully get the most out of the players. "For the ones who are doubters, let me bring you back in. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, ausmus has become accustomed to high expectations, sitting next to aaron boone the past three seasons as the new york yankees bench coach. In those three seasons, he got to see the highs of New York when the Yankees reached the World Series in 2024, but also the lows when disgruntled fans booed the team at home during back-to-back exits in the American League Division Series.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i don't worry (about expectations)," ausmus said. I think that should be the goal every single year. That's what we're here to do. "We need to win the World Series. It's very difficult to win the World Series, but that should be the goal. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that was a common theme throughout ausmus' 20-minute press conference. Even when asked about his 18-year playing career that included 10 years in Houston where he stamped himself as perhaps the best catcher in franchise history, he still turned the conversation to managing games until the end of October.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i'm not here to talk about glory days. But the goal is, and should be every single year, to win the World Series. I'm here to talk about the Houston Astros today and the Houston Astros going into 2027, which is now my main focus and certainly the goal is to win the World Series," he said. Winning the division, great step. "Making the playoffs, great step. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the astros have seen their win total decline in each of the past four years, including an 81-81 record in 2026 that was the worst for a full season since 2014, so world series talk seems a bit premature. Ausmus didn't get into specifics about changes that need to be made to make that conversation more realistic - "This is Day One for me," he said - but he expects to get plenty of input, not just from fans, but from some of his old teammates.

Jeff Bagwell and Craig Biggio sat in the front row Friday watching their friend and former teammate speak, but Ausmus laughed when it was brought up that perhaps the always outspoken Lance Berkman might be the one chiming in the most with suggestions.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i'm not going to say lance, but probably lance, and i welcome it," ausmus said with a grin. "I think you take information from all different sources and experience is a good source to come from. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the astros made the playoffs in five of ausmus' 10 years as a player here, including a world series. That 2005 run to the franchise's first Fall Classic means he's familiar with what the atmosphere can be like at Daikin Park when the fans are bought in.

Diungkapkan bahwa "with the roof closed, it was so loud in here, i had to yell to the umpire, literally yell to the umpire and i'm inches from his ear, for him to understand me," ausmus said. "So, when you get the fans here and you're winning ballgames and it's a big game, the energy is palpable. When you have people in the seats and the noise is up, it's a home-field advantage and it's a lot of fun. It's a home-field advantage, it really is. ".

Now, it's his job to win enough games to turn Daikin Park into that raucous stadium once again.

Diungkapkan bahwa "there's no question in the last 10 years that houston is looked at as one of the premier teams in the american league," ausmus said. "The World Series, playoff appearances, they've been outstanding, so we need to try to continue that with the goal being the World Series. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if this sounds familiar, there's a good reason. Danault has been down this road before, and Canadiens fans will remember just how effective his previous combination with Tomas Tatar and Brendan Gallagher was.

Sebagaimana diketahui, from 2018 to 2021, that trio became one of montreal's most dependable lines, playing a significant role in the canadiens' run to the 2021 stanley cup final. They weren't necessarily the flashiest players on the ice, but they were incredibly difficult to play against.

Neither Tatar nor Gallagher was a traditional superstar, yet the line consistently ranked among the NHL's best in expected goals share and shot-attempt differential.

Danault once again serves as the defensive safety valve, using his positioning, faceoff ability, and hockey IQ to neutralize opposing centres. Diungkapkan bahwa they may not be the line opponents lose sleep over because of their scoring ability, but they could very well be the line they dread seeing come over the boards. They're difficult to get around, frustrating to play against, and increasingly hard to get the puck away from.

If Danault can help recreate even a little of the magic he found with Tatar and Gallagher, the Canadiens may have stumbled upon something special.

By keeping the puck in the offensive zone and forcing opponents to chase them, the line delivers exactly the kind of impact Montreal desperately needs: elite defensive acumen.

Diungkapkan bahwa the lions also face a demanding stretch of their schedule, with the tampa bay buccaneers coming to detroit next week before a thanksgiving showdown against the chicago bears. Campbell has already made his priorities clear when discussing Sunday's matchup against the Patriots.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there is no guarantee that detroit's travel strategy will prove better than new england's. However, Campbell clearly believes the Lions have done everything necessary to be ready.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for now, campbell isn't losing any sleep over it. Well, other than the sleep he probably lost on that flight to Germany.

#904. Jensen Quits. Fools Tackle Your Toughest Questions

Jensen Quits. Fools Tackle Your Toughest Questions

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/11/13/jensen-quits-fools-tackle-your-toughest-questions/?source=iedfolrf0000001

Berdasarkan laporan, jensen huang has stepped down as nvidia’s ceo amid a national security scandal. Our analysts tackle the six questions every Nvidia shareholder is asking, from who can fill his shoes to whether the stock has fallen far enough.

Berdasarkan laporan, jensen huang has quit as nvidia's (nvda -2. 26%) CEO, effective immediately.

Diungkapkan bahwa huang co-founded nvidia in 1993 over a meal at a denny's in san jose. He has run it ever since. Under him, a maker of video game graphics chips became the engine of the artificial intelligence (AI) boom.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, he resigned after an extramarital affair raised national security concerns. Nvidia named its CFO, Colette Kress, as interim CEO. The board also named Harvey C. Jones, an entrepreneur and venture investor, as its first-ever chairman. Nvidia says it has no reason to think national security or company secrets were compromised. Its inquiry is still going on.

Sebagaimana diketahui, investors didn't wait for answers. Nvidia shares fell over 10% at one point today, on top of steep losses earlier in the week.

Diungkapkan bahwa many of you own nvidia because we recommended it. Yesterday in Stock Advisor, before Huang quit, Team Rule Breakers removed Nvidia from its list of Foundational Stocks. We explain where that leaves the stock at the end of this article.

Diungkapkan bahwa first, we asked our analysts from team hidden gems and team rb the questions we think you're asking. That's what makes us "motley. Some are tough. Our analysts don't always agree, and we haven't asked them to. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa with most companies, the answer to such a question would be simple, but nvidia is no ordinary company. CEO Jensen Huang is extremely ingrained in the company that he co-founded and has run for more than three decades.

Berdasarkan laporan, nvidia's internal structure is unique in that huang had an estimated 60 direct reports, which he dubbed "extreme co-design. " For context, most CEOs have roughly 10 direct reports, on average. Moreover, as an electrical engineer, Huang was deeply involved in the development process for the graphics processing units (GPUs) the company pioneered.

I would submit that Nvidia is one of those unique companies where it's extremely difficult to extricate the CEO from the company he founded and is so much a part of.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as such, it will be difficult to find a successor with huang's unique qualifications and leadership style. I suspect Nvidia will be a very different company going forward.

Berdasarkan laporan, nvidia named colette kress interim ceo, and this is a wise choice considering her performance as the company's cfo. Kress has spoken extensively during the company's earnings calls, not only about the financials but also about product rollout, product performance, and the company's strategy. She clearly has a deep understanding of where Nvidia is today and where it's going, and I could see her in the role as permanent CEO.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, another strong possibility is ian buck, nvidia's vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing. As the inventor of CUDA and the one to launch the use of GPUs for general computing, Buck would bring innovation and product strengths to the CEO role. This could be useful as Nvidia enters the next phases of AI growth.

Berdasarkan laporan, nvidia can find a new ceo. Huang was the company's loudest voice against export controls, and he lobbied the president directly to ease limits on chip sales to China. That pitch now comes with a scandal attached. Finding a new ambassador to Washington is harder. House China Committee Chair John Moolenaar says it changes how the whole debate looks.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that ties the leadership loss and the national security fallout into a single problem. Nvidia is heading into a tougher policy fight without the person who usually fights it. The business doesn't depend on any one person. Lawmakers in both parties want tighter controls, and Senate Democratic Leader Chuck Schumer wants answers on how Nvidia's lobbying shaped the administration's chip policy. But its standing in Washington did, and rebuilding it will take longer than a CEO search.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, let's be clear: nvidia is bigger than one person. This is not a fly-by-night start-up trying to make its way in the world. Nvidia tech is the foundation on which the AI industry, and other industries before it, has been built.

Diungkapkan bahwa hyperscalers have spent years building around cuda. I'd argue that Nvidia's best AI growth days were over before the CEO change, as competing chips came online. But there is plenty of business to be won, and Nvidia remains well positioned to compete.

Diungkapkan bahwa talent is a bigger risk. A new CEO will likely alter power dynamics, and some top people will inevitably leave. Nvidia's flat structure meant dozens of senior leaders reported to the founder. Engineers sitting on years of vested stock options might take this as a reason to walk.

Diungkapkan bahwa nvidia can weather some losses based on the quality of its offerings. But the new CEO's biggest challenge will be making sure the company is well positioned to win in whatever world follows this AI surge. The company will need all its best talent and partners for that to happen.

Sebagaimana diketahui, let's not make this a call on what the stock will do from here. One thing we can count on is that the market is irrational and people's emotions don't always work in the most logical ways during times of stress.

Sebagaimana diketahui, looking at the business as it stands right now, it's fair to say that the stock has probably fallen juuuuusst right. There will be a leadership vacuum for a while and likely some palace intrigue until the new permanent CEO is named. At the same time, it's hard to imagine that customers will be backing out of their commitments to buy Nvidia chips in the near future. So, in the shorter term, it looks fine.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the longer-term question comes down to our answers for no. If we were to see an Nvidia brain drain, that could impair the company's ability to deliver the bleeding-edge chips we have become accustomed to from Nvidia. 4. If you believe that is an inevitable outcome, then you'll probably find yourself in the "not far enough" camp.

If you're experiencing a weird sense of chip-sector déjà vu, you're not alone.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a dominant semiconductor company loses its ceo over a relationship scandal and immediately hands the keys to its cfo? intel (intc -3. 05%) ran this exact play in 2018, when troubled CEO Brian Krzanich exited under scandalous circumstances and CFO Bob Swan stepped into the interim seat.

Sebagaimana diketahui, intel bounced back from that setback, but not right away. The stock fell more than 70% over the next seven years as Pat Gelsinger took over and started an ambitious but difficult strategy shift. Then the board got antsy, showed Gelsinger the door, and brought in Lip-Bu Tan -- who largely kept Gelsinger's chip foundry blueprint intact and is now reaping the rewards as Intel's stock hit all-time highs in June 2026.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for nvidia, the durability of its ai lead hinges on how smoothly kress and a permanent successor bridge that transition. It's still the same company, only in search of a new all-star CEO.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this is bad news, and it's fine to feel rattled. Many investors bought Nvidia partly because of Huang. But one bad day doesn't tell you whether Nvidia can thrive without him.

Berdasarkan laporan, here's where we stand. Foundational Stocks are the companies we're most comfortable telling a new investor to buy and hold without a long list of caveats. Right now, Nvidia comes with too many, so Team Rule Breakers removed it from the list yesterday.

Diungkapkan bahwa nvidia is still a buy on the stock advisor scorecard. But the team is deciding whether to move it to the Penalty Box or potentially even issue a sell as more facts come out.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so, don't rush to buy or sell. Is that reason still true? Check how much of your portfolio it now makes up. Instead, ask yourself why you bought Nvidia. If it has grown very large, that's worth thinking about, whatever happens next.

Then watch for four things: what Nvidia says about demand when it reports earnings next Tuesday, who the board picks as permanent CEO, what the company's inquiry finds, and whether regulators act.

We'll keep following this story and update you as it develops.

Anthropic’s Valuation Target Has Slipped From $2 Trillion to Under $1.5 Trillion. Here’s Why

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/11/13/anthropics-valuation-target-has-slipped-from-2-trillion-to-under-15-trillion-heres-why/?source=iedfolrf0000001

Diungkapkan bahwa anthropic scaled back its ipo valuation target. Should that worry investors?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, anthropic's (nasdaq: ant) ipo is set for nov. 19.

The debut of the leading AI lab has been highly anticipated and comes ahead of rival OpenAI's, which pushed its IPO back to 2027.

Diungkapkan bahwa despite earlier speculation, anthropic won't top space exploration technologies' record set earlier this year when it raised $75 billion in its ipo, which valued the elon musk-led company at $1. 75 trillion.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, anthropic had purportedly aimed for a valuation of $2 trillion, but after updating its ipo filing, the company will now sell shares at a valuation of $1. 4 trillion, aiming to bring in $64. 4 billion, in addition to a private placement worth $26 billion from several big tech companies. That $1. 4 trillion figure is significantly higher than the $952 billion it was worth in a funding round this spring, but it also represents a significant moderation from the $2 trillion it was said to be aiming for.

So why is Anthropic pumping the brakes ahead of its big day? Let's take a look at a few of the reasons.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dario amodei on stage at an anthropic event. Image source: Anthropic.

Berdasarkan laporan, timing is crucial for an ipo, and anthropic may have missed the most attractive period of the ipo window. Over the last month, AI stocks have tumbled, first on concerns that rising interest rates would squeeze the AI infrastructure build-out, and then on fears of a data center crackdown following the midterm elections. Now, Jensen Huang's departure has injected sudden uncertainty into Nvidia and further clouds the prospects for the AI boom.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, spacex's ipo was timed just as ai stocks were peaking. By contrast, chip stocks like Nvidia, Intel, Arm Holdings, and others are down substantially from then.

Sebagaimana diketahui, with enthusiasm for ai stocks having cooled, it makes sense for anthropic to scale back its valuation target. However, the company is better off going public now than waiting and risking the IPO window closing further.

Sebagaimana diketahui, related to the pressure on the ai sector, anthropic also needs to price its ipo to ensure that the share price goes up on the first day. If it failed to rise, that could be devastating to the AI trade at this point, and Anthropic is reliant on the AI ecosystem remaining healthy. It needs continued demand growth and an increased supply of chips and data centers in order to justify its valuation.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the company has made more than $500 billion of purchase commitments to support its growth ambitions, and maintaining positive investor sentiment toward its own stock and ai broadly is key to supporting its growth to fund those investments. Share price movements are their own feedback loop, and if Anthropic can achieve an opening-day pop, it could ignite a surge across the AI sector.

Anthropic has reported surging growth this year, but there's a lot of risk in its business model.

Berdasarkan laporan, in its s-1, the company disclosed a whopping $895. 4 billion of future purchase commitments and lease agreements related to infrastructure and compute.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, many of those agreements are non-cancellable. For Anthropic to be successful, it will have to ramp up its revenue growth and cash flow to pay for those commitments. In an environment where AI investors are already spooked by rising interest rates, it's not a surprise that they would push back on Anthropic's plans to spend nearly $1 trillion.

IPOs typically underperform the market, but Anthropic could be the exception that proves the rule, especially at its lower valuation.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the company reached run rate revenue of $81 billion in october, meaning it trades at just 17 times run rate sales, which is a reasonable valuation for a software stock. Anthropic is also reporting triple-digit revenue growth and an adjusted operating profit, and it's established itself as the leading AI lab. The fate of the AI boom is now riding on Anthropic more than anyone else.

Sebagaimana diketahui, at that price, the stock looks like an attractive buy, even with the expected ipo volatility. While it's certainly a high-risk stock, there's a lot of upside to Anthropic if it fulfills the transformative potential of AI.

#920. How Mariemont claimed first girls state soccer title

📅 13 Nov 2026

How Mariemont claimed first girls state soccer title

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/mariemont-claimed-first-girls-state-190615670.html

Addy Zawaly was the active leader in career goals for the Mariemont girls soccer team.

The University of Wisconsin commit and All-American hasn't needed to score goals every game for her team to win, as she was part of a deep and balanced offense this season.

But the senior scored her biggest goal in her last game, giving her team the lead for good to win the program's state championship.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mariemont defeated findlay liberty-benton 6-1 in the ohio high school division iv girls soccer state championship game nov. 13 at ScottsMiracle-Gro Field, the home of the Columbus Crew.

Sebagaimana diketahui, mariemont, in its first trip to a state final, brings home the championship trophy and finishes 20-1-2 overall for the season. Liberty-Benton finishes 20-3-1. The six goals ties an overall state record for goals by one team in a girls soccer state final, matching Summit Country Day's total in a 2015 state final.

Diungkapkan bahwa mariemont led liberty-benton 1-0 at halftime. After controlling the possession for the most part in the first half, Mariemont got a big strike from its senior leader with six minutes left.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mariemont earned a corner kick. Claire Young delivered a ground ball to Zawaly at the top of the goal box, with another Mariemont player letting the ball go through her legs toward Zawaly to distract the defense. Zawaly quickly fired a strike into the far post for her 15th goal of the season.

Diungkapkan bahwa mariemont had nine shots to two for the liberty-benton. Four of the Warrior shots were on goal, and one for the opponent. Mariemont finished with a 19-8 edge in shots.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the warriors scored two more quickly to start the second half. They scored in just 12 seconds from the kickoff. Zawaly unleashed a hard shot that was deflected to senior Alyssa Dewey. Dewey, another four-year starter for the Warriors, knocked in the rebound for her 12th goal of the season and 51st for her career.

Diungkapkan bahwa a few minutes later, young, a freshman, made a great play for a goal of her own, dribbling into space and firing a rocket inside the left post from more than 20 yards. It was her 10th goal, making her the fifth player in double figures for the season.

Young scored her 11th midway through the second half, taking a pass by Dewey from the endline and scoring from near the penalty spot.

Sebagaimana diketahui, zawaly got her second goal a minute later, taking a pass from meryck bogle in transition and scoring from the middle of the box to make it 5-0. Zawaly, recently named a Top Drawer Soccer All-American, scored her 16th.

The Eagles got one back on a deflection off a free kick with 16 minutes left.

Berdasarkan laporan, bogle scored her first of the game with seven minutes left, taking a pass in transition from dewey for the final tally. It was her 12th. Bogle showed toughness by playing with a cast on her arm as did starting center back Ella Garrison, a senior.

Diungkapkan bahwa in its season opener aug. 14, Mariemont lost 4-0 to Ross, a Division III regional runner-up that went undefeated until the regional final loss to Indian Hill. The Warriors drew with Taylor and Indian Hill in early September and then won their final 15 games by a total of 82-4.

Berdasarkan laporan, mariemont seniors are elizabeth curran, ella garrison, m. J. Stevens, Alyssa Dewey, Emme Padjen, Jenna VanScoy, Camdyn Bogle, Hannah Iwanicki, Addy Zawaly.

Diungkapkan bahwa zawaly had 16 goals and 13 assists, graduating with 68 and 47. Dewey had 12 goals and a team-high 26 assists with her two today. She finished with 51 goals and 74 assists, reaching double figures in both all four years.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, bogle finished with 12 goals and 12 assists. Young had 11 and 11. Junior Marisa Murphy posted 18 goals and 12 assists. Mariemont outscored foes 94-14 for the season.

Addy Zawaly was the active leader in career goals for the Mariemont girls soccer team.

The University of Wisconsin commit and All-American hasn't needed to score goals every game for her team to win, as she was part of a deep and balanced offense this season.

But the senior scored her biggest goal in her last game, giving her team the lead for good to win the program's state championship.

Diungkapkan bahwa mariemont defeated findlay liberty-benton 6-1 in the ohio high school division iv girls soccer state championship game nov. 13 at ScottsMiracle-Gro Field, the home of the Columbus Crew.

Berdasarkan laporan, mariemont, in its first trip to a state final, brings home the championship trophy and finishes 20-1-2 overall for the season. Liberty-Benton finishes 20-3-1. The six goals ties an overall state record for goals by one team in a girls soccer state final, matching Summit Country Day's total in a 2015 state final.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mariemont led liberty-benton 1-0 at halftime. After controlling the possession for the most part in the first half, Mariemont got a big strike from its senior leader with six minutes left.

Diungkapkan bahwa mariemont earned a corner kick. Claire Young delivered a ground ball to Zawaly at the top of the goal box, with another Mariemont player letting the ball go through her legs toward Zawaly to distract the defense. Zawaly quickly fired a strike into the far post for her 15th goal of the season.

Diungkapkan bahwa mariemont had nine shots to two for the liberty-benton. Four of the Warrior shots were on goal, and one for the opponent. Mariemont finished with a 19-8 edge in shots.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the warriors scored two more quickly to start the second half. They scored in just 12 seconds from the kickoff. Zawaly unleashed a hard shot that was deflected to senior Alyssa Dewey. Dewey, another four-year starter for the Warriors, knocked in the rebound for her 12th goal of the season and 51st for her career.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a few minutes later, young, a freshman, made a great play for a goal of her own, dribbling into space and firing a rocket inside the left post from more than 20 yards. It was her 10th goal, making her the fifth player in double figures for the season.

Young scored her 11th midway through the second half, taking a pass by Dewey from the endline and scoring from near the penalty spot.

Diungkapkan bahwa zawaly got her second goal a minute later, taking a pass from meryck bogle in transition and scoring from the middle of the box to make it 5-0. Zawaly, recently named a Top Drawer Soccer All-American, scored her 16th.

The Eagles got one back on a deflection off a free kick with 16 minutes left.

Sebagaimana diketahui, bogle scored her first of the game with seven minutes left, taking a pass in transition from dewey for the final tally. It was her 12th. Bogle showed toughness by playing with a cast on her arm as did starting center back Ella Garrison, a senior.

Diungkapkan bahwa in its season opener aug. 14, Mariemont lost 4-0 to Ross, a Division III regional runner-up that went undefeated until the regional final loss to Indian Hill. The Warriors drew with Taylor and Indian Hill in early September and then won their final 15 games by a total of 82-4.

Sebagaimana diketahui, mariemont seniors are elizabeth curran, ella garrison, m. J. Stevens, Alyssa Dewey, Emme Padjen, Jenna VanScoy, Camdyn Bogle, Hannah Iwanicki, Addy Zawaly.

Sebagaimana diketahui, zawaly had 16 goals and 13 assists, graduating with 68 and 47. Dewey had 12 goals and a team-high 26 assists with her two today. She finished with 51 goals and 74 assists, reaching double figures in both all four years.

Berdasarkan laporan, bogle finished with 12 goals and 12 assists. Junior Marisa Murphy posted 18 goals and 12 assists. Young had 11 and 11. Mariemont outscored foes 94-14 for the season.

#926. Innventure: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors

Innventure: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.fool.com/earnings/takeaways/2026/11/13/innventure-3-key-takeaways-for-long-term-investors/?source=iedfolrf0000001

Subsidiaries must now raise outside money on their own, so Accelsius's fate hinges on whether it can attract capital without parent backing.

Diungkapkan bahwa on its third-quarter 2026 earnings call, held on nov. 12, 2026, Innventure (INV -19. Shareholders must understand how leadership plans to fund operations and preserve equity value. 61%) announced a strategic pivot toward cost reduction, debt restructuring, and asset preservation. The parent company faces severe near-term liquidity demands while its early-stage operating subsidiaries continue to burn cash. Three things management said stand out.

Berdasarkan laporan, management cut corporate staff from 40 to 15 employees and stopped spending on new start-up development to lower cash overhead. It expects payroll expenses to fall 56% once severance obligations end in early 2027.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the board formed an independent strategic review committee and hired investment bank rbc capital markets to evaluate all options for raising capital. Management wants to optimize the capital structure, which could include selling equity stakes in operating businesses or renegotiating loan agreements.

Diungkapkan bahwa innventure stopped providing ongoing funding to the liquid-cooling business accelsius, the flexible-packaging developer aeroflexx, and the waste-conversion unit refinity. Each operating subsidiary must now secure external capital directly from outside investors to finance its commercialization.

#928. Germany U21 Player Ratings | Muhammed Damar shines in 1-2 defeat against Belgium

📅 13 Nov 2026

Germany U21 Player Ratings | Muhammed Damar shines in 1-2 defeat against Belgium

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/germany-u21-player-ratings-muhammed-190600072.html

Berdasarkan laporan, in their first of two friendlies during the november 2026 international break, antonio di salvo's germany u21 side delivered a mixed performance in front of just over 10,000 fans at the stadion an der hafenstraße. In spite of some noteworthy performances from several individual players, an all-too-vulnerable DFB defensive unit conceded two goals and slid to a 1-2 defeat. Get German Football News' coverage of the match and individual player ratings highlights the uneven nature of the match. The result marked Germany's first defeat since a 3-2 loss to Greece in October 2025.

Diungkapkan bahwa di salvo ended up making five changes to the last xi he utilized against georgia in the final uefa u21 european qualification match back in october. With left back Lukas Ullrich of Borussia Mönchengladbach unavailable due to injury, former Germany senior team call-up Hennes Behrens of Augsburg earned his first U21 start in his first cap for Germany at the highest youth level. Intriguing Hoffenheim prospect Cajetan Lenz also ended up earning his first start in his first U21 cap, replacing Union Berlin's Aljoscha Kemlein in midfield.

Diungkapkan bahwa attackers noah darvich (elversberg) and nicolo tresoldi (club brugge) also forfeited their squad spots to newly recalled muhammed damar (wolfsburg) and anton kade (augsburg). Di Salvo compensated for the most unwelcome late loss of Tresoldi by deploying former Germany U17 World Champion Paris Brunner up front and having Damar take Brunner's place on the left wing. Stuttgart's Dennis Seimen started in goal after Freiburg's Mio Backhaus incurred a hand injury in training. As expected, Joshua Quarshie snapped on the captain's armband in Tresoldi's absence.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the german hosts regrettably weren't able to capitalize on some early opportunities. As the newly retooled German midfield of Lenz and Noël Aséko began to push high in open play, Di Salvo's youngsters looked increasingly vulnerable on the counter. A free-kick from Damar in the 2nd minute landed with Kade, but the FCA man found himself blocked from close range. Brunner and Behrens also had shooting opportunities inside the opening five minutes, yet couldn't manage to finish convincingly. Unfortunately, they would be punished in short order.

Diungkapkan bahwa former borussia dortmund attacker julien duranville wasn't able to locate the back of the net on his first counter charge. Duranville would nevertheless earn credit for the 0-1 in the 8th minute. Teammate Lucas Stassin hit Duranville with a sharp cutback after beating SGE defender Nnamdi Collins in an individual duel. The BVB exile appeared determined to crash into the box early. A small contingent of Germany supporters in the standing bleachers behind the goal whistled down Duranville hard when the 20-year-old marked his return to the Ruhr with an extra celebratory flourish.

Diungkapkan bahwa there were some instances during which the guests threatened to double their advantage. Damar, rotating regularly, also managed to make his presence felt on the right. Lenz, Damar, and Behrens led several useful charges down the left-hand side. The next phase nonetheless mostly belonged to the DFB-Jungs. Pejcinovic and Brunner sometimes pushed together up front as Di Salvo's men attacked in an occasional 4-4-2. The joy in the football was evident, though clear-cut chances were still not being engineered.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, damar finally received another chance off a dead ball in the 25th minute after brunner drew a foul outside the box. The former Hoffenheim and Elversberg man cleverly snuck the ball in underneath the leaping Belgian wall for his fourth tally in a U21 shirt. After the 1-1, Damar proved himself hungry for more. The Berlin native forced a save out of Belgian keeper Lucca Brughmans in the 28th, burst into the box on a long dribble at the half-hour mark, and earned a free-kick in a dangerous area in the 37th.

Once again taking the set piece himself in the 38th, Damar forced Brughmans to tip the ball off the crossbar.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as the opening half drew to a close, the germans were once again unrelenting in their attempts to secure another goal. Only the left post denied Stassin the 1-2 shortly before it was time to head into the tunnel. Damar actually showed himself to be mortal in possession twice before the first 45 was out. A Collins passing error in the 44th nearly led to the hosts heading into the locker room trailing. This led to some unfortunate turnovers in possession and close calls on the counter. Di Salvo's team appeared less inclined to take risks after the break.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a much more defensively stable dfb side didn't produce much in the first ten minutes after the restart, despite some strong play down the right involving elias baum and kade. Damar could be audibly heard directing his teammates from the press box as the stadium quieted during the prolonged lull. It would be Damar himself who shook the team out of its torpor with a strike of the crossbar in the 58th minute. Some two minutes later, Kade came close with a header after a nice passing sequence involving Damar and Brunner.

Berdasarkan laporan, damar exited the match alongside teammates aséko and kade on a triple substitution in the 63rd minute. Stassin played the role of provider again in the 65th minute, setting up the freshly subbed-on Romeo Vermant with a cross from the left. Belgian U21 coach Gill Swerts employed his own triple change one minute later. Vermant finished flatly from six meters out centrally. With so many new actors on the pitch, the Germans were unfortunately caught off guard on the transition. It took some time for the DFB ranks to re-settle.

Berdasarkan laporan, once german subs mert kömür and maurice krattenmacher were able to settle in, di salvo's team were once again able to engineer some decent chances. One minute later, Brunner put an effort on target following a high recovery from Krattenmacher. Brunner attempted the spectacular with an overhead finish of a fine Kömür cross in the 71st. Brunner showcased some fancy footwork within the box on subsequent charges, still failing to find the right finish with his final touch. The Monaco professional struck the side-netting in the 73rd.

Berdasarkan laporan, kömür (74th and 81st) tested the belgian keeper twice. On his U21 debut, new Freiburg signing Louey Ben Farhat struck the post on a scintillating effort from 16 meters out in the 84th. A near miss from Collins in the 90th and two promising free-kicks in second-half injury time kept the crowd on its toes. To their credit, the Germans were able to keep matters interesting until the full-time whistle. The equalizer nevertheless didn't come and the match concluded with the guests one goal ahead.

Dennis Seimen (4) – Elias Baum (5), Nnamdi Collins (3), Joshua Quarshie (4), Hennes Behrens (6) – Cajetan Lenz (7), Noël Aséko (7) – Anton Kade (6), Dzenan Pejcinovic (4), Muhammed Damar (9) – Paris Brunner (8).

Substitutes: Laurin Ulrich (5), Maurice Krattenmacher (6), Mert Kömür (7), Leandro Morgalla (6), Louey Ben Farhat (6), Tom Rothe (5), Max Moerstedt (5).

Berdasarkan laporan, the returning wolfsburg attacker covered virtually every blade of grass on the pitch during his 63 minutes of action. Starting on the left wing, Damar frequently rotated across the attacking line, made himself available in central areas, and assumed responsibility for the German attack whenever his teammates struggled to find a way forward. His clever free-kick equalizer and persistent threat from dead-ball situations were the most obvious highlights, but his tireless running, determination in possession, and vocal leadership from the front were equally impressive.

Diungkapkan bahwa damar's performance was not the only encouraging individual display in an otherwise disappointing german defeat. Paris Brunner (8) repeatedly threatened the Belgian defence with his movement, technical skill, and willingness to attempt the spectacular, even if his finishing ultimately let him down. Central midfielders Cajetan Lenz (7) and Noël Aséko (7) also impressed with their energetic contributions, while substitute Mert Kömür (7) helped inject fresh impetus into the German attack during the closing stages.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nevertheless, damar stood apart as the most influential player on the pitch. His return to the U21 national team after a year-long absence could scarcely have produced a more convincing individual performance, even if the team's defensive shortcomings ultimately ensured that his efforts went unrewarded.

#935. Turning 62 in 2027? These 3 Social Security Rules Might Surprise You.

📅 13 Nov 2026

Turning 62 in 2027? These 3 Social Security Rules Might Surprise You.

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.fool.com/retirement/2026/11/13/turning-62-in-2027-these-3-social-security-rules-might-surprise-you/?source=iedfolrf0000001

These things could have unpleasant consequences for your budget if you're not careful.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you're turning 62 in 2027, you have a big decision to make. You could claim Social Security benefits as soon as you're eligible to get the maximum number of checks. Or you could wait a few months or years to apply so that each check is larger.

Berdasarkan laporan, there is no right or wrong here, and a lot depends on your individual circumstances. But if you've been thinking about signing up as soon as you become eligible, there are a few important rules you'll want to be aware of. Let’s review them.

Diungkapkan bahwa you may only claim a social security benefit in your birth month if you were born on the first or second of that month. If you were born on any other day, you don't become eligible until the month following your 62nd birthday.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this has significant implications for your retirement budget, particularly if you're born later in the month. Remember, Social Security benefits go out on either the second, third, or fourth Wednesday of the month following the month in which they're due.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you were born on jan. 21, for example, your first month of eligibility will be February 2027. Those checks will go out on the fourth Wednesday of March. Make sure you have a plan for how you'll cover your expenses while you're waiting on your first check to arrive.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, claiming social security at age 62 carries a 30% early withdrawal penalty if your full retirement age (fra) is 67. This is the case for everyone born in 1960 or later. Exactly how much that shrinks your benefit will vary depending on the size of the checks you initially qualify for. But it will likely knock hundreds of dollars off your monthly payment amount.

Berdasarkan laporan, if this concerns you, you might prefer to wait a few months or years before you apply. It will permanently increase the size of your monthly checks, and it could lead to a bigger lifetime benefit, depending on your life expectancy. However, if you decide to do this, you will have to cover your living expenses on your own for longer.

Diungkapkan bahwa working while under your fra could cause you to lose money to the earnings test if you make more than a certain amount from your job throughout the year. This threshold is higher than the 2026 limits. In 2027, you can lose $1 for every $2 you earn over $25,560 if you'll be under your FRA all year. But it's still low enough that it could cost you entire months of checks if your income is high.

Diungkapkan bahwa money you lose to the earnings test isn't gone forever. The Social Security Administration will give you a one-time benefit boost when you reach your FRA. But that doesn't help you in the short term. Make sure you have another way to cover what your checks won't, or else consider delaying your benefits until you either retire or reach your FRA, when the earnings test no longer applies.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "clubs like to call themselves families. The problem starts when they talk about family as long as it costs nothing, and switch to talking numbers as soon as it becomes expensive," the 57-year-old added.

Diungkapkan bahwa kahn went even further, insisting that fulfilling a contract should not be celebrated as an extraordinary gesture of goodwill. "A club should not pretend that honouring the contract it signed itself is an act of particular humanity. It also bought the risk. The club did not just buy the performance. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the former goalkeeper also drew parallels with manuel neuer's serious leg injury in december 2022. Bayern publicly stood behind their captain before signing Yann Sommer just six weeks later.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "both messages reach the player. But the second one is always heard much louder," Kahn concluded.

Sebagaimana diketahui, musiala remains under contract until 2030, but has endured a difficult period with injuries and neurological issues. Bayern have stressed that continuing his playing career remains medically justifiable.

Sebagaimana diketahui, raiders quarterback fernando mendoza will make his first career start on sunday. Two others will make their debuts, too: Cardinals quarterback Carson Beck and Dolphins quarterback Kyle McCord.

Via NBC Sports research, they’ll become the 48th, 49th, and 50th different quarterbacks to start games during the 2026 season.

It will be only the second time in the last 15 years (excluding the 1987 strike season) during which 50 different quarterbacks have started games in the first 10 weeks of a season.

If, for some reason, another quarterback makes his first start of the season on Sunday (that’s unlikely with Seahawks quarterback Drew Lock not having an injury designation for Sunday), it will be the second-most starters through 10 weeks since 1950.

In 1999, 55 different quarterbacks started games through the first 10 weeks of the season.

Diungkapkan bahwa the federal deposit insurance corporation, the federal reserve board, the national credit union administration, and the office of the comptroller of the currency today announced that they will extend, until december 16, the comment period for proposed guidance on managing risks associated with third-party relationships. Comments on the proposal were originally due November 16.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the proposed guidance reflects the agencies' supervisory experience and lessons learned from examining financial institutions' third-party risk management practices. The proposed guidance takes a principles-based approach and, like all supervisory guidance, is non-binding.

Berdasarkan laporan, when finalized, the federal bank regulatory agencies plan to rescind existing third-party risk management guidance and replace it with the finalized guidance to promote consistency and prudent innovation in the banking industry. NCUA also plans to rescind its existing third-party risk management guidance and will conduct its own reviews to update related guidance as needed.

Also today, the Federal Reserve Board separately announced that it will extend, until December 16, the comment period on a proposed third-party risk management guide specifically for Federal Reserve-supervised traditional community banks.

#949. A trading strategy to ride out the Nvidia uncertainty and generate income in the process

📅 13 Nov 2026

A trading strategy to ride out the Nvidia uncertainty and generate income in the process

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/a-trading-strategy-to-ride-out-the-nvidia-uncertainty-and-generate-income-in-the-process.html

Berdasarkan laporan, jensen huang's abrupt resignation has sent shockwaves through the tech sector, dragging nvidia's (nvda) stock down roughly 30% since oct. 6. The market despises uncertainty, and losing a visionary founder, particularly one without a well-telegraphed succession plan, makes it worse.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, for opportunistic investors, this panic has made the stock cheaper (obviously) while options have become significantly more expensive. While Huang was the architect of Nvidia's AI dominance, the company's moat — superior GPUs, the CUDA software ecosystem, and networking expertise — does not walk out the door with him. Trading in the $160s, Nvidia's valuation has taken a big haircut, yet its underlying business fundamentals remain largely intact. The company's structural advantage in the global artificial intelligence rollout persists.

Diungkapkan bahwa buying good companies at a discount is investing 101, but the current market dynamics may do something else for those who use options. Huang's departure guarantees that Nvidia will be operating under a cloud of transition for the foreseeable future. Executing a permanent CEO search while navigating global regulatory scrutiny takes time. Consequently, Nvidia's implied volatility (IV)—the market's pricing of expected future price swings — has spiked to highs not seen since the tariff tantrum in the first half of 2025, and this elevated IV is highly likely to persist for several months as the leadership drama slowly unfolds.

Berdasarkan laporan, this prolonged period of high implied volatility can be a goldmine for option sellers, specifically those executing options overlays such as covered call strategies. When you buy NVDA shares at these depressed levels and simultaneously sell out-of-the-money call options against your position, the premiums you collect are directly tied to IV. Because fear and transition-related uncertainty have dramatically inflated these option prices, the income generated from selling covered calls is now significantly higher than usual.

Berdasarkan laporan, this lowers the risk profile of holding the stock considerably over time. If the stock trades sideways or recovers slowly during the CEO search, you are generating an outsized cash yield on a stagnant asset. Consistently collecting these inflated premiums systematically lowers your overall cost basis in the underlying shares. If the stock experiences further downside turbulence, the heavy premium income acts as a substantial downside buffer, meaningfully reducing the strategy's overall risk over time.

By deploying a persistent covered call strategy, investors can leverage the exact fear driving the stock down to generate robust, risk-reducing income while maintaining exposure to the undeniable future of AI.
