#951. FAA lifts ground stop after more than four hours, but flight cancellations will stretch into the weekend

📅 13 Nov 2026

FAA lifts ground stop after more than four hours, but flight cancellations will stretch into the weekend

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/faa-ground-stop.html

Berdasarkan laporan, the u. S. halted flight departures across the country for hours on Friday for the second time since 9/11, blaming aging technology that was overloaded, affecting key information for multiple air traffic control centers.

More than 10,000 flights were disrupted during the nationwide ground stop, and delays and cancellations were set to stretch into the weekend, if not longer.

Sebagaimana diketahui, transportation secretary sean duffy said at a press conference late friday that that telecommunications routers were overloaded with data. "They went down," he said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, homeland security secretary markwayne mullin said friday at the white house that there was no indication that the issues were a threat to the united states. He later said at a press conference that it doesn't appear to be a cyber attack, and that it "appears this was mechanically driven. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the federal aviation administration canceled the ground stop at 8:15 p. m. ET Friday after it lasted formore than four hours and disrupted the travel plans of hundreds of thousands of travelers, including some sports teams.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the agency earlier said in post on x that there was a "temporary telecommunications outage" and that it halted flights out of an "abundance of caution. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa when it issued the ground stop at about 4 p. , the FAA said the communications issues were "impacting multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers. m. " These facilities guide airplanes at high altitudes along their routes.

Berdasarkan laporan, while the faa lifted the ground stop, travel chaos continued at airports, which were forced to find places for parked planes. Delays were set to continue even as flights start taking off again.

Sebagaimana diketahui, carriers canceled more flights as the disruption wore on. JetBlue Airways told staff it would cancel the remainder of the day's flights, aside from European routes, as well as others scheduled for Saturday so that crews and planes are in place to resume operations, according to a memo seen by CNBC.

Sebagaimana diketahui, a ground stop halts flights at their departure point. Disruptions tend to snowball if ground stops drag on as flight crews reach their maximum number of duty hours for a day.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, there were 11,000 flights scheduled to depart u. airports after 4 p. S. 5 million passengers. m. ET on Friday, according to flight-data firm Cirium, with 1. There were about 600 diverted flights on Friday, 104 of them sent to other airports, Cirium said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, international flights had started taking off from coastal hubs before 6 p. m. ET.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the faa said earlier in the night that flights will be allowed to depart as en route traffic facilities recover, "through coordination with the air traffic control system. ".

The FAA's technicians are investigating, the agency said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nationwide ground stops are extremely rare. In January 2023, the FAA halted flights because of issues with a pilot alert system. Before that, traffic was halted nationwide after the Sept. 11, 2001, terror attacks.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, technical issues have repeatedly snarled air traffic in the u. S. in recent years. Aging infrastructure and staffing shortages have angered airline executives for years.

Diungkapkan bahwa in september, hundreds of flights into newark, new jersey, and philadelphia were canceled, delayed or diverted after a verizon fiber cable was accidentally cut. Officials said it occurred during construction in New Jersey, severing a backup feed of key data for air traffic controllers.

Diungkapkan bahwa in 2025, air traffic controllers lost contact with aircraft heading to and from newark liberty international airport, an equipment failure that led to massive flight delays and raised more concerns about aging u. S. aviation infrastructure and staffing shortages.

Berdasarkan laporan, "it's going to continue to fail," duffy said friday of u. S. The U. air traffic control infrastructure. S. is in the middle of an overhaul of the technology, and Duffy urged lawmakers for more funding.

Inbound international flights will be managed on a case by case basis, the FAA said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the major u. S. airlines issued statements saying they would work with customers who were affected by the ground stop and encouraged travelers to check for updates.

#959. Burnt Hills-Ballston Lake edges Troy in final seconds for epic Class A football title win

📅 14 Nov 2026

Burnt Hills-Ballston Lake edges Troy in final seconds for epic Class A football title win

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/burnt-hills-ballston-lake-edges-054851444.html

COLONIE - The waning stages of the fourth quarter Friday night for the Burnt Hills-Ballston Lake football team were looking painfully dire, as the Spartans found themselves down a point against Troy and forced to give the ball back on a punt.

In a span of a few minutes, BH-BL senior standout Login Tomlinson made two of the biggest plays of his career - the first with his hand and the second with his foot - to flip things back in favor of his team in the Section 2 Class A Super Bowl.

Berdasarkan laporan, first, tomlinson forced troy junior quarterback kyair carr to fumble the ball away at the flying horses' 23-yard line. Then, BH-BL had just 17 seconds left when it had Tomlinson line up for a 32-yard field goal on third down and without a timeout remaining. The senior - following a timeout by Troy - drilled a go-ahead, line-drive boot down the middle in what ended up being a thrilling 23-21 Super Bowl victory over the Flying Horses at Colonie High School.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i have been dreaming about this since i was a little kid and first starting kicking," said tomlinson, a four-year varsity player who is headed to siena university to play lacrosse. "It happened. It came true. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, "it was really nerve-racking out there," bh-bl junior quarterback tristan west said. "I believed in him every moment when he went out there to kick. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the pulse-pounding triumph secured bh-bl (11-0) the program's 11th class a sectional title in 20 years, and first since 2021. It also marked the first championship guided by fourth-year coach Kevin DeBonis. The loss denied Troy, playing in its second straight Super Bowl, a 10th title since first winning one in 1993.

Berdasarkan laporan, "this feels amazing. Since we were little kids, this is what we have been working for," West said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, last year, the flying horses lost to niskayuna. Troy senior fullback/defensive Ben Mergil, who produced two touchdown receptions and recovered a fumble by BH-BL, emerged from an emotional postgame gathering to put the defeat into context.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "it is hard, but, at the end of the day, it is football," mergil said. I want to thank my coaches, my teammates and God for giving me this opportunity to play for such an amazing school and play my heart out. "Anybody that has ever played football knows it will teach life lessons. Sometimes, things just don't shake out for you, but you just have to roll with the punches. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, both squads left everything they had on the field. There were colossal swings of momentum swapped between the two teams all evening, especially down the stretch.

Sebagaimana diketahui, troy led 14-0 and went to halftime up 14-6. West connected with Michael Bies for a 21-yard touchdown pass and Owen Huggins scored on a 2-point conversion to provide BH-BL its first lead at 20-14, but Troy senior running back Nymiear Jenkins - lined up in a wildcat formation - found Mergil on a 6-yard touchdown pass with 3:32 left to tie the score. Troy freshman kicker Crosby Murray booted the extra point through the uprights to provide Troy a 21-20 advantage.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i really thought when we went ahead, our defense would get the stop and we did," mergil said. "We went out there to run out the clock and things sometimes don't shake out the way you want. ".

Troy had the chance to run out the clock after stopping BH-BL and forcing a punt with 2:27 left, but Tomlinson helped set up the game-clinching sequence by punching the ball away from Carr on a first-down run down the Troy sideline.

Berdasarkan laporan, tomlinson saved his best for last. Originally summoned to the varsity as a freshman to be a kicker and punter, the senior has excelled at linebacker over the last three years. Friday, he reminded everyone how good of a kicker he is with the biggest field goal of his career.

"That is a hell of a play, and a hell of a player," Mergil said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "this was a true nail-bitter. "We knew it was going to be a close game and it feels great to come out with a 'W. We knew Troy was going to be tough to beat and real physical," West said. '".

124: Rushing yards turned in by Carr on 21 attempts.

3: Turnovers that Burnt Hills-Ballston Lake committed in the first half.

2: Total field goals this season for Tomlinson after Friday's game-winning kick.

Troy: The season came to a painful close for the Flying Horses with an 8-3 overall record.

Burnt Hills-Ballston Lake: The Spartans return to Colonie High School next Friday for a state quarterfinal contest against Section 9 champion Cornwall (8-3), a 27-26 winner over Washingtonville.

Berdasarkan laporan, jensen huang is out at nvidia. Washington is just getting started with him and the company he co-founded.

Diungkapkan bahwa huang, the leather-jacket-clad ceo of the world's most important chipmaker, resigned from nvidia on thursday after revelations that he had an affair with a suspected chinese spy. S. But the spy saga is gripping Washington, and lawmakers are preparing for investigations into how the now-ex-CEO's affair may have damaged U. artificial intelligence dominance, the national security implications and the executive's close relationship with President Donald Trump and his Cabinet.

Berdasarkan laporan, republicans will have their chance first during their last six weeks controlling both chambers of congress. GOP leaders immediately summoned Huang to Capitol Hill and said they would subpoena him if he doesn't agree to show up. In January, Democrats, who are already eager to make their mark with oversight when they take over the U. S. House and Senate, will be in the driver's seat.

Diungkapkan bahwa "in this environment where there's some really high stakes when it comes to our national security, i would expect there would be some follow-up, yeah," senate majority leader john thune, r-s. D. , told reporters at the Capitol on Thursday.

Berdasarkan laporan, huang and the woman with whom he reportedly had a relationship, alice huang, an executive at the singaporean technology company megaspeed and an alleged chinese spy have drawn congressional attention. And Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has drawn fire after reports this week that he stalled President Donald Trump's crackdowns on firms routing Nvidia chips to China.

Some Congress members have also called for an investigation into the role of the Bureau of Industry and Security, a subagency of the Commerce Department that manages and enforces export controls, in the Huang scandal.

Berdasarkan laporan, the new york times reported on monday that nvidia's general counsel, tim teter, claimed in emails to commerce investigators probing alice huang's company that he'd been in touch with jeffrey kessler, who leads bis. The Commerce investigation into Megaspeed, which allegedly smuggled restricted chips to China, was then transferred to the Justice Department.

Sebagaimana diketahui, by thursday night, senate banking committee chair tim scott, r-s. C. , summoned both Huang and Lutnick to testify before his committee in December. Later that same night, Lutnick had "proactively agreed to appear voluntarily before the Banking Committee to address their questions," Kristen Eichamer, a Commerce Department spokesperson, said in a statement.

Diungkapkan bahwa scott threatened to subpoena huang if he does not appear. A banking panel spokesperson did not immediately respond Friday morning when asked if they'd heard from Huang.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "recent reports raise serious concerns about our national security and the protection of sensitive u. S. technology," Scott wrote to Huang. "The American people deserve answers. ".

And with Democrats poised to take control of both chambers come January, the tech mogul's close ties to the White House will add fuel to an already burning fire as the new majority spools up myriad investigations into the Trump administration.

Sebagaimana diketahui, senate minority leader chuck schumer, d-n. Y. Huang and others at Nvidia about how they may have put U. , in a post to X on Thursday, said "Congress must demand answers from Mr. national security at risk. S. " Schumer is in a contested race to become Senate majority leader in the next Congress.

The senators who will lead those investigations, and hold subpoena power in the new Congress, are gearing up for Nvidia to take center stage.

Diungkapkan bahwa sen. S. Elizabeth Warren, D-Mass. , the likely incoming chair of the Senate banking panel, said in a statement Thursday that "Mr. Huang, NVIDIA executives, and NVIDIA's board of directors still owe Congress answers about the company's compliance with U. export controls.

Diungkapkan bahwa warren and sen. , the top Democrat on the Senate Foreign Relations subpanel with jurisdiction over East Asia and the Pacific, sent a letter Wednesday to Lutnick, Secretary of State Marco Rubio and White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller instructing them to preserve all documents and communications related to Nvidia's exports of "advanced AI chips to China or to entities that may divert such chips to China. Chris Coons, D-Del. ".

Even before Democrats take control in January, Huang is expected to appear before Congress.

Berdasarkan laporan, house foreign affairs committee chair brian mast, r-fla. , is actively negotiating for Huang to testify before House committees and told reporters Thursday the Nvidia CEO has agreed to appear in the coming weeks.

Diungkapkan bahwa details of that testimony are still being worked out, mast said. It would likely include his committee, as well as the House intelligence panel and the House Permanent Select Committee on China, and it would be under oath and transcribed. It's not clear at this point whether it would be public.

"We want to see him basically in a week … Sooner rather than later," Mast told reporters Thursday, adding that he believed it would happen before Thanksgiving.

If Huang doesn't willingly appear, Mast said he will subpoena him.

Diungkapkan bahwa mast, along with house select china committee chair rep. John Moolenaar, R-Mich. m. Rick Crawford, R-Ark. , sent a second request Thursday to Huang and Teter requesting they appear and giving them an 8 p. , and House Intelligence Committee Chair Rep. ET Friday deadline to respond. Mast also sent a second request to Kessler.

Diungkapkan bahwa rep. Josh Gottheimer, D-N. J. , a member of the House Intelligence Committee, said Friday during an appearance on CNBC's "The Exchange" that he wants answers from Huang on the national security and export implications of the affair.

Berdasarkan laporan, "from an intelligence committee perspective, you can imagine from an ai perspective, how important this is for our national security, for our critical infrastructure and understand when it comes to chip policy, what exactly got to china and. did Megaspeed divert chips?" Gottheimer said.

Berdasarkan laporan, the calls for immediate investigation into huang and nvidia on the day of his resignation represent a stunning fall from grace in the halls of power for the former ceo. Huang was one of the most effective voices for the AI industry in Washington — able to toggle between leveraging his relationship with Trump and defending his industry from fears about AI's risks to lawmakers.

Diungkapkan bahwa "he is always the ted talk guy," one senior democratic staff member who was granted anonymity to describe private meetings they had attended with huang, told cnbc. "He's really good and articulate, and really good at explaining why AI is important and why it's so important for the United States to be leading here. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the staffer said huang was a "happy warrior" for ai, and stayed longer than scheduled or anticipated for questions from lawmakers. But in the meetings with lawmakers the aide attended, they said Huang did not aggressively push against export controls or get too "deep in the weeds" to really "lobby one way or the other" with the lawmakers.

Huang has repeatedly resisted export controls publicly, a move that has rubbed some lawmakers the wrong way.

Some lawmakers even lamented the loss of Huang, despite the inevitable buzzsaw he now faces on Capitol Hill.

Berdasarkan laporan, "it's just sad all around," sen. John Fetterman, D-Pa. , said of Huang's resignation.

#963. Game Day: Louisville at North Carolina

📅 14 Nov 2026

Game Day: Louisville at North Carolina

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/game-day-louisville-north-carolina-050000502.html

Sebagaimana diketahui, location: kenan stadium: chapel hill, n. C.

Announcers: Mike Couzens (play-by-play), Tom Luginbill (analyst), and Lauren Sisler (sidelines).

Sebagaimana diketahui, last meeting: louisville won 47-35 on sept. 9, 2017 in Chapel Hill.

Berdasarkan laporan, bill belichick had a poor start to his tenure at unc last year, with the main issues being on the offensive side of the ball. He remedied that issue this year by going out and hiring none other than Bobby Petrino to be his offensive coordinator. Petrino had been bouncing around at a few spots since being fired by Louisville, but his offensive acumen is still coveted. The Tar Heels have improved on offense, though they still rank toward the bottom of the rankings in some key offensive metrics.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as always, an offense is only as good as its quarterback, and the tar heels are average with billy edwards under center. The veteran transfer quarterback has played about as well as most expected him to this season. His inconsistent play has been an issue for this offense, and it has contributed to a couple of the losses this year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as the season has gone on, he has played better, with his last two games being his best. He came back the following weekend to complete 76% of his passes against a solid UConn team. He torched Miami's defense for four touchdowns while completing 82% of his passes. Edwards isn't one of the top quarterbacks Louisville has seen this season, but he has played like one recently.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unc has three running backs that they can rely on, and they play all three of them. Demon June leads the group in touchdowns with 8 on the season. Benjamin Hall leads the group in yards and yards per carry. They are all over 220 pounds, and Petrino has done a good job of utilizing them this season. Jaylin Mcgill leads the group in yards per play as he is a factor as a receiver out of the backfield. The staff likes to ride the hot hand with this group, so we will have to wait to see which player gets the most touches.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, louisville will face another opponent that has a single key player at the wide receiver position this weekend. He is a fluid athlete with good body control which he uses to make contested catches and catches in tight spots. Shipp has good size at 6-2/200, and he can really move. Jordan Shipp is one of the more talented players the Cards will face this year, and they will need to have a plan. He is not a burner in the open field, but he has plenty of speed to score on a long play if he gets open.

Diungkapkan bahwa the biggest threat on this offense is at tight end in jelani thurman. He has already set the school record for touchdowns by a tight end with 8, which is the most in the country among tight ends. Lincoln Keinholz' former teammate at Ohio State has had a similar situation as he did not make much of an impact for the Buckeyes, but he has emerged as one of the best tight ends in the country for UNC. He also ranks in the top five in just about every receiving category when it comes to tight ends.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this team doesn't create a lot of big passing plays, but when they do it is down the middle of the field to thurman, or because he pulls defenders with him. Petrino is known for working deep over routes throughout his career, but this team has killed teams down the seams. Louisville's defense has been victimized many times on seam routes this year, so they will need to adjust their plan from their normal reliance on Cover 3.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the unc offensive line has been pretty average this year, especially from a run blocking standpoint. Billy Edwards is just a big better than being a statue in the pocket, so he is not one to avoid the rush if it gets to him. They don't allow a lot of penetration, but they haven't been opening massive holes for the running backs, either. It has not helped that his line has struggled with speed rushers this year. Where they have struggled is being consistent in pass protection. The Cards should have an opportunity to get pressure this weekend.

Sebagaimana diketahui, defense is bill belichick's forte, and the north carolina tar heels are benefiting from his expertise this year. For the second straight year, Belichick has his defense ranked in the top 50 in yards per play. His group is being led by his son Brian after his son Steve left the team earlier this season. While the defense has taken a step back this year, they have played well enough to keep the Tar Heels in each game, and they've made big plays at big moments.

Berdasarkan laporan, the most talented group on this team is the defensive line, with a couple of nfl prospects. Melkart Abou Jaoude is the returning ACC leader in sacks, while Jaylen Harvey has been a very good addition from Penn State with 21 pressures this season. The edges of this defense haven't put up crazy numbers from a havoc standpoint, but they will be key players for this defense if Louisville continues to attack the edges of the defense.

Berdasarkan laporan, the interior of the line is where this defense is at its best. The 6-0/260 tackle is extremely undersized, but he is very quick, and he uses his quickness to beat blocks to get into the backfield. Xavier Lewis is one of the best defensive tackles in the country. He is in the top five in pressures, tackles for loss, and sacks among his position group. He will be a key player in this game and will likely cause some issues for Louisville's offensive line.

Sebagaimana diketahui, isaiah johnson and leroy jackson are the other top players on the interior of the defense. Johnson is big enough to demand a double team, which has been a factor in Lewis' big season. Jackson has 14 pressures on the season as the main backup for Lewis, but he and Johnson provide really good size on the inside as well. He has been able to get one-on-one matchups often, and that has not gone well for offensive linemen.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unc's linebackers have benefited more than just about anyone from the strong play of the defensive line. Louisville has adapted their running game over the last few weeks, but they will likely have a hard time running the stretch zone runs that they really like. Derek McDonald and Peyton Sheelmann are averaging 19 tackles a game between the two of them. Both players are ranked in the top 25 in tackles nationally, and they are constantly running free when you watch their games. These two guys can run, and they will have a lot of space to get downhill to make tackles behind the line.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, jaiden patterson leads a solid cornerback group that has played at an average level this season. Umari Hatcher, Jordon Faison, Calvin Russell, and Bryant Wesco all stood out to me when I watched their games. UNC has given up a lot of yardage this season, but they are better when it comes to metrics like passer rating. The corners have had some issues against the top players they've seen this year. Those receivers were able to get open and make big plays on the outside.

Berdasarkan laporan, the biggest playmaker outside of the defensive linemen is greg smith at free safety. Smith can also come down into the box in run support or cover if needed. He's having one of the best seasons in the ACC at safety. He leads the team with 3 interceptions this year, and he's at his best as a deep safety playing center field. While this secondary isn't great, they do have a couple of players who can make a play on the ball, which is not something I would say about the last few opponents for the Cards.

Give me an SMU win over Wake at noon and a Cards win in Chapel Hill, and the EL is probably back up to where we want it to be for next week's home/conference finale against Pitt.

Diungkapkan bahwa —despite louisville being a member of the acc since 2014, this will be just the second time u of l has faced north carolina as a member of the conference. The Cardinals have not faced any other conference opponent fewer times than it's faced the Tar Heels, and league newcomer Cal is the only other ACC opponent Louisville has played just once.

—North Carolina will celebrate both Homecoming and Military Appreciation Night on Saturday.

—NorthCarolina is in its 136th season of football (139th year) and the Tar Heels own an all-time record of 760-588-54.

—Louisville's 44 points at Georgia Tech last week were its most on the road under Jeff Brohm and the most in any road game since a 62-22 throttling at Duke in 2021.

Diungkapkan bahwa —louisville's offense enters the weekend ranked sixth nationally in points per game at 40. 8.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, —louisville has scored at least 27 points in all nine of its games so far this season. Boise State is the only other FBS team to have accomplished that feat.

Sebagaimana diketahui, —north carolina offensive coordinator bobby petrino did three stints on the louisville coaching staff, including two as head coach. Petrino coached the Cards from 2003-06 and 2014-18, going 77-35 in nine seasons. Petrino is also the brother of U of L tight ends coach Paul Petrino.

—As the head coach at Louisville, Bobby Petrino was 3-0 in games against North Carolina.

Sebagaimana diketahui, —north carolina's defense is allowing opponents to convert on 44. 1 percent of their third down tries, good for 121st in the country.

—UNC quarterbacks coach Matt Lombardi began his coaching career at Louisville working as a special teams quality control coach in 2014 before working with tight ends as a graduate assistant in 2015-16.

Berdasarkan laporan, —north carolina wide receivers coach garrick mcgee has twice previously worked at louisville. McGee was the offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach in 2014-15 and then the wide receivers coach under Jeff Brohm from 2023-24.

In a key test flight on Friday, SpaceX tried but failed to recover both stages of its massive Starship rocket.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the rocket lifted off from the company's south texas launch facility at 4:47 p. m. local time, or 5:47 p. m. ET. SpaceX had to abort its plans to catch and reuse the booster, instead diverting it to splash into the Gulf of Mexico, where it burst into flames.

Test Flight 15, the most ambitious Starship mission to date, was the first time Elon Musk's company attempted to catch both the booster and upper stage, or spacecraft portion, of the massive rocket.

Berdasarkan laporan, earlier on friday, spacex obtained authorization from the federal aviation administration. Hours later, the FAA issued a nationwide ground stop after reporting communication problems affecting "multiple" air traffic control centers. The SpaceX license wasn't effected by the flight stoppage, a spokesperson for the FAA told CNBC.

Berdasarkan laporan, the upper stage of the starship continued its trajectory into orbit after the company failed to catch and salvage the booster. The rocket is expected to fly around the Earth fourteen times in total. If successful, SpaceX will land the upper stage back at its Starbase facility on Saturday.

Sebagaimana diketahui, starship's success is critical to spacex and its ambitions to eventually lift cargo and people to the surface of the moon and mars. In the near-term, SpaceX needs to send more satellites into orbit to expands its Starlink satellite internet service, which is currently the company's profit center.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the company's constellation already includes over 11,000 active satellites in low earth orbit. One Starship rocket has the capacity to carry up to 60 Starlink v3 satellites into orbit, the company has said, representing about 20 times the capacity of earlier Falcon 9 rockets.

In the previous Starship test flight, the company released 26 v3 satellites, and released another 26 in the Friday test flight, with the goal of "Starlink becoming 51% of the internet," SpaceX said in a post on X.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when it comes to launches, "spacex is likely a full decade ahead of peers on this front," william blair analysts wrote in a note out on friday. "Even if tonight's catch is unsuccessful, a delay by a few months is not that consequential. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, meanwhile, spacex is facing fresh criticism over restrictions imposed on its starshield satellite internet service in ukraine. Starshield is built on Starlink technology and is the military-tier of SpaceX's satellite internet service.

Berdasarkan laporan, earlier this week, ukraine president volodymyr zelenskyy said his country's military forces had experienced limits on starshield without warning again, harming their ability to defend against russia's ongoing aerial attacks. Similar limits on Starshield in Ukraine were temporarily imposed last month.

Diungkapkan bahwa some u. S. senators have condemned the restrictions, and urged Congress to investigate SpaceX.

#968. Jerry Jones reveals when he thinks NFL expands to 18-game season, but process to get there is complicated

📅 13 Nov 2026

Jerry Jones reveals when he thinks NFL expands to 18-game season, but process to get there is complicated

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/jerry-jones-on-nfl-expansion-18-game-regular-season/

If not listed, please contact your TV provider.

The National Football League regular season could be expanding once again.

Sebagaimana diketahui, from 1978 to 2020, the nfl played a 16-game regular season, but that changed in 2021 as the league expanded to a 17-game regular season. However, Dallas Cowboys owner Jerry Jones, one of the league's most influential voices, feels an expansion to an 18th regular-season game is just around the corner.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i don't think we're far away from it," jones said friday, via 105. That has to be negotiated with the players, but it's in everybody's best interest. 3 The Fan in Dallas. "What is far away? Next month? No. Next year, maybe. Next year? Next year, maybe. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa why would a greater physical toll in the regular season benefit the league's players playing one of the most violent sports? jones claims the compromise would be to trim the nfl preseason once again. Teams typically play three exhibition games as a warm-up and to evaluate the back-end depth on their respective rosters. Two teams end up playing four preseason games if they participate in the "Hall of Fame Game" centered around the Pro Football Hall of Fame enshrinements in August.

Berdasarkan laporan, jones feels simply erasing more preseason games and having the early regular season games, which already have a preseason feeling to them, is in everyone's best interest, players included. The NFL would certainly be in a position to ask for more money on its next media rights deals with its broadcast partners in that scenario. The league signed its current 11-year, $110 billion media rights deal with CBS, FOX, NBC, ESPN/ABC and Amazon Prime Video in 2023.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "you would cut back on the preseason games," jones said. "You would have teams develop more in the first few games as the type of thing you're trying to get done in the preseason, but it's in everybody's interest. It certainly is in the player's best interest, in my mind, for sure. Having said that, I would anticipate that coming. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the league's current cba with the players' union is locked in through the 2030 season, so any tweaks to the regular season would necessitate additional negotiation between the league and the union. Commissioner Roger Goodell didn't see an 18-game regular season on the horizon like Jones does now when he addressed the topic at Super Bowl LX in February.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we have not had any formal discussions about it and frankly very little of any informal conversations," goodell told reporters back in february. It's not something we assume will happen. It's something we want to talk about with the union leadership. "It is not a given that we will do that. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one league source voiced concern to cbs sports about increased injuries in an 18-game regular season in april. That is believed to be the biggest holdup to adding an additional regular-season game.

Berdasarkan laporan, "the bigger concern is now we're going to add another game, even if you multiply everything out with sensible assumptions, there are going to be more injuries," a league source told cbs sports in april. There are going to be season-enders and next-season-enders in Week 18 and 19. "And it won't just be hamstrings. That's the biggest sticking point on the field. ".

One player, who requested anonymity, also told CBS Sports in April that some of the NFL's top stars could sit out games at the end of an extended 18-game season to charge up for the playoffs or to reduce the risk of injury.

Diungkapkan bahwa "the nfl's issue will be more related to getting top players to play in games beyond playoff contention, which i believe get exacerbated the more regular season games they play," the player told cbs sports in april. "Top players will check themselves out more because games that don't matter late in the season will happen more often. ".

While Jones has been able to bring many major changes to his Cowboys and the league at large over the years, an expansion to an 18-game regular season may be a little more complicated than he thinks.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the cavs are still figuring some things out, and are far from a finished product. But if you wanted something positive to hang your hat on early in the season, it's the fact that the supporting pieces have the potential to change how this team plays.

The Cavs will have a tough time winning playoff series this spring if Mitchell or Harden lay an egg. Maybe Watson's ability to recover defensively alters how the two-big front line operates defensively and further insulates the guards. Maybe Proctor can help bring the ball up against the press, alleviating that burden from the stars.

That could make a huge difference if the stars can get healthy and more in sync than they have been.

#982. Tariffs Pushed Prices Up. Why Retail and Industrial Investors Shouldn't Expect a Quick Reversal

📅 14 Nov 2026

Tariffs Pushed Prices Up. Why Retail and Industrial Investors Shouldn't Expect a Quick Reversal

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/11/13/tariffs-pushed-prices-up-why-retail-and-industrial/?source=iedfolrf0000001

Tariffs are a moving target, and rising costs tend to be sticky, which is bad news for companies and retail customers.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, u. That, in turn, is likely to lead to price increases caused by tariffs being sticky. Given the uncertainty, it is difficult for a manufacturer to make long-term plans. But the truth is, inflation is generally sticky, and companies and consumers shouldn't expect a quick reversal of the impacts of tariffs. tariff policy has been unpredictable, which is a big problem for companies and consumers alike. S. Here's what you need to know.

Diungkapkan bahwa in the third quarter of 2026, industrial giant caterpillar (cat -0. That was roughly in line with the impact in the third quarter of 2025. 84%) reported that tariff costs amounted to $600 million. At the same time, the company recognized $128 million in tariff recoveries in the third quarter of 2026. There are a lot of moving parts, but the big picture is that tariffs are still a big issue for the heavy equipment manufacturer.

Berdasarkan laporan, meanwhile, the company has been facing higher manufacturing costs, driven partly by freight costs. There's a lot that goes into freight costs, notably including today's high energy prices. So there's more going on than just tariffs on the cost front, which is important to consider when you think about the tariff situation reversing.

Diungkapkan bahwa notably, consumer staples companies like pepsico (pep +2. 23%) have been dealing with input cost inflation, which this snack and soda giant highlighted as an issue in its third-quarter 2026 earnings update. The impact of tariffs and broader inflation is working through the entire supply chain, which is a process that is hard to reverse. Add in the uncertainty around the implementation of tariffs, and companies aren't likely to rush to roll back any price increases they've pushed through.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you look at tariffs as just another form of inflation, the impact isn't all that difficult to understand. Rising prices flow through the economy, starting with raw materials, moving on to manufacturers, then to retailers, and finally hitting end consumers. At each step along the way, rising costs are passed on to the next entity until they hit your pocketbook.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the costs get passed along because companies are attempting to protect their profit margins. And, not knowing what to expect next, it makes business sense to continue passing its higher costs on to its customers as best it can. As Cat shows, even with the tariff rebates it collected, it still had to bear significant tariff costs. The same is true for PepsiCo or any other company that directly touches consumers. For example, Target (TGT +0. 34%) isn't likely to lower prices on products bought overseas if it can't be sure it can maintain that lower price and still make a profit.

Diungkapkan bahwa meanwhile, these companies are still facing inflation in other areas. As those costs work through the system, too, protecting margins becomes an even more difficult task. Rolling prices back simply isn't something that companies do quickly, if they do it at all.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, adjusting supply chains isn't a complete solution, either. While that may help companies avoid tariffs, relocating production or sourcing from a different region often entails higher costs. Those costs are baked in and can't be easily reduced, so prices end up permanently higher.

Berdasarkan laporan, it isn't easy for companies to raise prices. Add in the uncertainty around tariffs, and the reluctance to roll back price increases is likely to be even higher. This is why companies like PepsiCo change package sizes while keeping the price the same, which is a way to raise prices without actually announcing a price increase. But once a price increase is implemented and accepted by customers, there is great reluctance to roll it back. They face pushback throughout the supply chain because nobody wants to pay more for the same thing they bought before. In other words, don't expect a quick reversal of the tariff impact.

#983. AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system, Fed survey finds

AI risks are the biggest threat to the financial system, Fed survey finds

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/13/ai-risks-financial-system-federal-reserve.html

Threats from artificial intelligence topped the list for greatest risks to the financial system, far exceeding any other dangers, according to respondents who participated in a Federal Reserve survey released Friday.

The central bank's twice-yearly look at a variety of dangers saw a surge in respondents saying that the biggest danger comes from AI along several fronts including debt, stock market valuations and security risks.

"Respondents noted three distinct areas of concern: (1) elevated equity valuations and the possibility that lower-than-expected earnings could result in lower valuations and a market correction; (2) cybersecurity risk, stemming from either a malicious attack by sophisticated state actors or damage caused by frontier AI models themselves; and (3) risks associated with complex forms of AI-related financing," the report stated.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the report comes with wall street on edge over high-flying ai hyperscalers, while communities are on alert for the rapid spread of data centers used to power the technology. Some 56% of voters in this month's midterm elections said data centers were of crucial or major importance in their choices, according to exit polling.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, respondents to the fed survey released friday include a variety of market participants, economists, analysts and institutional sources. The report covers the period up to Oct. 28, just a few days shy of the election.

Sebagaimana diketahui, of the group, 87% cited ai as a "salient risk" to the system. That was up from 50% in the survey during the spring of this year and well ahead of the next most-cited danger, a risk asset correction, which was mentioned by 52% of those surveyed.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, other leading risks were higher long-term rates (48%), cyberattacks (43%) and fiscal debt sustainability (43%), the latter coming with the u. S. debt over $40 trillion and the budget deficit near $2 trillion.

The report otherwise found the system fairly stable, though it mentioned that hedge fund leverage is at its highest since 2013 and concentrated on a relatively small group.

#1001. They train people to avoid 'honeypot' scams—here are the common red flags they spot: 'It feels so good to be wanted'

📅 13 Nov 2026

They train people to avoid 'honeypot' scams—here are the common red flags they spot: 'It feels so good to be wanted'

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/make-it/2026/11/13/honeypot-scam-red-flags.html

Diungkapkan bahwa shawnee delaney often kicks off a training session by telling a room full of corporate workers: "ok, raise your hand if you've ever gotten a flattering message on linkedin just complimenting your background and your profile and your experience. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, "every hand goes up," she says. Then, she tells attendees how responding to a simple adulatory message could unwittingly open the door to a potential romance scam.

Diungkapkan bahwa delaney is a corporate security expert, well-versed in teaching people how to avoid “honeypot” schemes, in which a bad actor uses romantic or sexual interest to build trust and gain information, access or leverage over a target. The term is currently making headlines in the wake of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation from the company, following reporting on his admitted affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, honeypots, also known as "honey traps," are a very human form of social engineering attack, a category that also includes various forms of phishing and use of deepfake technology. And you don't have to be a billionaire tech CEO to possess information that scammers may value.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as competition in the global artificial intelligence race heats up, openai is reportedly training employees to recognize espionage tactics including bribery, romantic manipulation and blackmail, according to the wall street journal. On Nov. 3, cryptocurrency exchange Binance revealed that a recent cyberattack — which saw roughly $6 billion of digital assets stolen — was partially made possible by a fake job interview scheme that infected an employee’s work computer with malware.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "people can get solicited, bribed, romanced, etc. ," says Kevin Tian, co-founder and CEO of Doppel, an AI-powered platform meant to help identify and deflect social engineering attacks. He adds: "If you've got access to sensitive IP [intellectual property] — it's not just AI companies — you can be a target. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa increasingly, scammers can use ai to scour websites ranging from reddit to pinterest for an individual's personal information and customize a ploy designed specifically for them, tian says. C. Once they have relevant data points, attackers tend to use "the oldest tricks in the book: elicitation, flattery, ego," says Delaney, a former intelligence officer with the Defense Intelligence Agency and the founder and CEO of Washington, D. -based corporate security consulting firm Vaillance Group.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in many cases, delaney notes, targets have an inkling that something is suspicious — but they'd rather allow themselves to believe the interest is legitimate. So how do you keep yourself from falling victim? Trust your self-awareness, common sense and ability to identify situations that feel too good to be true, she says.

Berdasarkan laporan, "the bottom line is, we're all human," says delaney, adding: "it feels so good to be wanted, or to be respected, or to be appreciated, or loved. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, delaney, who has worked with fortune 500 companies such as uber and merck, advises corporate clients on cybersecurity risks and develops training programs to improve employees' awareness of security threats. Her sessions aim to build awareness of manipulative connections, such as romance scams, from how they begin to the natural progression they often take. "Introduction, then repeated contact, favors, sensitive requests — the secrecy, the pressure," she says.

Sebagaimana diketahui, bad actors may tap into any information you post online to find an interest that can be mirrored and exploited, or an acquaintance who can be infiltrated and make an introduction. If someone you know and trust makes an introduction, you might be less likely to "go do due diligence" on the new person, even if they're a stranger, Delaney says.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one of vaillance's services includes building a "targeting package" around an executive or c-suite member, says delaney. "That's when people's eyes open. "We can show how they are vulnerable and how we would target that organization just by leveraging the people around them in that circle: spouses, friends, kids, parents, administrative assistants, neighbors," she says. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa from there, she discusses red flags to spot. Conversations that begin with flattery and seemingly innocuous small talk can gradually shift toward digging for information, introductions to colleagues or access to documents, says Delaney. It's human nature to want to be helpful and fulfill friendly requests, she adds. Add a potential romantic connection to the mix, especially amid an ongoing "loneliness epidemic," and the urge to comply can be even harder to resist, she says.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you feel yourself getting cornered in a situation where a recent acquaintance or romantic partner keeps asking for information you're not comfortable revealing, delaney says it helps to have first practiced polite refusal. You can say you don't know. "One of my favorites is: They could just respond with: 'Why do you ask?'" she says. You could give a nondescript answer. You can say you can't respond. "Put the other person on the defensive. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, if you're ever suspicious of a new connection — even if you don't want to be — do yourself a favor and conduct some basic vetting, she recommends. You might examine their social media profiles and other publicly available information, for example, to see if their story checks out.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you can't find enough information to allay your suspicions, don't be shy about alerting your employer's security or human resources team, she says. For smaller companies, or scams outside the workplace, you can file a complaint for cyber threats or romance scams with the Federal Bureau of Investigation's Internet Crime Complaint Center.

And pay attention if your new paramour starts asking you specific questions about your finances or work credentials, says Delaney.

"If you have no game at home, and you get off an airplane somewhere and suddenly everyone's all over you, we call that a red flag," she says.

#1009. Hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance—2 habits that take 'a few seconds' can help you avoid similar traps

📅 13 Nov 2026

Hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance—2 habits that take 'a few seconds' can help you avoid similar traps

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/make-it/2026/11/13/binance-hack-2-online-habits-that-can-help-you-avoid-scams-.html

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the biggest heist in cryptocurrency history began with small mistakes many internet users make. 3 billion from the crypto exchange Binance. A hacking group tied to North Korea recently stole $6. The operation was sophisticated, involving fake job interviews and malicious code.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but it was also mundane. Although artificial intelligence played a role in the hack, this was not a cyberattack of the future, propelled by swarms of AI agents. Rather, it relied on humans who made some basic errors, like clicking a link because it appeared first on a search results page or trusting strangers at a fake company without taking a few seconds to look them up.

We work at the Digital Inquiry Group, a nonprofit that researches how people evaluate online information and creates free, evidence-based curriculum that helps people decide what to trust.

Diungkapkan bahwa in over a decade of research, we've found that people frequently engage in online behavior that makes them more likely to get duped. Two simple strategies can help you better navigate today's information landscape, from traditional phishing to misleading social posts to AI fakes. Here's how.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the binance heist began when one of the company's engineers downloaded compromised software. That engineer, according to the Reuters investigation of the hack, clicked on a sponsored search result that appeared higher on the results page and directed them to the malicious code.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, our research at the digital inquiry group suggests internet users frequently behave as if first is best. They click on the first thing they see. Students have gone so far as to tell us "Google is almost never wrong" or "AI is always right. They incorrectly associate a higher placement with vetted content, ceding judgment to tech company algorithms. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, professional fact-checkers commonly practice click restraint. They understand that whether you're searching on the internet or querying a chatbot, first isn't always best. If you're researching an organization, the first link will often be to its own site, which is hardly likely to disclose anything that's wrong with it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so the next time you search for something online, be wary of links to sponsored content, the organization you're investigating, or to open platforms where anyone can post and information isn't verified, such as quora or reddit. Read the brief snippets beneath each link, and make a more informed choice about what to open.

Always ask yourself: Who is behind this information? What makes them credible? Look for people and organizations that have direct expertise on the topic at hand, or have processes to ensure the accuracy of information, such as news outlets that employ editors and fact-checkers.

Sebagaimana diketahui, binance says it caught that first malicious download, replaced the device and changed passwords. But later, another engineer downloaded compromised code as part of what they thought was a job interview, which included a virtual meeting with the supposed CEO of a fake company.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's tempting to think that the engineer should have seen something was off. But the internet is a precarious place because bad actors know how to make content feel legitimate. Binance says its employee was snared by a hacker posing as an HR rep who "shared a social media account with him, including personal photos and videos posted on the platform, in order to build trust. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when they encounter a piece of unfamiliar content, professional fact-checkers don't just read it closely — they read laterally. They open new browser tabs to see what other, credible sources have to say. Fact-checkers know that bad actors make themselves look good on their home turf, but that it's a lot harder to fake a good reputation across the internet.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the next time you encounter something unfamiliar online, look for authoritative sources that can shed light on the person or organization. You might find a news article that confirms the claim you're looking into, or a report that identifies a supposedly neutral source as biased.

In some cases, you may find nothing at all, which is a signal in itself: if you look up a company that reached out to you and find no external confirmation of its existence, that should be an immediate red flag.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, had that first binance engineer engaged in click restraint and verified the source of the software, they might have avoided the malicious download. Had that second employee taken time to seek external verification about the supposed HR rep, rather than trusting a polished social media profile, they might have realized that something didn't add up.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the internet and ai have made it harder to know whether what we see is authentic. They've also made it easier than ever before to investigate who or what we encounter online. It's always worth pausing to check. A few seconds up front can save us all a lot of time, grief and money later on.

Diungkapkan bahwa nadav ziv is a researcher at the digital inquiry group. Joel Breakstone is co-founder and executive director of the Digital Inquiry Group.

Unfortunately for Nebraska, they currently are not.

Berdasarkan laporan, nebraska's #4 vincent robinson — a former national champion for nc state — took on oklahoma state true freshman rocklin zinkin. A three-time California state champion, Zinkin was a big-time recruit coming out of high school.

Berdasarkan laporan, with robinson taking the majority of the shots in regulation, the third period ended tied at 1-1, sending things to sudden victory. After a scoreless overtime period where Zinkin nearly took Robinson down late, but Robinson used his splits to ward off the points, the match went to tiebreakers.

Diungkapkan bahwa in the tiebreakers, zinkin rode robinson out for the full 30 seconds, forcing robinson to choose neutral in the second tiebreaker. Robinson was unable to get through the head and hands defense of Zinkin, handing him his first loss of his Husker career 1-1 in tiebreakers.

Facing the prodigy #1 Jax Forrest, Nebraska's #7 Jacob Van Dee put up a valiant effort but fell in the end via 21-6 technical fall — giving the Cowboys an 8-0 dual lead.

Forrest scored six takedowns, but Van Dee did score a second-period reversal — not a lot of guys score offense points on Forrest, so it's noteworthy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after dropping his opener late and losing to forrest, van dee will look for his first win this season when nebraska travels to face #20 penn on nov. 21.

In a battle of true freshmen, Oklahoma State's prevailed with #13 Jayden Raney downing Nebraska's Lincoln Sledzianowski 10-2 by major decision.

Raney scored three takedowns in the match and earned the bonus points with a riding-time point.

Diungkapkan bahwa the cowboy freshman was a blue-chip recruit out of high school, so this is no surprise. After a promising debut last week, Sledzianowski was brought down to Earth a little bit on Friday night.

With the loss by major, Nebraska trailed 12-0 in the dual.

These familiar foes wrestled the kind of match they always do — a tight contest with #1 Sergio Vega of Oklahoma State coming out on top.

The returning NCAA champion, Vega scored a first-period takedown on Nebraska's #5 Anthony Echemendia and used his seemingly impenetrable defense to secure the 4-2 win.

Vega has never lost or been taken down in college — after three tries against him, Echemendia is now 0-3 with zero takedowns scored.

In a rematch of the 2026 NCAA final at 157 pounds, Nebraska's #3 Antrell Taylor faced off against #1 Landon Robideau of Oklahoma State.

There really wasn't a lot of action from either wrestler throughout regulation as they traded escapes to start the second and third period, but it was Taylor who was called for two stall calls late in the bout — both within five seconds of each other — that gave Robideau the 3-1 decision win.

I'm certain we'll see this match again in March.

With the loss, Nebraska took an 18-0 deficit into the break.

Coming out of intermission, Nebraska's #5 Meyer Shapiro took the mat against Oklahoma State's #6 Casey Swiderski.

Sebagaimana diketahui, despite a lot of action, the score was knotted up 1-1 late in the third period when swiderski got in on a single leg with a duck-under and scored the go-ahead takedown. Shapiro got the escape, but there were only six seconds left.

Swiderski earned the 4-2 decision win over the Cornell transfer Shapiro.

With the loss, Nebraska was down 21-0 on the team score at this point.

When Nebraska needed to stop the bleeding, it was #2 Christopher Minto who delivered.

Facing Oklahoma State's Lorenzo Norman — a Stanford transfer this offseason — Minto used a low shot in the third period to score the go-ahead takedown, riding the period out for the 5-1 decision win.

With the win, Minto is now 2-0 on the year.

On the dual scoreboard, Oklahoma State held a 21-3 lead after the Minto win.

Taking the mat for the first time in a dual for the Huskers, Penn State transfer #14 Lucas Cochran faced off against Oklahoma State freshman #10 Mikey White.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, white shot immediately to start the match, catching cochran for the takedown to go up 3-0. Cochran recovered to score an escape before starting the second period on top. The Husker senior rode White out the entire period, scoring a stalling point along the way.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the third, cochran started the period with an escape to tie the match at 3-3. White then shot in on Cochran's legs and was able to work for the takedown to take the 6-3 lead before adding another takedown on a low shot in the waning seconds, handing Cochran his first loss of the year — a 9-4 decision after awarding Cochran's riding-time point.

Nebraska fell behind 24-3 with the loss by Cochran.

In their third career meeting, Nebraska's #5 Camden McDanel took his third loss to Oklahoma State's #2 Cody Merrill.

After a scoreless first period, each wrestler scored an escape in regulation, sending the match to sudden victory where Merrill eventually shot in, leading to an extended scramble that Merrill won at the last second, securing the takedown and the 4-1 decision win.

With the loss, McDanel is 0-2 on the year after dropping his opener 4-1 to #4 Joey Novak of Wyoming.

With the loss, Nebraska was trailing the dual 27-3 here.

In a match that on paper didn't look too monumental — Nebraska's #9 Cade Ziola taking on #15 Dreshaun Ross of Oklahoma State — this was a match that will help set the pecking order at heavyweight going forward.

A preseason pick by many to win an NCAA title as a true freshman this season, Ross came in with incredible expectations as the top heavyweight prospect in the country out of Iowa.

Not a lot of people were giving Ziola a chance here, but his gains both in the wrestling room and on the scale seem to have paid dividends as he secured the late takedown to win this match 4-1.

After a scoreless first period and an escape a piece, Ross shot a low single-leg late, but Ziola sat the corner and flipped Ross over with a crotch lock for the takedown with two seconds left.

Ziola is now 2-0 on the year with this by far his best career win so far, setting him up for a deserved climb in the rankings.

#1059. Cold weather can't cool off Purdue soccer on way to Big Ten Tournament title

Cold weather can't cool off Purdue soccer on way to Big Ten Tournament title

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/cold-weather-cant-cool-off-053639321.html

WEST LAFAYETTE — It was a frigid 37 degrees on a day bogged down by rain and sleet, but adrenaline won out against the weather conditions.

Purdue soccer's Jaiden Anderson just added to her program record with her 20th goal, this one delivering a Big Ten Tournament championship in thrilling fashion.

Sebagaimana diketahui, anderson, ignoring the looming indiana winter weather, ripped off her no. 54 jersey and ran across Folk Field twirling it above her head, was chased down from behind by teammate Emilia Deppe, who tackled Anderson to the ground as the rest of the Boilers dogpiled on top.

The Big Ten's Forward of the Year had been marked by two, and sometimes three, Michigan State defenders all night before getting into the open field, juking two Spartans and ripping a shot into the lower right 90 6:35 into overtime to give Purdue a 4-3 victory.

"It was just spur of the moment, pure excitement, pure love and passion for this game," Anderson said.

It was the latest in a series of thrillers that brought the Boilermakers their first Big Ten Tournament championship since 2007 and the second victory this season over third-ranked Michigan State.

Purdue earned its first NCAA Tournament appearance since 2021, doing so a season after not even qualifying for the Big Ten's eight-team postseason tournament.

More: 'Special team' piloting turnaround for Big Ten leading Purdue soccer.

Anderson's heroics were only possible after what gets lost in the post-match celebration, a diving stop by Purdue keeper Grace Miller, one of the heroes in Purdue's penalty kicks victory over Wisconsin in the Big Ten semifinals, off a Kayla Briggs header just moments earlier that briefly looked like it would have spoiled the Boilers' championship moment.

Despite allowing three goals, including a game-tying boot from Mackenzie Kruer with 1:40 to go in regulation, Miller was magnificent, standing tall against a Michigan State team that dominated possession and fired 22 shots, 11 on target.

Kruer's neutralized a night where goals by Rosa Maalouf, Addison Feldman and McKenzie Carle had the Boilermakers nursing a lead for nearly the duration of regulation.

More: How Purdue soccer uses data to boost performance.

But it was the Boilermakers who capitalized most on its chances, including its final one, to assure this ride will continue at least one more week.

Diungkapkan bahwa "there's this, like, sort of chemistry on this team," miller said. "You could see it from the sidelines and watching. Everyone is rooting for each other and I think that's what makes this team special. ".

It was a championship performance that fell in line with a season full of thrillers.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i think this team is special," said senior midfielder irene campo, the tournament's most outstanding player. You guys have seen it today. "Everybody shows up every practice, every game. They tied us in the last few minutes, and then we just kept pushing. We were up. We've been pushing since the first game of the season, and I think all the people that came out to see us deserved this. ".

No moment seemed too big during a 17-2-3 record entering the NCAA Tournament that has captured the attention of Boilermaker fans, many who provided a standing ovation during Purdue's men's basketball game down the street at Mackey Arena witnessing it on the video board.

Another 2,200 sold out Folk Field, surrounding the pitch and pounding against the boards to deliver an electric title match environment.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "a shout out to the fans coming out here and bearing the miserable weather and choosing to come to a soccer game over basketball, that might be a first on this campus," purdue head coach richard moodie said. "Long may it continue. ".

They've witnessed a team that was projected to finish 13th in the Big Ten's preseason poll launch into a program that is now ranked 13th in the country.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a team that made a head coaching change three seasons ago, hiring moodie to succeed drew roff. Moodie came to Purdue with a history of winning, first at Division II Carson-Newman, then as head coach at South Alabama, both at which playing in the NCAA Tournament was frequent and expected.

A program that for the first time in 19 years is hoisting a Big Ten Tournament championship trophy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "our fight is so different compared to anyone else's," said megan santa cruz, who had two assists in the championship victory. "No matter what, who we're playing, I feel like stepping onto the field with the people that I am, I just feel it gives me so much confidence because I know we have so many good players and so many solid players that are going to show up every single game and give it their all. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the minnesota vikings made the move they had to make after a half-season of underwhelming quarterback performance in trading for kirk cousins. He will be the starter as soon as possible, which is likely to be this Sunday against the Packers. His arrival has come with much fanfare as the savior of the Vikings offense who, combined with the Vikings dominant defense and good special teams, could position the Vikings for a deep run in the post-season.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but a quarterback switching teams in mid-season is not without its difficulties, even with cousins' familiarity with kevin o'connell's scheme and some of the key players around him from justin jefferson, jordan addison, and t. Hockenson to Brian O'Neill, Blake Brandel, and Christian Darrisaw. J. It's also an advantage that Cousins has been playing the entire season, so he doesn't have to get acclimated to playing again, as a backup quarterback who hasn't played would need to do.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if cousins plays on sunday (as expected at this point), there could be some hiccups as he works out timing and other rapport issues in his first game back after three years. But Cousins has been playing in the same type of offense under Klint Kubiak in Las Vegas, and is probably the most well-versed quarterback in Kevin O'Connell's scheme in the league- and one of the most well-suited to execute it.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the first graphic compares cousins' rate and epa efficiency in the play-action passing game, which is central to koc's offense. This season, Cousins' passer rating with play-action is 123. 2, and in play-action it is 110. Cousins' career passer rating from under center is 107. He's been one of the more effective quarterbacks out of play-action for most of his career, and has run it at a relatively high rate for most of his 15-year career. 0. He's also played at a relatively high rate from under center, which KOC also likes to do to make the play-action game more effective. 4.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the vikings have used play-action more than the raiders have so far this season. Part of that is game situation- both down-and-distance and score/time remaining. You would think that with the Vikings dominant defense, they would continue to be able to run play action at a high rate to maximize Cousins' strength in that area.

Diungkapkan bahwa the second graphic represents cousins' passing metrics to each part of the field. He's also had good success throwing at intermediate depth (10-19 yards) this season. Both Kyler Murray and Carson Wentz have been reluctant to target the middle of the field, which compromises the effectiveness of O'Connell's scheme. One of the staples of O'Connell's scheme is the dagger route combination, which has largely disappeared from run or targeted routes this season. The big takeaway is that the lion's share of Cousins' passing yards and attempts are between the numbers. That's another important element of KOC's scheme-targeting the middle of the field. It's also one of the most effective route combinations for Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, bottom line, having kirk cousins at quarterback should open up the entirety of koc's playbook, but it may take some time for cousins to re-familiarize himself with the playbook and get on the same page again with receivers. Still, I don't anticipate Cousins hesitating to get the ball out to open receivers as Murray and Wentz have done this season.

Berdasarkan laporan, since the last time cousins played for the vikings- three years ago- he had his achilles tendon repaired and spent most of his time in atlanta recovering from that. According to Albert Breer, when the Vikings were looking into trading for Cousins, after, "meshing the scouts' and coaches' analysis, they saw Cousins as still possessing a live arm and deadly accuracy and having returned to the baseline of athleticism he set before tearing his Achilles in 2024, evidenced on tape in the keeper game that's essential to Kubiak's scheme. Apparently, he couldn't really push off of his foot with the repaired Achilles and that was negatively affecting his game. His passes lacked velocity and his movement was slower than it had been. At that point it looked like he was done. But after signing with the Raiders, it appears that Cousins has fully recovered from the Achilles injury and no longer has the issues that plagued him in Atlanta. The velocity is back and while Cousins has never been particularly mobile, he is able to move like he used to before the Achilles injury. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, i've watched all of cousins' throws with the raiders this year, and it is reminiscent of his previous stint with the vikings. He's also not afraid to deliver the ball downfield in the face of oncoming pressure- and pay the price for it. He has run for five-yard gains on a couple occasions this season, but that's about it. Additionally, he has not become any more mobile over the last three years, and the scampering of Kyler Murray to pick up first downs here and there is definitely not in Cousins' bag, if that wasn't obvious. This is the impact of being his being 38 years old. He can't launch balls down field with velocity off his back foot like Jordan Love or Caleb Williams. That may have been the case before as well but it is something that stood out when watching his tape this season. He can make all the throws, as you would expect from a starting NFL quarterback, but he needs to step-in to deeper throws for them to have the needed velocity. He is able to maneuver within the pocket effectively and does fine on bootlegs, but he's not going to outrun many pass rushers for very long. I don't know that his arm strength has declined much- it doesn't look like it- but there is a caveat. He's also not afraid of throwing into tight windows and does so with regularity.

And whereas Murray or Wentz may look to scramble to buy time, Cousins is mainly focused on getting the ball out. So, he's generally done an excellent job of avoiding the rush and getting the ball out- maybe only one of sacks can be blamed on him. He's very much a pocket passer in that respect, with his only move typically being to step up in the pocket to avoid the edge rush.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but after a clean separation in the upper atmosphere, the lower half -- a super heavy booster -- was diverted off the coast, splashing down in the gulf of mexico, after which it burst into flames. The company has not shared details of the issue encountered.

Diungkapkan bahwa while that kept the mission from achieving complete success, starship — the upper stage — successfully reached orbit at 6:13 p. m. ET. That's only the second time the company's pulled that off, with SpaceX's Dan Huot calling it "a really great moment" on Flight 15's livestream.

Diungkapkan bahwa if the rest of the mission goes according to plan, starship will reenter the atmosphere tomorrow with a catch attempt scheduled for 4:17 p. ET. m. Berdasarkan laporan, even without a first catch, a successful second catch of starship would be huge for the company, representing a major step toward making spacex's goal of a fully and rapidly reusable, heavy lift rocket a reality. The program is a major part of SpaceX's growth thesis.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the company's current workhorse, falcon 9, reuses its booster but throws away its upper stage on every flight. The ability to reuse such a large rocket would drive down the cost of getting payloads of all sizes into space, helping it win larger contracts from enterprise and government customers alike.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, spacex is aiming for full starship capability around the end of 2027, but the program has seen significant setbacks and delays in its development. A successful catch tomorrow would go a long way in reassuring investors worried about further delays.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, getting starship into orbit with a full load of starlink satellites is a good day for spacex, but having the booster diverted into the water and burst into flames is a reminder that the hard part of this program -- the real essence of what makes it special -- is not getting to space, but getting back to earth in one piece, over and over. That is what will change the economics of space.

Diungkapkan bahwa every year, congress is supposed to pass 12 spending bills to keep the government’s lights on. These appropriations bills fund those programs already approved by Congress, including defense, the IRS, food assistance, veterans’ benefits and national parks.

Berdasarkan laporan, the deadline to fund programs for the next fiscal year is always oct. 1. Without passing appropriations bills or approving a stopgap that kicks the deadline down the road, the government shuts down.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at 43 days, the 2025 government shutdown was the longest in history. There have been 22 shutdowns since 1976 and most are short-lived — a few hours or days, at the most.

Berdasarkan laporan, before then, there hadn’t been a shutdown since 2018-2019. That shutdown, which lasted 35 days, arose in a dispute over funding for Trump’s border wall in his first term.

Diungkapkan bahwa before that there was a 16-day shutdown in 2013, as negotiations over the affordable care act dragged on. In 1995 and 1996, two shutdowns totaled 26 days.

Federal workers bear the brunt of impact from government shutdowns.

During a shutdown, there are ripple effects on delivery of government services and programs.

National parks may close or operate without services.

Federal student aid application processing could be delayed.

Food and drug inspections will be delayed.

The IRS can’t verify income and Social Security numbers, which could cause delays for some mortgages and other loan approvals, as well as tax refunds.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, flights will still operate, but there could be delays if tsa agents and air traffic controllers, who are considered essential employees, decide to call out of work, leading to staff shortages. Even small shortages can have a big impact: During a 2019 government shutdown, the absence of just 10 air traffic controllers at two airports grounded flights and caused delays for the Eastern Seaboard. (Read more on how the shutdown affects travel. ).

Social Security and Medicare will keep going, but some administrative functions may be suspended, and telehealth appointments may be interrupted.

Unemployment benefits will continue — states administer compensation — but there could be application processing delays if the shutdown lasts long enough.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, food benefits through supplemental nutrition assistance program (snap) and the accompanying wic program will continue — both run on contingency funds. WIC funding will only last one month, and SNAP could be strained after 30 days, as well.

The postal service — the USPS is not funded by the federal government.

Federal student loan payments — accounts are serviced by private companies.

Public schools will remain open — they’re funded by state and local governments.

Amtrak will continue operations — it is operated by a for-profit company.

On another possession, Booker beat the double team himself and converted. He wasn't forcing the issue. Goodwin missed the shot, but the process was exactly what you wanted to see. He was reading the defense, understanding what was available, and making the appropriate decision.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, we are currently witnessing what can only be described as a devin booker heater. Over his last 7 games, he's averaging 27. 4 points on 49/40/95 splits.

Diungkapkan bahwa quite honestly, the suns desperately need it because the rest of the starting lineup is struggling mightily. Perhaps it's the lack of continuity and limited playing time together.
