In the clutch, everyone without 'Booker' written on their back has combined to make 20% of their threes and 30% of their shots.

Diungkapkan bahwa while the shooting inefficiencies that plagued booker last season generated plenty of concern, those issues haven't carried over into the early portion of this campaign. He's up to 25. Against Charlotte, he connected on 4-of-8 attempts from deep, continuing to provide the offensive production and efficiency that Phoenix needs from its best player. 5 points this season, doing so on 50/38/94 splits, adding 5. 0 assists, and 1. 2 steals.

Sebagaimana diketahui, until the rest of the starting five figures out who they are, what their responsibilities should be, and how they can contribute more effectively on both ends of the floor, the suns are going to need booker to keep this heater going. Because if he has an ordinary night, there's a pretty good chance Phoenix is going to lose. That's an unfortunate reality, but it's where this organization finds itself.

Sebagaimana diketahui, devin booker is in the prime of his career. This should be the period when the franchise has a clear understanding of what works alongside him, what complements his strengths, and how to construct a roster that maximizes his abilities. The organization has had plenty of time to figure that out.

Diungkapkan bahwa instead, we've watched phoenix spend much of his prime fumbling through roster construction, repeatedly acquiring players with overlapping skill sets and similar positional responsibilities. Rather than consistently surrounding Booker with complementary pieces, the organization has continued placing additional weight on his shoulders, asking him to compensate for deficiencies that should have been addressed through better roster construction. Thankfully, at least through the opening weeks of this season, Booker appears more than willing to accept that responsibility.

But how long can he sustain it? How long can a team reasonably expect one player to account for more than a third of its starting lineup's scoring while simultaneously serving as its primary offensive organizer and late-game closer? At some point, the supporting cast has to establish its identity and begin providing consistent production.

Berdasarkan laporan, i've been quick to remind people that devin booker is the $57 million man whenever his performances fall short of expectations. When you're earning that kind of money, there's a certain level of production, leadership, and accountability that comes with the paycheck. And right now? He's earning every damn dollar.

Berdasarkan laporan, you earn that money by delivering in the clutch, which booker has done. Check that too, as the team sits at 5-6. You earn it by showing up night after night, accepting the responsibility of carrying an offense while your teammates are still trying to figure out their roles, their responsibilities, and perhaps why they're being asked to occupy spaces already filled by somebody else. You earn it by becoming the stabilizing force that prevents an inconsistent team from completely unraveling. That's what Devin Booker has been doing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, and while i certainly hope the rest of the roster begins providing him with the support he deserves, there's something worth appreciating about watching a player embrace that burden and continue delivering. Because for all the questions surrounding the Phoenix Suns right now, Devin Booker is providing the most important answer. He's playing like the $57 million man.

But for the moment, he's reminding everyone why he's the face of this franchise. The Suns still have plenty to figure out, and Booker can't be expected to carry them indefinitely. Right now, he's answering those questions with his play. And why, when the game is on the line, you probably shouldn't leave him open from 28 feet.

Keeps me from having to buy frozen fruit and multiple vinegars.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, pantry shopping can result in less food in the trash and fewer trips to the grocery store. Take a page from Managing Editor Athena Cocoves, who says, “Sometimes we pretend we're on ‘Chopped. It can also make experimenting with new recipes a little more exciting. ’”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ryan brady, lead writer: rotating toys with our kids has helped them get more enjoyment out of the same toys versus constantly buying new toys. We put a bunch of toys they're bored with in a bin, and months later, take one out and bam — it's like a new toy all over again!.

Kim Lowe, head of content: I invested a whole $12 in a lint remover last winter that transformed all my old sweaters into almost new!.

Sebagaimana diketahui, laura mcmullen, editor: almost all of my kids’ clothes are thrifted or hand-me-downs. We’ve developed a hearty clothing exchange. My friend group of parents has kids from age 2 to 7, all of whom are about six months apart. It’s fun to see my friends' kids wear hand-me-downs that we got from my brother’s family almost 10 years ago.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, look for other ways to salvage your belongings or get them secondhand. That might include watching a vacuum repair tutorial on YouTube, borrowing books from the library or purchasing used tools from Facebook Marketplace. The goal: Keep more stuff in circulation and out of landfills.

Berdasarkan laporan, abby doyle, lead writer: composting isn’t as fussy as it seems. Once you get into it, you start seeing would-be waste as stuff to feed your new backyard buddy. Junk mail, paper bags, slimy spring mix … it’s all food for my “pet dirt. ” And my garden has legit never looked better.

Berdasarkan laporan, yuliya goldshteyn, editor: instead of throwing away kid art, i reuse it as wrapping paper throughout the year. Bespoke gift wrapping for everyone! I haven’t bought gift wrap for five years now.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, caitlin constantine, editor: i repurpose glass jars and plastic containers. It always seemed like such a pity to throw perfectly good containers into the recycling after one use, so now I reuse them before I recycle them.

Before you toss something, ask yourself, “Is there another way I can use this?” An old T-shirt makes a good cleaning rag, for example.

Being resourceful often means getting as much mileage as possible out of what you have.

#1120. Canada embrace Concacaf experience in win over Guatemala

📅 14 Nov 2026

Canada embrace Concacaf experience in win over Guatemala

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/canada-embrace-concacaf-experience-win-053200813.html

Sebagaimana diketahui, a fireworks-filled anthem, a less-than-ideal playing surface, and cages surrounding the pitch. Away days in Concacaf aren't for the faint of heart, but Canada scraped out a 3-2 win over Guatemala on Friday.

Diungkapkan bahwa under head coach jesse marsch, canada have faced some of the world's best teams and reached the fifa world cup round of 16. Yet Friday's opening 45 minutes of the Concacaf Nations League quarterfinals may have been among their most complete, before a disheartening second half saw a 3-0 lead nearly disappear.

Berdasarkan laporan, jonathan david brought his stellar laliga form to the estadio el trébol, posting 1g/1a and helping build up canada's third goal. Liam Millar, in dominant form in the EFL Championship, scored too, while former Minnesota United striker Tani Oluwaseyi netted his first for Canada in 18 appearances.

"We were very happy with that start," assistant coach Mauro Biello told reporters, taking media duties after Marsch's second-half red card.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "it was something that we addressed here in the build-up to be able to create more, to score more goals, and i think we're very happy with the way our forwards played. Especially in the first half, and getting goals from both strikers and Liam, who was also doing really well at his club. ".

It had been more than 600 days since Alphonso Davies last started for Canada, when he tore his ACL in the 2025 Nations League third-place game against the United States.

It seemed as if his return, committing to playing for Les Rouges on a November night in Guatemala amid stellar FC Bayern Munich form, was him putting the last two years of injury troubles behind him.

That hope lasted just five minutes before an awkward shot block sent him off the pitch early.

As of Friday, it was unclear if Davies would be available for the pivotal second leg in Canada or fly back to Germany to recover.

His team's first-half response, though, spoke volumes about the development beyond the 26-year-old's contributions.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we were all so excited to see phonzie back, and for him to go down that early, we were just gutted for him," oluwaseyi said. I think overall, this is just the mentality of the entire team. "We still played a really good game, and we got a win in a really tough place. ".

Despite the lackluster second half, Canada got a largely new experience playing in Friday's environment, marking the program's first game in Central America since 2022, when only five of the players who saw minutes Friday were on the roster against Honduras.

For Real Salt Lake center back Luc De Fougerolles, it could prove pivotal, as he thrived in a commanding role for most of the night and showed veteran poise alongside Portland Timbers center back Joel Waterman among the starters.

And for the new era of Canadian players, who have largely played at home, in the US or against Caribbean foes, a true Concacaf away day will be invaluable as they aim for regional trophies — even after giving up two goals in the second half.

Diungkapkan bahwa "they're playing in front of their fans, they're pushing, and we know they're the type of team they are; they're fighters, and they're guys that are going to push till the end," biello said. "We have to learn from that when we play these types of games. ".

Canada can count themselves lucky that the away goals rule is still in effect for Nations League play, giving them a slight cushion as the quarterfinal tie enters Monday's second leg at Toronto FC's BMO Field.

There, Canada will look for greater composure, aiming to secure a spot in the Nations League semifinals in March and the 2027 Concacaf Gold Cup as they hunt a first trophy since the 2000 Gold Cup.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we know this can be a difficult place to play, and they're a team that's been on a really good run and getting good results," biello said. "Now we look ahead to Monday and know we have to come out in the right way. ".

#1122. Why the Suns should avoid trading Jalen Green for Dejounte Murray

📅 14 Nov 2026

Why the Suns should avoid trading Jalen Green for Dejounte Murray

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/why-suns-avoid-trading-jalen-000000949.html

Berdasarkan laporan, would i or wouldn't i? that is the question. And I understand why they're asking. Ever since reports surfaced earlier today linking the Phoenix Suns to disgruntled New Orleans Pelicans guard Dejounte Murray, I've had plenty of friends reaching out to ask whether I'd pull the trigger on a potential deal involving Jalen Green. If there's anybody who's been more vocal about the belief that Jalen Green doesn't belong in the Suns' starting five, I'd certainly be a contender for that title.

So a straight-up swap of Green for Murray makes sense, right? Not so fast.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i understand the appeal. And who knows? Maybe it would work. Bringing in Murray would theoretically provide Phoenix with a more traditional point guard, allowing the team to reestablish some semblance of positional clarity and better define the responsibilities of the players surrounding Devin Booker. A straight-up deal would also save the Suns some money, which is certainly beneficial from a salary cap perspective, although it doesn't exactly put any additional cash in my pocket.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, murray is somebody i've been thinking about since last summer. We've discussed potential scenarios involving him for quite some time, and no matter how many times I revisit the possibility, I keep arriving at the same conclusion: I'll pass on that, thank you.

Sebagaimana diketahui, my hesitation begins with murray's health. He suffered an Achilles injury in February 2025, and there's still uncertainty surrounding whether he can return to the player he was before that injury. That's a significant concern when you're discussing acquiring a guard whose effectiveness has historically relied on his mobility, quickness, and ability to operate on both ends of the floor.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and even before the injury, was murray really a game-altering player? he was a serviceable guard with a defensive reputation, someone capable of contributing in multiple areas without necessarily elevating the overall ceiling of the teams he played for. The last time he was impactful was when he was in a Greg Popovich system that elevates guard play, and even then the team wasn't winning much with him.

Sebagaimana diketahui, maybe a player with his skill set would fit more naturally alongside booker than green currently does. Considering Green's $36. 3 million salary and declining perceived value, there's certainly an argument that swapping one distressed asset for another could make sense from a basketball operations standpoint.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but then there's everything else. I call it PTKD. Murray's recent public frustration with the situation in New Orleans, including allegations that he has used burner accounts to comment on videos, gives me a familiar and uncomfortable feeling. Post-Traumatic KD Disorder.

Say what you want about Jalen Green; we don't see him coming unhinged online when people challenge his fit.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of the things i've genuinely appreciated about this current iteration of the phoenix suns is how relatively quiet they've been away from the basketball court. They're not turning every criticism into a public confrontation. They're not regularly lashing out at fans. They're not creating unnecessary distractions through social media. Outside of a few entertaining trolling commercials from Dillon Brooks, this group has largely avoided the public drama that surrounded previous versions of the franchise. They appear to handle their business internally, and I have tremendous respect for that.

Berdasarkan laporan, perhaps that appreciation comes from personal experience. I've been on the receiving end of Kevin Durant's verbal lashings because I dared to express an opinion about the basketball team I cover. I have opinions, I have a platform to express them, and that's precisely what I intend to do. My apologies. As Don Draper might remind these players, that's what the money is for.

Sebagaimana diketahui, now, perhaps a change of scenery would do wonders for murray. Maybe getting out of New Orleans, joining a different organization, and playing alongside Booker would provide the reset he needs, both professionally and personally. That's entirely possible.

When evaluating a potential acquisition, I keep returning to the same fundamental question I've been asking about Jalen Green: Does he make your basketball team better? And with Murray, I'm not convinced the answer is yes.

Berdasarkan laporan, when you examine his time in atlanta and new orleans, his on/off impact has generally been underwhelming. He's spent much of that period posting negative net rating results, raising questions about how much his individual production actually translates into improved team performance.

Diungkapkan bahwa that's what makes this entire conversation so fascinating. You're essentially exchanging one set of problems for another, hoping that the new problems are somehow easier to manage. In theory, the Suns would be acquiring a player with a negative statistical impact to replace another player with a similarly negative impact. I'll take the guy with a better attitude every day out of the week.

Berdasarkan laporan, there are potential advantages, of course. The Suns would still have problems with size, rebounding, and interior production. The overlapping skill sets of Miles Bridges and Dillon Brooks would still exist. Even that doesn't solve every issue with the roster. Murray would be cheaper, providing some financial flexibility. His presence could help clarify the responsibilities within the starting lineup, allowing Booker to operate more naturally in his preferred role while Murray handles additional facilitating duties. There would be no guarantee that Murray's arrival would suddenly create the offensive connectivity Phoenix has been searching for.

So where do I ultimately land? I think the Suns should wait.

Sebagaimana diketahui, if murray is disgruntled today, there's a pretty good chance he'll still be disgruntled two months from now. His desire for a change of scenery doesn't necessarily create an obligation for Phoenix to rush into a transaction, especially when the player they'd be acquiring comes with legitimate questions of his own. Meanwhile, the Suns still have an opportunity to evaluate Jalen Green and determine whether there's a way to make his skill set work within the current roster.

Sebagaimana diketahui, quite honestly, i believe the best immediate solution is moving green to the bench. Allow him to operate with the second unit, where he can play a style more familiar to him without constantly navigating the responsibilities and tendencies of Devin Booker. Give him an opportunity to rebuild his confidence, establish some offensive rhythm, and continue developing the distribution skills the organization clearly wants him to improve.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the suns' bench has already demonstrated a greater understanding of its collective identity. The players know their responsibilities, understand how to complement one another, and have shown an ability to sustain productive stretches without relying on one individual to orchestrate everything. Perhaps placing Green in that environment would help him develop comfort and confidence, ultimately making him a more effective contributor when his minutes overlap with the starters'.

Berdasarkan laporan, if it doesn't work? well, at least phoenix will have gathered additional information before making another significant roster decision. No need to make a trade just to make a trade. Isn't that what got us into this mess?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the reality is that there's no obvious correct answer here. Murray hasn't demonstrated that he'd necessarily be a better one. Both players carry significant salaries, legitimate concerns, and enough uncertainty to make any potential transaction a gamble. Green hasn't demonstrated that he's the right fit. And if the Pelicans and Suns ultimately decide to swap them, what exactly are we accomplishing?.

Diungkapkan bahwa "here's your problem. " I like our problem better. " "Thank you very much. Have a nice day. We'll take it off your hands if you take ours. Green is younger and more athletic, seems to be a better locker room guy, is less injury-prone, and seems to be simply having a hard time navigating his new role.

Diungkapkan bahwa the suns have a roster that needs work, and jalen green hasn't made the transition phoenix hoped he would. How about we focus on getting some rebounding, eh? Suns are 9th in assists. Swapping two players with question marks attached to their names might make the transaction look productive, but it doesn't necessarily make the basketball team any better. There's a difference between identifying a problem and finding a solution. They're dead last in rebounding. But that doesn't mean Dejounte Murray is the answer. Let's focus on fixing what's broken.

Sebagaimana diketahui, give green a chance to find his footing in a different role. Give Murray and the Pelicans some time to sort through their situation. The Suns don't have to be the organization that solves everybody else's problems, especially when they have enough of their own.

#1123. Cowboys aggressiveness on offense must be turned up vs. 49ers

📅 13 Nov 2026

Cowboys aggressiveness on offense must be turned up vs. 49ers

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/cowboys-aggressiveness-offense-must-turned-233000779.html

After two straight weeks of early window kickoffs in which the Dallas Cowboys had to fight, claw, scratch, and get knocked down to go 1-1 against the Arizona Cardinals and Indianapolis Colts, they play in the Sunday late afternoon window against the San Francisco 49ers.

Diungkapkan bahwa both teams are off a win, which puts the cowboys right back in a position they've been time and time again and failed in nearly every time, trying to win consecutive games under brian schottenheimer. The Cowboys can't afford to spin their wheels much longer if they want to make this season mean something though.

This 49ers matchup is exactly that opportunity for the Cowboys, so let's get to how they can pull off the upset.

Sebagaimana diketahui, think for a second about how many nfl offenses are truly earning the label of "elite", "scary", or "explosive" right now, then without looking at any other metrics or analytics consider the top four tiers in the first downs per play category. They are the Bills, 49ers, Lions, and Bengals tied for first, the Cowboys in second, and the Jaguars and Rams in third just ahead of the Patriots and Chiefs.

Sebagaimana diketahui, also among these teams, the 49ers, lions, and bills are in the top five for fewest third downs faced per game. The Patriots, Chiefs, Jags, and Bengals are all virtually tied with the Bills to round out the top nine. Then there are the 14th ranked Cowboys, much closer to teams like the Steelers, Texans, and Browns – none of which have the QB situation Dallas does that should be keeping them out of this not-so-great company. This is a main culprit why they feel like outliers on the elite, scary, or explosive list while the other offenses are much more deserving.

Berdasarkan laporan, for even more evidence that the cowboys offense is all about dak right now, and that prescott should be getting way more help than he is from all directions, there's the fact two of the three touchdown drives last week at the colts came in two minute situations before halftime and at the end of the game. The Cowboys need much more than just Prescott to be at their absolute best against the 49ers, but fairly or not will also need #4 to be among the players that elevates their game this week as well.

The best path towards doing so is much more early down aggressiveness and the Cowboys embracing what they do best by throwing the ball to CeeDee Lamb, and hopefully George Pickens, not just on third down, but all the time.

Diungkapkan bahwa without jake ferguson for this game, one of the things the cowboys are going to have an incredibly difficult time doing is persuading the 49ers defense out of loading the box. They don't have the middle of the field threat to get behind these stacked looks, especially considering the freakish coverage ability to all parts of the field from Fred Warner. Dallas will still need to find it's times to run the ball and doing so well on early downs would also be huge, but staying in spread looks and letting Prescott make the right decision should be their bread and butter.

This could also allow them to use some tempo to their advantage, getting to the line quickly to give them time to use motions, something the 49ers offense is going to do a ton of to the Cowboys defense, and Cowboys offense would be wise to try to give it back.

Berdasarkan laporan, on defense, the cowboys need to do everything they can to limit the vast amount of plays 49ers coach kyle shanahan can get to at all times. If Christian McCaffrey is breaking tackles and getting considerable gains on first downs all game, the 49ers are simply too talented and well-coached to be stopped. They will toy with Christian Parker's defense when ahead of the chains with short, intermediate, and deep layered passes.

Diungkapkan bahwa there's also the element of brock purdy's effectiveness scrambling outside of the pocket, another area quinnen williams and kenny clark will have to step up in pushing the pocket and keeping contain. A complete game in both run and pass defense from the Cowboys front will give them a chance to replicate what the Atlanta Falcons did to the 49ers as the only team to beat them this season.

Berdasarkan laporan, even though the disparity in records is obvious in this game between the 7-1 49ers and 4-5 cowboys, if the game was going to solely be decided by the players on the field, i think many fans on both sides would be expecting a much closer game than they currently are. The biggest gripe from Cowboys fans when it comes to things they're not looking forward to the most about this toughest game of the season to date is how likely it feels the 49ers coaching staff will run laps around the Cowboys staff, and separate even more on the scoreboard as a result of it.

This chart shows that Schottenheimer is lacking creativity in his offensive formations/plays, while Shanahan is uplifting the 49ers with his usual masterclass at taking a roster hammered by injuries and still finding a way to win.

Diungkapkan bahwa the cowboys have already lost to four of the coaches that presently rank above schottenheimer on this chart, play the 49ers this sunday, then still have to play the jaguars and seahawks in december. The only win for Schotty against a coach above him on this list is the one directly above him by the smallest of margins, Nick Caley with the Texans. The Cowboys are finding themselves outcoached all too often right now.

Berdasarkan laporan, the cowboys have the talent to compete with this 49ers team, and they have everything left to play for in the nfc east. If they come out and continue to have communication issues on both sides of the ball, call plays like they're playing to not lose instead of playing to win, and shoot themselves in the foot with egregious penalties, it will be all most fans need to see that this season is doomed to look like year one under Schottenheimer and fall short of the playoffs again.

Berdasarkan laporan, a cowboys head coach that's had the chance to work with a healthy dak prescott has never had as little success as schottenheimer is now, and prescott has not beaten the 49ers since being with the coach that drafted him jason garrett in 2017. The chance for this QB-HC duo to have a real signature moment is right there for the taking in week ten if the Cowboys play their best game of the season, a challenge the Dallas coaching staff needs to rise to instead of wilting under the pressure of.

Diungkapkan bahwa after the game, michael malone talked about the loss and where unc goes from here. All quotes via Inside Carolina.

What Is a Business Development Company? 2 BDC Stocks to Buy for Income.

Berdasarkan laporan, these two bdcs deliver yields of 7. 6% and 9. 8%, respectively.

Many investors are familiar with REITs -- or real estate investment trusts -- and their ability to deliver high-yielding dividends.

Business development companies, or BDCs, are not as well known to the average investor, but they essentially do the same thing: deliver huge dividends.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, bdcs were created by federal law in 1980 to funnel public investment into small- and mid-sized companies that don't have the same access to private capital as larger firms. Like REITs, BDCs are required by law to distribute 90% of their taxable income as dividends in exchange for certain tax breaks.

Berdasarkan laporan, also like reits, bdcs tend to provide investors with substantial income. High-yield dividends are their main benefit for investors, but some also deliver decent returns.

Here are two of the best BDC stocks to buy right now.

Sebagaimana diketahui, main street capital (main +0. Since it went public in 2007, Main Street Capital has never reduced its dividend, raising its monthly payout annually for 19 straight years -- and counting (it also pays out a semiannual supplemental dividend that it did suspend in 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic). 30%) is pretty much the gold standard among BDCs. Earlier this month, the company approved a dividend increase for the first three months of 2027, marking the 20th straight year of regular dividend increases.

Diungkapkan bahwa main street capital boosted its dividend for january, february, and march 2027 to $0. 27 per share, up from the current $0. 265 per share.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the other thing that makes main street capital stand out is that it pays a monthly dividend, rather than quarterly. 66% (when including the semiannual supplemental dividends), which is 7 times higher than the S&P 500 (^GSPC -0. The more frequent payouts give investors a steady flow of income. And the dividend payouts come at a high yield of 7. 40%)average.

Berdasarkan laporan, main street capital has been so consistent in raising its dividend because of its model, which features two primary benefits. One, it is internally managed, so it handles loans in-house rather than using third-party asset managers. That gives it more direct control over its investments, but also reduces the fees it would pay out to a third party.

Berdasarkan laporan, two, it holds an equity stake in most of the lower-middle-market investments it makes. So, it profits from the companies it invests in through its equity stake. That makes it, perhaps, much more selective and focused on growing its investments in these LMM companies.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this has allowed it to not only sustain its dividend but also perform relatively well from a capital appreciation perspective. Since it went public in October 2007, Main Street Capital stock has averaged a 7. But if you reinvested the dividends, that average annualized return jumps to 16. 2% annualized return, which is solid for a BDC. 6%.

So, the high-yield dividend puts money in your pocket every month, and if you choose to reinvest it, it has a track record of generating solid returns.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ares capital (arcc +0. 31%) is another excellent BDC that pays an even higher yield than Main Street Capital, but it does not have the same degree of sustainability as Main Street.

Berdasarkan laporan, ares is the largest publicly traded bdc, with a market cap of around $14 billion. It invests in larger companies than Main Street, primarily middle-market firms. It focuses on high‑quality companies that are market leaders with sturdy cash flows, experienced management, and differentiated business models.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the stock pays a super-high dividend yield of 9. 88%. However, it has maintained its dividend at $0. It's different from Main Street in that it pays its yield quarterly, rather than monthly. It also doesn't have the same streak of raising its dividend. 48 per share for the past four straight years, since late 2022.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, and before that, it hadn't lowered its quarterly dividend since 2009. It has also periodically paid out supplemental dividends over that time.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ares capital stock has averaged just a 2. 2% return over the past 10 years, but with the dividend reinvested, that increases to a 12. 4% average annualized 10-year return.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in an uncertain market for bdcs, with borrowers in general facing economic challenges, these two stand out for their rigorous lending standards, conservative underwriting, and stability. But if one stands out as the better option for investors, it is Main Street Capital.

#1153. Why failure without Kawhi Leonard is ok, but not without Scottie Barnes

📅 13 Nov 2026

Why failure without Kawhi Leonard is ok, but not without Scottie Barnes

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/why-failure-without-kawhi-leonard-220000452.html

Berdasarkan laporan, when you start dating, there's something to be said for bad dates and breakups serving as lessons for the do's and don'ts of the world of romance. But, if you keep making the same crummy jokes, not brushing your teeth, over and over again, you're not learning much from those bad dates. At a certain point, losing becomes unproductive.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it's kind of like that with basketball, too. And in the last couple of matches, the Toronto Raptors' losing has been real, real unproductive. Because, it doesn't tell anyone anything that they don't already know.

Diungkapkan bahwa toronto, on- october 21 – scottie barnes #4 of the toronto raptors and kawhi leonard #2 of the toronto raptors share a laugh on the bench as the toronto raptors play the chicago bulls in their season opener at scotiabank arena in toronto. October 21, 2026. Steve Russell/Toronto Star (Steve Russell/Toronto Star via Getty Images) | Toronto Star via Getty Images.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, both times when the raptors have traded for kawhi leonard, there's been an implicit gamble attached to that. Leonard won't play a lot of regular season games, but take him to the playoffs okay, and he'll turn into the '84 Terminator, or '85 Jordan, whichever set of skills might be needed more that night.

Diungkapkan bahwa this season, kawhi went out early. And you remember the playoff series against the Cavaliers, and say, "okay, Scottie and RJ, maybe they can anchor this offence, even without a scorer like Brandon Ingram or Kawhi Leonard. That just means that the other guys need to start pulling extra weight a little sooner. Okay. " And then… Scottie Barnes goes down.

Diungkapkan bahwa an old teacher of mine told me that "practice doesn't make perfect — perfect practice makes perfect," and it concerns me that that raptors are just practicing really, far, far away from perfect. Now, Scottie seems like he's going to come back soon; when exactly that will be is unclear, but there has been little indication that the groin strain is something particularly serious.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but, losing the games that the raptors are losing, without scottie barnes, doesn't really help them understand how their team is going to perform in playoff settings, which, for this roster, should be the ultimate goal. Before the season started, Bobby Webster spoke to the media, and argued that the question that should remain pervasive throughout the season should be "can we win every night?".

Diungkapkan bahwa thus far, the answer to that question, without kawhi leonard, has be a resounding "no. " Omer Osman illustrates that clearly, in the tweet above. It's not 2019 anymore. The Raptors are a different beast, younger, less veteran-heavy, and constructed in a less careful manner.

With Scottie missing the last couple of matchups against heavy-hitters like Boston and Philadelphia, the Raptors don't know how well the team can operate in an optimal sans-Kawhi state, because Toronto was never expecting to, and is not built to, compete without both of its All-Stars.

Barnes was showcasing that he's taken a leap offensively, and can piggy-back the Raptors — to a degree — but when facing off against diminished rosters of great teams, and the forward isn't there to help the Raptors take advantage of weakened clubs, the Raptors are effectively leaving both wins or positive reps on the table, and without Barnes, aren't necessarily getting either.

Diungkapkan bahwa this isn't to say that there's *zero* value from playing without barnes or leonard. And the team's younger players are getting more time on the court to find their legs and develop themselves further. Jakob Poeltl has quietly been looking more like his uninjured self again. RJ Barrett just had a season high in points, and is continuing to prove his value. But, this season was never meant to be about development. It was meant to be about the Raptors bashing teams' heads in with lockdown defence and gliding to the playoffs.

Berdasarkan laporan, but, ultimately, the team has to play the cards they're dealt. The season thus far hasn't been the triumphant return of Raptors basketball to the big stage anyone expected, but there's a lot of basketball left in the year.

Berdasarkan laporan, @baaileyycreates on twitter raised an important point; that last year, leonard's health management kept him off the court almost entirely until the new year, and when he was back, he was whooping teams left right and centre. It's not 2019 anymore, and Kawhi is 35 years old now, but that means, simply, that ramping up looks different for Leonard now, not that he's unable to deliver on-court product. The Raptors need to be able to compete with and without Leonard for this roster to work, but without Scottie Barnes to lead the charge, Toronto will remain in dire straits.

Tanggal: 14 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/duke-crushes-siue-90-47-052423253.html

Duke started slow against Southern Illinois University-Edwardsville, missing nine of its first 11 shots, before things got going.

Sebagaimana diketahui, duke controlled the boards early though, and got off to an early, if slow lead, at 6-2. Then the team just took off, going on a 25-6 run, behind a pair of threes from Caleb Foster, and an 11-0 burst, en route to a 90-47 win.

Diungkapkan bahwa siue fouled a lot early, putting duke in the bonus in the first five minutes. Duke's immense size advantage, paired with solid perimeter defense that held SIUE to 0-7 from behind the line, helped the Blue Devils roll out to a 43-20 lead.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the second half was more of the same. Duke's size and athleticism were overwhelming. SIUE hit a pair of threes early in the half, but there just wasn't much the Cougars could do. The Blue Devils ripped off a closing run of 20-3, outscored SIUE 47-27 after the break, and ultimately won by 43.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it was a lot better than we saw from duke against michigan state. Duke was much more aggressive and connected than they were in Chicago. Duke forced 19 turnovers, had 11 steals, and blocked eight shots. The Blue Devils were more physical and aggressive on defense. Five were by Patrick Ngongba; the other three were by Cameron Williams, who had his best game by far.

SIUE shot about 14 percent from outside and 30 percent overall.

Sebagaimana diketahui, offensively, after the slow start, duke shot 9-29 from outside (31 percent) and 30-66 overall (45 percent). If you deduct the cold 2-11 start, the Blue Devils shot 50. 9 percent overall and 36 percent from behind the line.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, inside, after the cold opening, duke shot 63. 3 percent.

Diungkapkan bahwa ngongba, who looked healthy after playing somewhat sick against michigan state, finished with 13 points on 4-6 shooting. He also had nine rebounds and four assists.

Sebagaimana diketahui, jojo boumtje boumtje finished with 11 points on 5-8/1-2 from the floor, and matched ngongba on the boards with nine of his own. Dame Sarr finished with 12 points, four rebounds, and three assists.

Berdasarkan laporan, cayden boozer had 11 points, led the team in rebounding (!) with 10. He also had four assists. John Blackwell continued his recent offensive struggle with just three points, shooting 1-7.

Sebagaimana diketahui, caleb foster came off the bench for 12 points and three boards. Sebastian Wilkins shot 1-5 from the floor, but hit 9-10 from the foul line. Williams finished with nine points.

Sebagaimana diketahui, coach jon scheyer said this about duke's offensive struggles: "offensively, i thought we looked disjointed. We're a little bit behind in role identification right now — knowing the strengths of each guy and how to position them the right way. As a coaching staff, we got to take the next step with that to help our team. ".

With high-powered Illinois in Cameron on Tuesday, figuring that out would be a good idea.

Sebagaimana diketahui, by the way, if you missed it, siue coach brian barone said this about visiting duke. Quite lovely, really.

Notes – Boumtje Boumtje pulled off a pretty keen spin move, going from the baseline to the basket in a big hurry…we haven't seen every team play, but Sebastian Wilkins is a huge luxury off the bench…we really like how Cayden Boozer is growing into his role as point guard…he'd probably prefer to be playing with brother Cameron, but it's fun to watch him build his own identity…you'd be hard-pressed to find a better teammate than Foster…Williams was a force tonight…like everyone, he was much more aggressive, but we saw more of his athleticism tonight than we'd seen previously….

#1158. Hugs will wait as Raiders’ ex-Seahawks trio hopes to spoil reunion with former team

Hugs will wait as Raiders’ ex-Seahawks trio hopes to spoil reunion with former team

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/hugs-wait-raiders-ex-seahawks-225815805.html

For all the time we spend talking about who needs a ring, who deserves a ring, and whose perfectly fine career will forever be held against him because he never won a ring, you'd think a guy who finally got his hands on one would wear the thing to the grocery store.

Sebagaimana diketahui, andrew janocko has worn his two times. And only at the urging of his better half.

"I wore it this summer twice at the request of my wife," the Raiders' offensive coordinator said Thursday.

Sebagaimana diketahui, las vegas raiders head coach klint kubiak, middle, reacts with assistant coaches during an nfl football game in santa clara, calif. , Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026. AP Photo/Justine Willard.

Diungkapkan bahwa the rest of the time, the super bowl ring janocko earned as the seahawks' quarterbacks coach stays tucked away in a safe deposit box. Which tells you something about how little time the NFL gives coaches to enjoy the very thing they spend their professional lives chasing.

Berdasarkan laporan, consider janocko's boss. On a special Sunday in February, Klint Kubiak called the plays that helped Seattle beat New England for the Super Bowl championsip. The very next day, the Raiders were announcing him as their head coach.

Many of us have had weekends off that lasted far longer than Kubiak got to be the reigning Super Bowl champion offensive coordinator of the Seattle Seahawks.

Diungkapkan bahwa kubiak wasted little time bringing two of his super bowl lieutenants with him to the desert. He tapped Janocko, who coached Sam Darnold in Seattle, to run the Raiders' offense and Rick Dennison, who coordinated the Seahawks' run game, to coach the offensive line.

Berdasarkan laporan, seattle seahawks head coach mike macdonald is doused with gatorade during super bowl lx against the new england patriots, sunday, feb. 8, 2026, in Santa Clara, Calif. Charles Wenzelberg/New York Post.

Sebagaimana diketahui, fernando mendoza's first nfl start will command most of the attention at allegiant stadium, and rightfully so. They spent last season figuring out how to get a special group of Seahawks to the Super Bowl. But consider what the afternoon asks of three men on the Raiders' sideline. They've spent this week trying to make sure their former colleagues have a miserable flight home.

"It's a big one because it's the next one," Janocko said of Sunday's game.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, seattle seahawks head coach mike macdonald watches his players warm up prior to an nfl football game against the arizona cardinals in seattle, sunday, nov. 8, 2026. AP Photo/Lindsey Wasson.

Berdasarkan laporan, give him credit. That might be the only way to make facing the team you won a championship with sound like a Thursday night in Cleveland.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, kubiak had a pretty good reason for holding off on the nostalgia himself. There were five Raiders turnovers on that film. When the subject came up early in the week, he still had a 38–17 loss to the 49ers to sort through. The trip down memory lane could wait until after the walkthrough.

"And I'll turn the page here later this afternoon," he said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ask kubiak what he brought with him from seattle, though, and he'll give you something to chew on. Tom Brady and the Raiders saw what he did with Darnold and wanted him to develop the quarterback they would select first overall. Kubiak, for his part, was paying attention to how the two men above him, head coach Mike Macdonald and general manager John Schneider, ran a football team.

Diungkapkan bahwa fernando mendoza of the las vegas raiders warms up before a game against the san francisco 49ers in santa clara, california, sunday, nov. 8, 2026. Getty Images.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "number one, i think it's just organizationally, just an all-football building, and from john schneider to coach macdonald, just extremely intelligent people that treat people the right way and get the most out of their people because they're genuinely good people. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa that might be the piece of seattle kubiak can put to work fastest. He'll have the head coach who called plays for a Super Bowl winner and the coordinator who sat next to that quarterback between possessions. On Sunday, Mendoza will come off the field after his first series as an NFL starter and look for somebody to talk to. Whatever the kid just saw, there's a decent chance one of them has seen it across a practice field.

As for what happens when Janocko sees the people he shared all that with, he's made room in the schedule.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we'll hug and stuff after the game, but we'll let everyone else deal with that. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, there'll be time for a handshake, a hug and, if the raiders can pull this off, maybe a little grief for a few old friends. Anybody hoping to get a look at Janocko's ring, though, ought to take it up with his wife. So far, she's the only one who's gotten him to wear it.

PUP = Physically unable to participate list.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ir = injured reserve. Note: only starters on IR are listed.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, probable = the league defines a probable injury designation as a 75% or greater chance of playing. Historically, 95% of players designated probable are active and played on game day.

Berdasarkan laporan, questionable = the league defines a questionable injury designation as being 'uncertain' of whether the player will play or not. This replaces the former definition of having a 50% chance of playing. Historically, 70-75% of players with a Questionable injury designation were active and played on game day.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, doubtful = the league defines a doubtful injury designation to mean the player is unlikely to participate in the game. In practical terms, teams use the designation when a player has less than a 50% chance to suit up, and active game appearances from this designation remain rare. Historically only around 6% of players with a Doubtful designation are active and played on game day.

Sebagaimana diketahui, out = will not play. Players with this designation are not active on game day and league rules prohibit them from playing.

On Friday, Rams coach Sean McVay explained the abrupt change of plans.

Diungkapkan bahwa plain and simple, the new york rangers took care of business friday night in vancouver, overwhelming the last-place canucks 5-1 at rogers arena. Which is exactly what should have been expected.

Berdasarkan laporan, make no mistake, this is a game the rangers (12-8-1) had to have. Not only to ensure a winning road trip in the Pacific Northwest, but because the Canucks (3-17-1) are an absolute train wreck, the worst team by far in the NHL.

Sebagaimana diketahui, though the rangers started slowly in the first period, there was only one expected and acceptable outcome. And that was a Rangers victory. No excuses.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, they've now lost seven in a row, and have just one victory in their past 18 games (1-16-1) since oct. 4 after winning two of their first three. They're the worst defensive team in the League, allowing more than four and a half goals per game on average, and their penalty kill is simply atrocious.

So, even though the Canucks took a 1-0 on an Elias Pettersson deflection at 12:13 of the first period, and the Rangers hadn't won a game this season after giving up the first goal, there was no way visitors could lose this game.

Berdasarkan laporan, gabe perreault's short-side snipe at 18:47 of the first tied things up. They scored four unanswered goals in a span of 7:49, out-shot the Canucks 12-4, and had a whopping expected goal share 5v5 of 84. And then it was a master class by the Rangers in the second period. 02 percent, per Natural Stat Trick.

Sebagaimana diketahui, through two periods, the rangers had a 16-6 advantage in high-danger chances. They took their foot off the gas some in the third period, but Dylan Garand stopped all 13 shots he faced in the final frame.

Sebagaimana diketahui, new york was the far better team at even strength, and on special teams — where they scored once on teh power play and were a perfect 3-for=3 on the penalty kill. Though none of this should come as a surprise.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the rangers took three of four on this road trip, after beginning it with just one road victory on the season. And this latest victory represented their first in nine games when allowing the first goal (1-7-1). 4.

Diungkapkan bahwa they reach the season's quarter-mark third in the metropolitan division, and winners in five of their past six games. And without a bitter taste in their collective mouth if they hadn't taken care of business in a can't-lose game in Vancouver.

Bob Frid-Imagn ImagesCredit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect.

It was a very happy homecoming for two BC boys — and by that we mean British Columbia, not Boston College, Perreault's goal notwithstanding.

Berdasarkan laporan, glenn gawdin scored the first two goals of his nhl career, and the richmond, bc native did so in his first-ever game in vancouver. Playing his second game since he was recalled from Hartford of the American Hockey League to center New York's fourth line earlier in the week, the 29-year-old took full advantage of a terrible giveaway by Canucks goalie Leevi Merilainen at the 13-minute mark of the second period to bury his first goal. A Vladislav Gavrikov drive caromed of Gawdin's skate and into the net 3:10 later to make it two goals on the night.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, first nhl goal alert 👏and it's been a long time coming for glenn gawdin! the 29 year old played his first nhl game back in february 2021 and gets his first career goal in his home province! pic. twitter. com/nciQfbutz3.

Berdasarkan laporan, this was gawdin's 15th game for three different teams since his nhl debut with the calgary flames on feb. 20, 2021. Yes, he's a career minor leaguer, one who's tied with Liam Greentree for the Hartford lead in scoring with 14 points this season. That makes what happened at Rogers Arena even sweeter for Gawdin.

"That was pretty special," Gawdin said in a postgame understatement.

Berdasarkan laporan, then there was garand, the victoria, bc native, who had 50 friends and family at the game. He was terrific in the first period, when the Rangers didn't quite have their legs yet, could've slept through the second, and then was up to the test in the third period, when the Canucks showed some life. Garand was at his best with a string of Grade-A saves during a pair of penalty kills in the final period, and finished with 27 saves to even his record at 7-7-1 this season.

Happy homecoming for a pair of native sons, indeed.

Diungkapkan bahwa canucks fans let rangers captain j. Miller hear it pretty much every time he touched the puck, showering the former Vancouver star with boos. T. Safe to say that didn't bother Miller, who assisted on each of New York's first two goals — the one that tied the score, and the eventual game-winner.

Berdasarkan laporan, miller won a puck battle from his nemesis, pettersson, to gain a secondary assist on perreault's first-period tally. Then 8:21 into the second period, Miller patiently waited for his teammates to get into position on the power play before he zipped a pass to Oliver Bjorkstrand. The veteran forward snapped one over the glove of Merilainen and the Rangers never looked back.

Diungkapkan bahwa after being boo'd all powerplay, miller gets his revenge and sets up bjorkstrand for the lead 😤🚨 pic. twitter. com/QvF4rykr0D.

— B/R Open Ice (@BR_OpenIce) November 14, 2026.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the canucks traded miller to the rangers back on jan. 31, 2025 after plenty of drama and locker room turmoil. Vancouver recived Filip Chytil as part of the return for Miller, and it was good to see the oft-injured center out there Friday, returning after missing five games with a shoulder injury, and facing the Rangers.

Bob Frid-Imagn ImagesCredit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect.

Noah Laba remains without a goal over the first 21 games of the season, but he certainly came close to breaking through — twice — during the first period.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, five minutes into the game, laba had a prime opportunity in close, but his back-hand shot was denied by merilainen. Then a couple minutes after Pettersson opened the scoring, Laba nearly tied it up when he drove down the middle of the ice to redirect a Will Cuylle pass off the rush. It took a sensational lunging left-pad save by Merilainen to keep the 23-year-old center off the score sheet.

If opportunities like those keep coming, Laba's more than due to finally end his drought.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, rangers defenseman braden schneider didn't play a single shift over the final 8:27 of this game. The durable 25-year-old was clearly in distress in his final shift of the game, one when he was on ice for 1:45 helping kill off an Adam Fox penalty.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, not only did schneider appear exhausted, he looked dinged up, as well. With the Canucks charging the crease and generating several scoring chance that Garand ultimately denied, Schneider could barely move, remaining hunched over outside the blue paint. When Garand finally covered up for a whistle, Schneider was actually pushed by Miller from behind to help him glide to the bench, where he remained for the rest of the night.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the rangers are already without defensemen sean durzi and alberts smits — each is on ir, though durzi is close to returning. Still, an injury of any significance to Schneider would be another blow for the Blueshirts blue line.

Diungkapkan bahwa what we learned as steph curry-less warriors look lost in ugly defeat vs. Spurs originally appeared on NBC Sports Bay Area.

The Warriors journeyed into the NBA's deadliest jungle without their superhero, and it didn't take long to realize they were easy prey.

While the Warriors were missing their first 11 shots, the white-hot San Antonio Spurs were scorching the nets, taking an 18-0 lead from which Golden State never came close to recovering in a 123- 85 walloping on Friday at Frost Bank Center.

It was such a lopsided affair that the Spurs pulled their starters in the third quarter.

The absence of Golden State scoring leader Stephen Curry (right oblique tear) was felt throughout, as the Warriors struggled to score in the paint, the terrain of 7-foot-5 Victor Wembanyama, and from beyond the arc.

Two-guard LJ Cryer rang up 20 points to lead the Warriors in scoring, with none of his teammates reaching double figures.

The best thing the Warriors did, with Draymond Green the primary defender, was contain Wembanyama, who finished with12 points, 12 rebounds and two blocks.

The big Frenchman was more than covered by his teammates, especially Stephon Castle, who posted a game-high 32 points.

Here are three observations from the kind of night the Warriors never want to revisit:.

Whatever plan the Warriors took into the game was shredded within three minutes.

Sebagaimana diketahui, when coach steve kerr called his first timeout with 9:33 left in the first quarter, his team had missed its first four shots while the spurs made five of their first six for a 12-0 lead. Golden State finally scored on a Gui Santos layup six minutes into the game.

The Spurs' 18-0 opening run was a San Antonio franchise record and, according to the stat mavens at Elias, the Warriors' worst start to any game since the league instituted such stats in 1997.

Diungkapkan bahwa the quarter closed with warriors trailing 38-14 after shooting 20. Their starters – De'Anthony Melton, Brandin Podziemski, Will Richard, Draymond Green, Yaxel Lendeborg – scored four points, shooting 1 of 14 (7. They were outrebounded 17-10 and outscored in the paint 16-4. 8 percent from the field, 25 percent from deep. 1 percent) from the field.

It was, for the Warriors, 12 minutes of the ugliest kind of foreshadowing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, with curry, averaging 27. 8 points per game, out for at least several weeks, much of Golden State's scoring burden falls into the laps of Lendeborg, the No. 2 scorer, at 21. 3 scorer, averaging 17. 7 points per game, and Podziemski, the No. 3 per game.

Facing a defense tilted their way, Lendeborg and Podziemski combined for six points in the first half – three fewer than two-way guard LJ Cryer managed off the bench – each shooting 1 of 8 from the field.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, lendeborg struggled mightily, finishing with a season-low three points on 1-of-13 shooting from the field, including 0 of 2 from beyond the arc while committing three turnovers. He was minus-40 over 24 minutes and at times was visibly frustrated.

Berdasarkan laporan, podziemski fared slightly better, totaling eight points on 2-of-11 shooting from the field, including 2 of 5 from distance. He was minus-24 over 22 minutes.

Berdasarkan laporan, this is the first of many games in which golden state won't have curry, and it happened to come on the road against the hottest – and best – team in the nba. It's reasonable to believe Lendeborg and Podziemski will recover.

If not, the Warriors will be in more trouble than they could have imagined.

Diungkapkan bahwa through the first 12 games this season, golden state's bench was among the most productive groups in the nba, ranking third in bench scoring at 45 points per game. That bench is not this bench.

Diungkapkan bahwa but brandon williams, the team's top bench scorer at 10. 4 points per game, is sidelined by a hamstring strain and will be reevaluated next week. The No. 2 bench scorer, Melton (10. 1 points per game), entered the starting lineup Friday to replace Curry and likely will stay there.

With Al Horford's 3-point shot MIA (1 of 11 over the past four games), it's suddenly a deeply compromised bench; no other reserve averages more than Niang's eight points per game.

These changes punch a massive a hole in the team's depth and force the two-way trio of Cryer, Graham Ike and Malevy Leons onto the court.

Victor Wembanyama controlled the interior and had his MVP-level two-way play shine.

Stephon Castle orchestrated the offense, and San Antonio overwhelmed Golden State with its combination of size, athleticism, and defensive intensity.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the spurs finished with a massive 60-43 rebounding advantage, scored 56 points in the paint, and recorded 34 assists while holding the warriors to just 33. 3% shooting from the field. Golden State never led, and San Antonio's largest advantage reached 43 points.

Here are four reasons why the Spurs were so dominant against the Warriors.

Stephon Castle was arguably the biggest offensive difference-maker in this matchup.

Diungkapkan bahwa the spurs guard finished with 32 points on 12-18 shooting, including five three-pointers on eight attempts. He also contributed six assists, five rebounds, and a block while committing just one turnover.

Berdasarkan laporan, castle's efficiency was particularly impressive considering how much responsibility he carried offensively. He consistently converted his opportunities while helping San Antonio maintain its offensive rhythm.

Berdasarkan laporan, his performance complemented the spurs' interior dominance perfectly. Golden State had no reliable answer for Castle's scoring, and his ability to create offense helped San Antonio establish an overwhelming advantage early.

Wembanyama didn't need an enormous scoring performance to completely influence the game.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the spurs superstar finished with 12 points, 12 rebounds, six assists, two steals, and two blocks in just 21 minutes. His defensive presence helped San Antonio control the paint while his passing contributed to the team's impressive offensive movement.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, golden state scored only 28 points in the paint, compared to san antonio's 56. That 28-point difference illustrates just how thoroughly the Spurs controlled the interior.

Wembanyama's combination of rim protection, rebounding, and playmaking made him an enormous advantage even without a high-volume scoring night.

The Spurs played exceptionally unselfish basketball.

Sebagaimana diketahui, san antonio recorded 34 assists on 46 made field goals, demonstrating how effectively the team generated quality scoring opportunities. Golden State finished with just 23 assists on 31 made shots.

Diungkapkan bahwa the difference extended beyond passing numbers. San Antonio shot 48. 4% from the field, while Golden State struggled to convert just 33. 3% of its attempts.

Devin Vassell, De'Aaron Fox, Dylan Harper, and Castle all contributed to the offensive structure, while Harrison Barnes and Keldon Johnson provided additional production off the bench.

The Spurs consistently found better offensive opportunities, and Golden State never established the defensive consistency necessary to slow them down.

San Antonio's dominance was perhaps most evident in the rebounding and transition numbers.

Berdasarkan laporan, the spurs grabbed 60 rebounds, including 15 offensive boards, compared to golden state's 43 total rebounds. That advantage gave San Antonio additional possessions while limiting the Warriors' ability to generate second-chance opportunities.

The Spurs also scored 21 fast-break points, compared to just three for Golden State.

San Antonio's seven steals and seven blocks further demonstrated its defensive activity, while the Warriors struggled to find consistent offensive rhythm.

With a 56-28 advantage in points in the paint and a 60-43 edge on the boards, the Spurs completely controlled the physical aspects of the game.

On third-and-three, Rashee Rice ran a comeback route and picked up the first down to keep the drive alive. Mahomes then connected with newly acquired Josh Downs for a 12-yard gain and another first down.

Sebagaimana diketahui, josh downs hauled in an 18-yard pass on a deep out route, going up to make the catch while keeping both feet in bounds. The reception moved the Chiefs to the Falcons' 25-yard line.

Diungkapkan bahwa the chiefs' final attempt fell incomplete as mahomes tried to make a throw while being taken down by the pass rush. Kansas City turned the ball over on downs, ending its comeback attempt.

#1182. Dejounte Murray’s trade request creates an opportunity for the Suns

📅 13 Nov 2026

Dejounte Murray’s trade request creates an opportunity for the Suns

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/dejounte-murray-trade-request-creates-205042203.html

Sebagaimana diketahui, over the first eleven games of the season, it has not all been sunshine and rainbows for this suns team. This has brought them to a 5-6 record, which lets them beat the bad teams but struggle against the good ones. They have seen injuries, rebounding issues, and lapses on both ends of the floor. As Espo from PHNX said the other night, they are basically in basketball purgatory right now, and some things need to change. Regardless of whether it's a lineup switch, plugging in Jordan Goodwin or Collin Gillespie for Jalen Green, or potentially a trade on the horizon.

Diungkapkan bahwa in last night's contest against the charlotte hornets, we saw jalen green benched and not finish the game. This move allowed the Suns to regain their lead and still win a game they should have controlled the whole way. Since Green hasn't been playing well in the lineup and has been forced into this playmaking role, many are making him the scapegoat for the team's early-season struggles.

While they are right to put most of the blame on him, it is not entirely his fault, as sometimes the bigs have trouble rebounding or some of the forwards are not locked in defensively.

Berdasarkan laporan, this is where green has become a devalued asset across the league, as they now know he cannot fit with this starting lineup, and the suns will likely switch things up as we get closer to the deadline. With Green still 24, some lottery teams will likely be willing to take a chance on him and let him shine with their club. For the Suns, today's news may have made that landing spot clearer.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dejounte murray of the new orleans pelicans has requested a trade. I've highlighted him multiple times as a good target for the Suns for many reasons, but now that his value is depleted and he's on the market, this is the perfect trade for both teams. Both teams have an asset with depreciated value that could help the other franchise, and everyone seems to be catching on.

Diungkapkan bahwa they've also been linked to murray via chris haynes in this tweet. Haynes was the first to address locker-room concerns via the Suns, saying many felt the team needed a true point guard. Well, Murray could come in and fill that role as a better fit for the starters, but also mesh into the defensive identity that Jordan Ott wants to bring to this Phoenix team,.

Sebagaimana diketahui, murray, who has a $30. 8 million player option next season, would accept it heading into next offseason but at 30, doesn't seem to want a long-term, expensive deal. On the other hand, Green is young and looking to extend long term. With Booker's contract coming up, plus the Brooks extension and a potential Bridges extension, and Beal's dead money, it doesn't seem feasible to pay all four players, especially when they look this bad on the court together.

Sebagaimana diketahui, green is also the same player option as murray, just at $36 million, and is making that same amount this season, so not only would you save $4 million this season and $6 million next year, but you would save yourself from a pain-inducing contract negotiation. It is clear Green can't be a starter given his recent play, and Murray, who has been a head case in NOLA, may be the same, but it's an unknown.

Berdasarkan laporan, i feel murray, who has been frustrated with the pelicans this season, will buy into the suns' culture once he gets here. As we know, the Pelicans are bad and lack a clear direction for building. They view Herb Jones and Trey Murphy III as high pieces but not the building blocks of their rebuild. It seems like there are three timelines: Jones and Murphy III, Zion Williamson, and Murray as the vets who can help with a playoff push, and then you've got Jeremiah Fears and Derik Queen as the young building blocks. Getting a young player like Green may not be the best fit, but it would give him a chance to return to his scoring form and try to become their number-one offensive option.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for the suns, this move frees up some money and gives you a player who can hopefully buy into the culture and help alleviate some of the pain for your best player. Murray isn't coming in as a game-changing secondary option, but if he can buy into the team role and do the little things, he could find some great success in this starting lineup. Murray was an all-caliber defender in San Antonio, and yeah, he's had many injuries, but I still think some of that player is still in him if he gets to Phoenix.

Diungkapkan bahwa ultimately, time will tell whether the suns make this move or switch their starting lineups first. That said, the Pelicans front office doesn't have the best track record with trades, so maybe the Suns can get something else thrown in for taking on their disgruntled player, since Green hasn't made his frustrations as obvious as Murray's. One good thing to know, though, is that Murray wants out, and the Suns look like one of the only teams that would need a true point guard. With both Green and Murray at their lowest values and on similar contracts, it seems a one-for-one deal could be the easiest thing for both parties. Could the Suns try to get a pick back in exchange for a younger asset? That's something I'd like to see them try to pull off, alongside bringing in Murray to give them more flexibility in the long term.

What are your thoughts? Is Dejounte Murray someone you would like the Suns to go after? Is there another piece you think would be a better fit? Ultimately, given what assets the Suns have to trade, this may be the best option they can pursue without hurting their depth too much, and I'd like it to materialize.

The Minnesota Vikings finally made the announcement that many have been expecting for several days.

Berdasarkan laporan, quarterback kirk cousins will start against the green bay packers in week 10, head coach kevin o'connell announced on friday, nov. 13. The intra-divisional game will mark the start of Cousins' second stint in Minnesota, three years after his last game for the Vikings.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "kirk cousins will start the football game. Cannot give him enough credit for coming in here, how he's gone about the week. Both him and the coaching staff getting him ready to go, working extremely hard, using all the time we possibly can," O'Connell said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "it's been really impressive, what he's been able to do. just getting right back in the huddle with a lot of guys he's played with, but certainly some guys he hasn't. It's been something that everybody's been very, very impressed by. Excited to start Kirk in the game, see him play on Sunday. ".

KIRK COUSINS: Veteran QB kept mum about his chance to start Week 10.

Diungkapkan bahwa coincidentally, the upcoming nov. 15 clash will be Cousins' second straight matchup against the Packers as the Vikings' starting quarterback. The last game the 38-year-old played for Minnesota, in 2023, was also at Lambeau Field.

Sebagaimana diketahui, cousins' first stint with the vikings ended unceremoniously – trainers had to cart him off of the field after he tore his achilles during a game his team went on to win. In the offseason that followed, the Vikings allowed him to walk in free agency, and he went on to sign a four-year, $180 million contract with the Atlanta Falcons.

Diungkapkan bahwa cousins said in his (re-)introductory press conference with the vikings on nov. 11 that he expects the Week 10 game to be meaningful. It's both his first game back with Minnesota but also his return to Lambeau Field for the first time since the 2023 injury.

Diungkapkan bahwa "it means a lot to play at lambeau field, no matter what the circumstances," cousins said. "Knowing that that was where I was carted off, and I had thoughts of, 'Is this my last game? Is this my last game as a Viking?' To be back out there, wearing the purple and gold. It has meaning, but you have to go make it mean something with the way you play. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, in nine starts with the las vegas raiders this season, cousins has a 4-5 record. He was 202-of-315 passing for 2,340 yards, 20 touchdowns and eight interceptions. His 97. 1 passer rating so far this season is his highest since his previous stint with Minnesota.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the vikings are hoping the addition of cousins will help kick-start an offensive resurgence. The team has lost two straight following a 6-0 start, and it sits in third place in a tightly contested NFC North.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while the defense has been a strong point – the 14. 5 points per game the unit has allowed so far is the fewest in the league – the offense has struggled. Minnesota's 18. 3 points scored per game are sixth-fewest in the NFL.

Austin Reaves' injury update wasn't as dire as it could've been.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, austin reaves shouldn't be sidelined for long. NBAE via Getty Images.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, austin reaves suffered a heel injury during the second half of the lakers' win over the bucks on wednesday. AP Photo/Aaron Gash.

Reaves subbed himself out and limped to the back of Fiserv Forum with team personnel because of the heel injury he suffered midway through the third quarter of the Lakers' eventual seventh straight victory of the season.

The Lakers ruled Reaves out for the remainder of the game midway through the fourth quarter, saying he had a heel injury.

Berdasarkan laporan, austin reaves' hot start to the season hit a hitch with his heel injury. NBAE via Getty Images.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, these initiatives, together with the development of offshore and onshore resources, will expand supply options and contribute to strengthening energy security and the reliability of colombia's gas market. Regarding domestic supply during the third quarter of 2026, Ecopetrol maintained its position as the only domestic producer to offer and allocate firm gas volumes to the market. Next slide. During the quarter, we allocated additional volumes from Cupiagua, complemented by new production sources in Huila. These actions allowed us to make additional gas volumes available to the market, contributing to the reliability of domestic supply. Ecopetrol also actively contributed and responded promptly to operational events affecting the system.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, during the scheduled maintenance of the spec regasification terminal between july 30 and august 3, we marketed 97 gbtud to help meet thermal generation and essential demand. Subsequently, during the operational contingency at SPEC in September, we increased the availability of gas from Cusiana and Cupiagua by 5 GBTUD for six days, helping mitigate the impact on regulated demand and the national transportation system. This contributed to maintaining the operational stability of the pipeline system until SPEC resumed normal operations. More recently, on October 27, we increased supply by an additional 5 GBTUD to support the system during the contingency resulting from the scheduled curtailment associated with another SPEC shutdown. Next.

First, through our energy efficiency program, we achieved cumulative optimization of 2. This allowed us to reduce the group's energy requirements and consequently our exposure to increased energy supply costs. Through a combination of conventional self-generation on-site and remote renewable self-generation and active contracting management, our purchases in the wholesale electricity market were made at average prices of 8. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, thank you so much. Now, we'll hand it over to our CEO.

Sebagaimana diketahui, joaquín gutiérrez: let me conclude this presentation with a reflection on the environment that we're facing and our priorities going forward. In this context, our organic production is declining as fields mature, and it requires exploration and sustained investment to boost volumes. We are operating in a context marked by geopolitical volatility, higher logistics costs, pressure on capital, and challenges in sustaining organic production. In addition, we have seen wider discounts on certain crudes relative to Brent and greater volatility in refined product differentials, reflecting an energy market that remains tight and subject to supply and global logistics disruptions. Yet, amid these challenges, Ecopetrol has distinctive strengths to navigate this environment.

Berdasarkan laporan, we have an increasingly flexible commercial platform and a portfolio of opportunities that includes brava, sirius, orca, and our recent exploration successes. We have the ability to capture value through an integrated model that combines production, transportation, refining, marketing, and a growing international presence, as reflected in the results we have presented. In gas, in particular, we are simultaneously advancing on short, medium, and long-term solutions that contribute to the country's energy security and allow us to monetize the potential of our resources. This new stage demands that we go further, and our priority is to transform Ecopetrol so we can do things differently and prepare it for new opportunities and challenges.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that is why our focus is on organizational and operational transformation to raise productivity, efficiency, and profitability across the ecopetrol group by simplifying processes, eliminating rework, and reducing costs through rigorous capital allocation. The progress presented today shows that this transformation is already underway. We will achieve excellence in the execution and delivery of strategic projects by accelerating strategic decision-making, and we will build a more efficient organization based on delivering results. We are unlocking strategic projects, strengthening institutional coordination, mitigating material risks for the company, and advancing initiatives that have a tangible impact on our growth prospects, competitiveness, and value creation.

Sebagaimana diketahui, opportunities are important, but what truly matters is our ability to turn them into concrete, tangible, and demonstrable results. That will be the measure of this new era of rebirth, a more agile and competitive Ecopetrol, capable of turning opportunities into sustainable results, where we can strengthen reserves, develop gas, improve profitability, preserve a solid financial position, and create sustainable value for our shareholders. All of this alongside our employees, whom I thank for their commitment and dedication, as well as our investors, clients, communities, and other stakeholders for their trust. May determination guide our decisions, and may the future of Colombia be the goal we never stop pursuing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, welcome once again to the new era of the crown jewel of the nation, the company we will defend because it belongs to all colombians by nature. Welcome to the rebirth that will mark the beginning of a new chapter for Ecopetrol and for all of Colombia. Thank you very much. With this, we begin the Q&A session.

Berdasarkan laporan, "this is where we belong," brooks said. "It's been a long stretch of really good football for Rockwall, and I just feel like last year was just a little bump in the road, and we're back where we need to be. ".

Gordon finished with a game-high 138 yards rushing, 215 yards receiving and five total touchdowns.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i lost some sleep this week thinking about how to stop him," brooks said. But he's a special player. "But I thought our guys did a good job, obviously, especially in the first half. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa "last year we didn't really have the outcome we wanted, and i didn't personally do as good as i wanted to," castro said. "So this year, I wanted to go out there and make a point and help this team to succeed this season. ".
