#1189. The Goal of the Utah Jazz This Season: Win The NBA Cup

📅 13 Nov 2026

The Goal of the Utah Jazz This Season: Win The NBA Cup

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/goal-utah-jazz-season-win-203010655.html

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if you follow me on tiktok or twitter you may already know this about me, but for those who don't: i am a big nba cup supporter. I am also a big soccer (or as I call it, footy) fan, so I was already prone to enjoying these in-season tournaments. We #RespectTheCup in this house. When it was announced I actually think that I was one of the only ones in my content creation circle, and certainly the only one in my friend group, to be 100% on board with the idea.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, while adam silver has had more missteps in the last few years than i would prefer, he knocked it out of the park with the nba cup. As mentioned above, I think that there are ways to improve the tournament, but even in its short existence, it has brought much needed excitement and punch to the early portion of the NBA season.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the utah jazz haven't had the season that any of us would have envisioned, and while starting 1-11 is quite the hole to put ourselves in, the nba cup allows us to strive towards a real goal outside of "development. " Even more important than presenting an opportunity to lift up some hardware, getting all the way to the NBA Cup Final would prove that this team is ready to compete one day.

Berdasarkan laporan, the nba cup's lineage is relatively short, but in its brief history we've been able to see some truly great basketball teams compete for the prize. If we take a trip down memory lane, we will notice something almost immediately — the teams that make it are/were threats to the rest of the league.

These weren't flukes, they were mistakes; if you made it to the Final, you were a team with the aspirations and the roster to play basketball in June.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the inaugural nba cup final was a success by every single metric there is. The game drew 4. 58 million viewers between ABC and ESPN, the arena in Las Vegas hosted over 19,000 fans, and the Final featured one of the most exciting teams in the league at the time in the Indiana Pacers and the one of the most well known brands in all of sports in the Los Angeles Lakers, of course led by LeBron James – one of the most recognizable athletes in the world.

Berdasarkan laporan, while the lakers weren't world beaters at this time, being three years removed from a championship, the year prior this squad lost in the western conference finals to the ever dangerous denver nuggets. Haliburton was coming off of an All-Star campaign the year prior and the Pacers were just so fun to watch. On the other side of the bracket, Tyrese Haliburton and the Indiana Pacers were the talk of the town. The matchup also presented an opportunity for there to be a "passing of the torch" moment, but LeBron had other plans.

Diungkapkan bahwa lebron finished the game with 24 points, 11 rebounds, and 4 assists, anthony davis had a game of a lifetime with 41 points and 20 rebounds, and austin reaves chipped in 28 points off the bench in route to a 123-109 victory. LeBron won the inaugural NBA Cup MVP award, the most recognizable NBA team in the world won the inaugural NBA Cup, and the win reiterated that the Los Angeles Lakers were still going to compete at the highest level.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while i was personally rooting for the indiana pacers in this game, they gave it everything they had. It wasn't the result that they (or I) wanted, but it wasn't long before they proved to be worthy opponents themselves. Haliburton had a cool 20 point and 11 assist performance while Bennedict Mathurin scored 20 off the bench. Lest we forget that the Pacers could have been one catastrophic injury away from lifting up the Larry O'Brien Trophy the following year in the 2024-2025 NBA Season.

Diungkapkan bahwa the second iteration of the nba cup had quite the shoes to fill, but the nba cup final did not disappoint. While there wasn't a widely recognizable brand in the Final like the Lakers or the Celtics, there was a massive amount of star power.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the milwaukee bucks were just a few years removed from a nba championship themselves, and giannis antetokounmpo was out to prove that they could still compete. Giannis was, and still is, one of the the world's best players and one of the game's biggest names. With Damian Lillard at his side, Giannis was out to prove that the Bucks were still threats to come out of the East.

Berdasarkan laporan, over in the west, the oklahoma city thunder were taking the league by storm. The year prior the team showed up on everyone's radar after winning 57 games, and this year turned out to be no different. After it was all said and done, the OKC Thunder won 68 games led by Shai Gilgeous-Alexander who won his first MVP award, and the crew hoisted the Larry O'Brien Trophy at the end of the year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, unfortunately for the thunder, giannis and the bucks weren't ready to lose this night. Giannis lead the way with a 26 point, 19 rebound, and 10 assist triple-double while Damian Lillard scored 23 points and led the Bucks to a 97-81 victory.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the power of friendship didn't help the thunder on this night, but they did give it their best effort: sga scored 21, jalen williams scored 18,and isaiah hartenstein chipped in 16. While they weren't victorious this night, they did prove to the world that they could compete with anyone in the league. After making it all the way to the NBA Cup Final, they dominated the regular season and defeated the aforementioned Indiana Pacers in 7 games in the NBA Finals.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the third iteration of the nba cup was arguably the best of the three. It also combined the best of both worlds from the previous two matchups: mega star power AND a recognizable brand. They don't call Madison Square Garden "The Mecca of Basketball" for no reason. The New York Knicks are either the second or third (depending on who you ask) most recognizable brand in all of basketball, and for good reason. To top it all off, the Knicks were coming off of a 51 win season and a Conference Finals appearance the previous year, and Jalen Brunson just made the All-NBA 2nd Team.

Diungkapkan bahwa out west the san antonio spurs were well ahead of schedule with their roster. Stephon Castle just won the Rookie of the Year award the previous year, they drafted Dylan Harper with the #2 overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft, and Victor Wembanyama had displayed All-World potential despite missing most of the 2024-2025 NBA season with DVT. To a lesser extent compared to the Knicks, the Spurs are also a world wide brand in the basketball realm due to the success of international stars like Tony Parker and Manu Ginobili.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with all of the star power and recognizable brands at play, it shouldn't be a surprise that the amazon prime video broadcast averaged over 3 million viewers. The Spurs had 7 players in double figures; Wemby and Dylan Harper combined for 39 points off the bench, while Stephon Castle scored 15 points and dropped 12 dimes as a starter. What also wasn't a surprise is that both teams came to play. For the Knicks, their Power of Friendship mantra rang true with 7 players scoring in double digits led by Jalen Brunson's 25 points and OG Anunoby's 28 points.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the knicks came out on top 124-113, but this was just the appetizer for the nba finals. In the NBA Cup Final both teams proved that they had what it took to compete at the highest level, and then they both powered their way through the NBA Playoffs to meet in the NBA Finals. Unfortunately for The Baseline Bums, the Knicks prevailed again in a 4-1 series win to secure a championship for the first time in 53 years.

Berdasarkan laporan, time and time again, the nba cup has proven to be the battleground for future competitors and nba championship threats. THAT is what we should be striving for. In all three years of existence, the teams competing in the NBA Cup have either already climbed to the mountain top or they were getting ready to take the league by storm. I think after the 1-11 start it would be very difficult to compete for a Playoff spot (I predicted that we would finish 7th) so we should strive to do something more enticing than another year of developing our young talent.

Sebagaimana diketahui, we had higher expectations for our team, but we've had a season from hell when it comes to the injury department: jaren jackson jr. Do I think that it will be difficult to win the games necessary to advance in the NBA Cup tournament without them? Absolutely. is out until the new year, Jusuf Nurkic will be out for at least another two weeks, and Lauri Markkanen will miss at least a month with his hand fracture. Do I think that this is a tremendous chance for our young players to prove what they can do? Without a doubt.

Diungkapkan bahwa the road will be hard, especially after dropping our first nba cup game against the mavericks 112-100, but i don't think that our chance to win has been snuffed out. There is a real scenario where the Jazz go 3-1 in group play and earn a spot in the NBA Cup Quarter Finals. After that, the Suns and Nuggets are both very volatile. Tonight we play the Houston Rockets, and while they are formidable, they are not unbeatable. Once we get there, it just takes a hot streak to take us all the way to the Promised Land.

Sebagaimana diketahui, again, without lauri or jjj, the burden will be placed on our younger players and luckily we have the firepower to do it. Keyonte George is good for 20 points a game this year, Darryn Peterson became the first teenager in Utah Jazz history to score 20+ points in four straight games, and Ace Bailey has proven that he is invaluable to this team.

Diungkapkan bahwa the season has been disappointing so far, but there are reasons to be excited and goals to strive for. There is a lot of basketball left to play this year, and I for one am not satisfied with chalking up this year to another development year. Our goal for the rest of the year should be to win the NBA Cup, because if we can do that with a depleted roster, just imagine what we can do in the 2027-2028 season with a fully heathy squad.

#1191. Jensen Huang Steps Down as CEO. Is Nvidia Still a Buy?

📅 13 Nov 2026

Jensen Huang Steps Down as CEO. Is Nvidia Still a Buy?

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/11/13/jensen-huang-steps-down-as-ceo-is-nvidia-still-a-buy/?source=iedfolrf0000001

A slew of extramarital affairs and security risks have shaken Nvidia's investment thesis to the core.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nvidia (nvda -2. 01%) has been tethered to the spotlight since Nov. 8, when founder and then-CEO Jensen Huang admitted to having an affair with Alice Huang.

Sebagaimana diketahui, alice huang (no relation to jensen) was an executive at a singapore-based nvidia customer. On Nov. And reports indicate that U. S. officials and the FBI are investigating the relationship because Alice Huang is suspected of being a Chinese intelligence operative. 10, Nvidia hired a prominent New York law firm to initiate an independent investigation into the affair.

Berdasarkan laporan, the situation escalated after market close on nov. 12, reports surfaced of a possible third affair with a second employee. 11, when the New York Times reported that Jensen Huang had a romantic relationship with Nvidia's vice president of healthcare, Kimberly Powell. On Nov. That same day, Nvidia published a press release, announcing that Huang had resigned, with CFO Colette Kress taking over as interim CEO.

Berdasarkan laporan, as of market close on nov. 12, Nvidia is down a staggering 27. 5% in the last month. Here's how the recent news surrounding Huang impacts Nvidia's investment thesis and whether the growth stock is still a buy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, jensen huang was arguably the most important ceo in the world. He co-founded Nvidia with Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem 33 years ago and possesses a rare balance of technical, strategic, marketing, and leadership skills.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i recently read the nvidia way: jensen huang and the making of a tech giant by tae kim. And the biggest takeaway I had from the book is that Huang is arguably more integral to Nvidia than Steve Jobs was to Apple (AAPL +0. It's an excellent book that serves as both a history of Nvidia and a biography of Huang. 39%), Bill Gates was to Microsoft, or Jeff Bezos was to Amazon.

Berdasarkan laporan, tim cook was able to catapult apple's market cap up severalfold, even after jobs's passing, by leveraging apple's integrated ecosystem of products and services. Huang has made several key decisions throughout the company's history. Nvidia is different. When it comes to artificial intelligence (AI) in the semiconductor industry, competition is fierce, and innovation is paramount. And without them, it's highly unlikely the tech stock would be where it is today.

Diungkapkan bahwa huang was a firm believer in parallel computing and the graphics processing unit (gpu) -- a term nvidia helped coin when it debuted the geforce 256 in 1999 -- and labeled it the world's first gpu. He was also adamant about CUDA, which is Nvidia's software architecture used by developers with Nvidia GPUs.

Sebagaimana diketahui, by integrating hardware and software, nvidia paved a runway for repeat business in an industry where a hot product can leapfrog the moats of even the most entrenched industry leaders. After all, Huang saw this in the early days of Nvidia, when the company almost went bankrupt multiple times because it developed products too infrequently and bet the farm on a single launch.

Sebagaimana diketahui, huang also has an impeccable work ethic and top-to-bottom devotion to nvidia -- arguably to a fault. Nvidia's organization structure positioned Huang like Jupiter, surrounded by dozens of direct reports that orbit him like moons. This wasn’t just so Huang could keep tabs. It's so that he can contribute through spontaneous bursts of creativity.

Berdasarkan laporan, to complement this workflow, nvidia has whiteboards scattered throughout meeting rooms for ideation and real-time problem-solving. The knowledge and willingness to break concepts down, start from scratch, and hold frequent open discussions have become essential parts of Nvidia's corporate culture. And it remains to be seen if that will persist under new leadership.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, huang has also been a firm proponent of ai. And it's a key reason why Nvidia was able to shift its end markets from gaming, professional visualization, and automotive to data centers in just a few years. Gaining a foothold in AI was one thing. But Nvidia has continued to push the bounds of innovation through incredibly impressive product upgrades.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nvidia could have easily taken its foot off the gas after announcing its grace blackwell architecture in march 2024. Blackwell unlocked massive efficiency improvements and cost reductions in AI training. But Nvidia really outdid itself with Vera Rubin, which it announced in January 2026.

Berdasarkan laporan, rubin's full-stack platform includes six chips, allowing nvidia to control a larger share of data center infrastructure. 26 Q2 fiscal 2027 earnings call, Nvidia said that it began shipping Rubin in August and expects it to account for 20% of its Q3 data center revenue, which it will report on Nov. Rubin's cost reductions and efficiency improvements compared to Blackwell are so massive that hyperscalers are lining up at the door to place orders. On the Aug. 17.

Berdasarkan laporan, reports of three affairs, an internal investigation, an fbi probe, and now jensen huang resigning as ceo directly impact the investment thesis. Until we get answers on the extent of the damage and the next long-term CEO, the stock simply isn't as strong a buy as it used to be -- even with a valuation that's ridiculously cheap for such a high-quality business.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i wouldn't sell nvidia simply because the company's operating leverage and market position are impossible to ignore. But it's hard to imagine Nvidia without Jensen Huang's leadership. The situation would be different if Huang had a clear successor, but there's nothing of the kind at Nvidia, which poses a major key-person risk.

Diungkapkan bahwa at the very least, nvidia must overhaul its organizational structure. Poor character aside, I'd expect any replacement to fall short of Huang's caliber as a CEO. And that's legitimately concerning for investors.

Diungkapkan bahwa as tempting as the sell-off looks at first glance, investors are better off waiting for the dust to settle. I'd much rather buy the stock at a higher price with greater clarity than bottom-fish in waters this murky.

Former UFC bantamweight champion Sean O'Malley has an idea for Usman Nurmagomedov's UFC debut whenever he signs with the promotion.

Despite being sentenced to six months in prison for his role in a gang attack against Merab Dvalishvili at an Abu Dhabi hotel earlier this week, the UFC is still expected to sign Nurmagomedov once he gets out of prison.

When that happens, O'Malley knows just the fight for him.

Speaking on his YouTube channel, O'Malley suggested that Nurmagomedov fights former UFC lightweight champion Ilia Topuria for his debut.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "does this set up a fight between ilia topuria and usman nurmagomedov? that's a crazy fight. Ilia makes sense. The storyline's there," O'Malley said (via MMAjunkie. He's 5-6, Usman's probably 6-1. These are huge, massive, insane numbered main events that don't have any titles on the line. Usman is up there. It would be an interesting fight. it would be a tough fight for both guys. … I think Usman vs. That's the fight to make. That's a crazy, hard fight for Ilia to bounce back from. I mean, Ilia vs. It's an insane fight for Usman to jump into the UFC pool. It is a fight that I want to see. Ilia's big, but he's not tall. That would be a crazy fight. Paddy (Pimblett) is up there, Ilia vs. com).

Berdasarkan laporan, the idea of a nurmagomedov vs. Topuria fight is certainly one that makes a lot of sense given that both men have a lot of bad blood against one another, especially in the wake of the attack on Dvalishvili, who is a close friend of Topuria's.

That being said, it seems far more likely that Topuria will fight Paddy Pimblett next, as that's the fight that has been teased for several months now, and one that makes more sense based on the UFC rankings.

But we all know the UFC is a business, so don't be surprised if and when the UFC inks Nurmagomedov to a contract, that he gets a huge name in his debut with the promotion.

It was only a matter of time before Draymond Green earned his first flagrant foul of the 2026-27 NBA season, and the Warriors veteran crossed it off during Golden State's NBA Cup game against the San Antonio Spurs on Friday night at Frost Bank Center.

Diungkapkan bahwa green sent victor wembanyama to the floor with 6:47 left in the second quarter as the warriors trailed 45-22, making contract with the spurs star's back that officials deemed included a "wind up" by green. Diungkapkan bahwa the bulldogs grabbed the first four points of the night, but xavier punched back immediately and never gave the lead back after tru washington (21/8/4) put on a personal 5-0 run. Xavier started to gain separation near the midway point of the half when Ruben Dominguez (9/0/0) was fouled shooting a three and cashed out all three free throws then cut out the middle man and drained a three the next time down to put X up 7 and put the Bulldogs on the ropes. That pushed the lead to a dozen and a triple from Jovan Milicevic (12/3/0) prompted a Chris Jans timeout and put Xavier in a spot where they were well and truly in the driver's seat. Xavier never took their foot off the gas, forced 13 second half turnovers, and gave the impression of a team that is comfortable playing with a lead against high major talent.

Diungkapkan bahwa xavier's defense has made a huge leap- in the past two seasons, josh hubbard has scored 12 or fewer points in 4 outings against high major competition. There was a moment in the first half when he started to heat up, but Xavier's size and aggression kept him off balance the rest of the night and forced one of the best scorers in the country into a line of 12/4/3 with 4 turnovers and 4-12/2-8/2-2 shooting. Xavier wanted to get bigger in the portal, and that showed in the way they stifled the Bulldogs offense tonight, holding them to 0. 8 points per possession.

Diungkapkan bahwa the depth passed the first test- xavier had the luxury of being able to play basically whoever they wanted in the first three games and knowing that it was probably going to work out for them. Tonight, the bench got shorter, but they still combined to chip in 34 points and give Xavier some big minutes. Kalek House couldn't get his shots falling, not for lack of trying, but ended the night with 4 boards, 3 assists, a block, a steal, and no turnovers in 21 minutes. Chitikoudis ended up playing more minutes than Nwoko, taking 25 of the 40 at the center spot and was excellent if you ignore the column that tells you how well each player shot free throws. Rolyns Aligbe had a night to forget shooting wise, but 6 rebounds, a block, and a steal in 12 minutes is nothing to shake a stick at and Ruben Dominguez lost his starting spot, but responded with 9 points in 9 minutes on 2-3/2-3/3-3 shooting. It didn't all click for all these guys tonight, but the bench was a large reason why this one was such a comfortable win for X.

The Bulldogs were state runner-up in 2025 and made back-to-back state tournament appearances for the first time in school history. Over the last two years, they have won 49 games.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "it is hard right now, but the five seniors we had were great this year," mcferin said. Lafayette Jeff football's postseason ends in regional with loss to Warsaw

LAFAYETTE — Jeff football lined up together on its side of the field, as it does every week, but it wasn't in the same way its grown accustomed to over the last several weeks.

Diungkapkan bahwa the bronchos made history with their third consecutive sectional championship this season, but the road ended at the regional once again with a 49-39 loss to warsaw on friday, nov. 13. On the other side of the field, the Tigers celebrated their second regional title with the trophy raised in the air.

Diungkapkan bahwa coach pat shanley acknowledged it was one that hurt. He called senior leader Ka'vion Campbell-Walker up to make a departing speech, who commanded every player's attention with a passionate message to the underclassmen to carry on the work when he's gone.

More: Lafayette area IHSAA football regional championship game scores, updates.

Diungkapkan bahwa more: benton central's claire whaley voted nov. 2-8 J&C Athlete of the Week, sponsored by Ivy Tech.

Sebagaimana diketahui, he and other seniors, such as wide receiver bryce vanostran, quarterback trysten barrett and defensive lineman chris hardy, have laid the foundation for the program over the years. That group has helped them get to a place where they can be surefire sectional winners each season and have chances to make it deeper into November.

Diungkapkan bahwa the bronchos couldn't quite kick down the doors of regional this year. But they have no doubts that they'll continue to build the foundation up and accomplish that soon.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we have a program that is only going to continue to get better," shanley said. "We have people in this community that are really committed and understand what we're doing and what we're building. You have kids that really believe in it and they love it. … We're going to fight, claw and scratch to find ways to get better and to kick that door in.

Berdasarkan laporan, on the opening drive, vanostran got the crowd at schuemann stadium fired up with a 63-yard touchdown at the 10:01 mark of the first quarter off a pass from barrett. It was a whole lot of yards after the catch, and VanOstran skipped his way to celebrate the moment in front of the crowd. That was the energy Jeff needed to start the night.

Berdasarkan laporan, but warsaw's flexbone triple option offense, a style of play that jeff has grown to be familiar with over the years, quickly took over. The Tigers tied it up at 7-7 at the 5:11 mark, but their next drive signaled something that the Broncho defense couldn't contain for the rest of the game.

Diungkapkan bahwa quarterback mark haynes broke loose and went untouched for an 80-yard touchdown with 1:27 remaining in the first, before converting a two-point conversion to give warsaw a 15-10 lead. The defensive breakdowns happened again at the 3:22 mark in the second, in which Brady Sauer bounced to the outside and down the sideline for a 50-yard touchdown on fourth-and-2.

By the end of the first half, the Tigers led 29-10.

Diungkapkan bahwa "you got to stop a quarterback/fullback, right? so, you're kind of damned if you do and damned if you don't," shanley said of the warsaw run game. … (coach Bart Curtis) is a Hall of Famer. He's a really, really good coach. He runs that flexbone as well as anybody in the country. "We spent a lot of time studying it. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, warsaw switched it up to start the second half. It opted for a pass play, in which lineman Grady Nelson snuck by the Jeff defense for a wide-open catch to score a 46-yard passing touchdown at the 9:11 mark of the third quarter.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the bronchos needed to score quickly, which they found a rhythm in throughout the second half. Barrett threw another shot for an explosive play at the 8:11 mark in which receiver Na'Darius Young caught it and raced down the sideline for a 66-yard touchdown on third-and-11.

Berdasarkan laporan, both vanostran and young finished the night with another touchdown each, the latter of which followed a fumble recovery from linebacker myles stetler. But Warsaw kept battling back on the ground to prevent a big enough dent in its lead, including a 48-yard touchdown from Ethan Rivich with 11:33 remaining in the fourth to go up 49-24.

"They got some stops on us in the second quarter, and unfortunately, we couldn't get enough stops to get on the right side of the scoreboard," Shanley said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, although disappointment was felt on the field in the aftermath of the loss, a lot of optimism remained. Jeff won't sit this one for too long; the mindset is already on next season.

Berdasarkan laporan, there will be new talent added to the fold and players that have to step into bigger roles. But as the Bronchos find a way to do each year, they plan to do it again. There's a lot of work to be done, but that's just part of the process.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "there's so many good kids that are coming back," shanley said. We got to grow, we got to get bigger. "The foundation's laid. Again, it's just going to boil down to the work that we do in the offseason. … I know we got the right people on the bus. ".

#1231. He’s here, he’s there, he’s every-f—ing-where, VJ Edgecombe

📅 13 Nov 2026

He’s here, he’s there, he’s every-f—ing-where, VJ Edgecombe

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/every-f-ing-where-vj-182356459.html

Ted Lasso became an iconic show in short order.

The Jason Sudeikis-led comedy series about an American football coach who becomes a football (soccer) coach became a cultural phenomenon.

Berdasarkan laporan, one of the most popular characters is roy kent, the grizzled old veteran of a. F. Richmond. C. Kent, portrayed by writer and comedian Brett Goldstein, was once a star of the Premier League, but he's on his last legs when we meet him in the show.

Fans of Kent made up a song at his peak, one they serenaded him with as he gets hurt and leaves the pitch for the final time.

He's here, he's there, he's every-fucking-where, Roy Kent, Roy Kent.

Diungkapkan bahwa though he's only in his second year — and is the polar opposite of "grizzled" — vj edgecombe has embodied that song in his young nba career. There was no clearer example of that than his performance in the Sixers' 123-112 win over the Toronto Raptors Thursday night.

With LeBron James out of the lineup, Edgecombe stepped into a bigger role and looked comfortable in it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i'm blessed to have a group of guys around me that's encouraging," edgecombe said postgame. "They help me with confidence. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, edgecombe scored 15 points with multiple dazzling finishes at the rim, a couple serious dunks (and then teasing the possibility of doing the dunk contest postgame) and a three. He continued to crash the glass at a high level for a guard, pulling down eight rebounds. He drove to the rim and made the right reads all night, finding his teammates for eight assists. He also continued to defend at a high level, recording three steals and a block.

All of this and the general winning plays he makes on a nightly basis have become what's expected of him.

Diungkapkan bahwa "i just tell him to go do that vj stuff," tyrese maxey said. He does it all. "Literally, that's exactly what I tell him. He makes winning plays. He defends. Who knows? Next game it may be 20, four and four. I say, 'Hey, man, go do that VJ stuff that you do,' and he literally goes out there and does VJ stuff. He had 15, eight and eight tonight. He just does VJ stuff. He scores. He gets us loose balls. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, so much of the noise this offseason surrounding the super team of james, maxey, joel embiid and jaylen brown the sixers have built was about edgecombe. How would he handle his role changing? Would a drop in usage affect his development? Would the glut of stars hurt Edgecombe's chances to put up numbers and earn his eventual rookie max extension?.

Nights like Thursday show why those queries were silly.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "when i'm on the floor with those four other guys, it's kind of in a way where it's helpful for me," edgecombe said, "because i'm in different positions and i'm in a year two — i'm seeing basketball from different standpoints. Some nights one might be out. Some nights none might be out. Some nights two of them might be out. And to be able to just balance the different lineups and just trying to stay consistent throughout it all.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "i just want to shout out my teammates for that. They just helped me a lot, especially 'Rese and Joel. They always just tell me keep going, keep going. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, anyone who watched edgecombe as a rookie and heard him talk knew he'd excel with this star-studded group. Last season, Edgecombe's usage was unexpectedly high because the Sixers needed it to be. This season, they've needed Edgecombe to flash more of his overall game.

And 13 games in, that's exactly what he's done.

But when guys are out of the lineup, Edgecombe knows his team needs more.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i think this is like the second time he's done this as well when we're down somebody that he just comes out a little bit more lively and assertive," nick nurse said. "And I thought … he made some really decisive moves in the open floor — not necessarily break situations, but the flow is still going, and he's punching through.

Berdasarkan laporan, "and again, i thought he kicked out a few of those, and even on some of the half-court sets, he just attacked aggressively to the paint, and that's where some of those assists were coming from. So, I just thought he did come with an extra pop, and he's done that a couple times now this year. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, when edgecombe was coming out of baylor, there were comparisons to old friend jimmy butler. This writer didn't see it at the time, but now it makes sense.

Sebagaimana diketahui, some players simply impact winning. They affect the game in every facet. They stuff the stat sheet, but their imprint on the game goes far beyond it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, he's here, he's there, he's every-fucking-where. VJ, Edgecombe.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i'm just blessed to be in this position," edgecombe said, "and at the end of the day, i just want to keep getting better. Sometimes you got to be mentally strong. Some opportunities might not be there, but I think I'm getting better mentally, and that's the most important part of the game. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa i've got the chiefs winning this one. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, what impressed me most about the chiefs' 35–12 win over the jets was how they finished. Kansas City has a habit of letting teams it should beat hang around, and the Jets were within two points at halftime. Seattle and Denver showed what happens when defenses can load the box and trust their corners to hold up one-on-one: the run slows down, and play-action loses its bite. Drake London demands attention, and Kyle Pitts can still cause problems for the Chiefs' linebackers and safeties even in a quiet season. off his spot and forcing him past his first read. I like the Chiefs' chances when Atlanta has to win that way.

Berdasarkan laporan, your kansas city chiefs head to atlanta as big favorites against the 2-6 falcons. Yes, they've lost 4 of their last 5, but this is a dangerous opponent. But, as always, this game will come down to how the Chiefs execute. They've got the league's best RB and a streaky young QB– it's an offense that can get out to an early lead and make things uncomfortable. From the pass protection to the receivers and the short-yardage offense, this team has questions, but they're more than capable. Ideally, they start strong with Walker and Johnson– if the run game gets going, the Chiefs are hard to beat.

Diungkapkan bahwa the chiefs enter this game after righting some of their wrongs last week against the jets, although still with major question marks for a team intent on making a super bowl run. I never quite know what to make of the Falcons. The Falcons, meanwhile, are on a two game losing skid after their upset win over the previously unbeaten San Francisco 49ers. But Anunoby blocked Fox's shot, giving the Knicks one final possession to pull off their miraculous and historic comeback victory after being down by as many as 29 points.

The decision to shoot the layup, that's a bang-bang decision. 6-for-16 from the field, not that important. Not a smart play. '.

Berdasarkan laporan, "i think the turnovers were worse than the attempted layup. Yes, it was bad. There were so many things down the stretch. But that's not what cost them the game. I'm not saying it wasn't. … I'll blame those turnovers more than I'll blame the layup. ".

"Two big missed free throws at the end from a great free-throw shooter. Wemby scored 14 more points and was 4-for-17 from the field," Green said. ".

Wembanyama finished with a team-high 24 points and 13 rebounds, but he shot just 36 percent from the field and 25 percent from beyond the arc.

Finally, Green believes Spurs coach Mitch Johnson made some questionable decisions down the stretch.

Berdasarkan laporan, "mitch johnson, 20-4 run before you take a timeout with a young team like that, i can't agree with," green said. Rotations were not great. I think you could have given him some rest and he could've been fresher down the stretch. But he played and he played. He left Wemby in. "Never adjusted in the second half. And if you get him some rest in some of those spots that you could have, maybe down the stretch, he could've done some of those things I was just talking about. Jalen Green’s fit alongside Devin Booker remains a major concern in Phoenix

How much data do you need before you're compelled to make a decision?.

Diungkapkan bahwa in the nba, the answer to that question is as unique as the front offices tasked with making those decisions. There are countless philosophies surrounding what constitutes meaningful data, how much weight to place on sample sizes, and when statistical trends are reliable enough to warrant action. But here we are, 11 games into the new season, and I know I'm not the only person with two functioning eyes beginning to question whether the Jalen Green experiment is going to work in Phoenix.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i'll admit that i initially viewed green's acquisition as more of a necessity than an intentional pursuit. The Suns knew they needed to move Kevin Durant for a multitude of reasons, eventually found a trade partner that was acceptable to him (which is an entirely separate situation worth exploring), and needed to make the salaries work. In my mind, Green was simply part of the financial equation required to facilitate the deal.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, after all, the houston rockets had four seasons of data to evaluate green. Four years of watching his development, assessing his strengths and weaknesses, and determining whether he was someone they wanted to build around moving forward. Their willingness to include him in the trade suggested that perhaps they'd already reached a conclusion about his long-term value.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as sam amick revealed in his latest piece for the athletic, green wasn't merely a contractual necessity or a convenient piece of salary matching. He was someone the Phoenix Suns actively coveted.

Berdasarkan laporan, "(it) was never gonna get done without jalen and dillon (brooks) in the deal," ishbia told me earlier this year. I want Jalen Green as a 23-year-old up-and-coming leading scorer. It wasn't, 'Hey, how do we fill a salary with these numbers?' It was, 'In order to have Kevin Durant on your team, I want Dillon Brooks to help me with my culture and my identity. "Those are the two players we wanted. '".

Berdasarkan laporan, last season was supposed to be the year of evaluation for green, a player who arrived in phoenix with an unbelievably clean bill of health, only to appear in 32 games due to lower extremity injuries. So there's data point number one: 32 games. Of course, there's only so much you can reasonably take away from that sample, considering Green was essentially joining a race that was already three-quarters of the way finished by the time he got involved.

Sebagaimana diketahui, which brings us to this season, the one in which the suns would finally have an opportunity to evaluate what they actually have in jalen green. And the early returns? Less than optimal would probably be the polite way of putting it. Getting benched for the entire fourth quarter against the Charlotte Hornets, a team Green should theoretically thrive against, might be a more accurate description of where things currently stand.

And quite honestly, it was the right decision.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the suns had been cooking, putting together an impressive 38-16 run in the first half and establishing the kind of offensive rhythm that has been painfully difficult to sustain this season. Much of this occurred with Green on the bench. But when Green checked into the game with 6:06 remaining in the second quarter, that momentum came to a screeching halt.

Diungkapkan bahwa charlotte proceeded to unleash a 31-11 run that extended into the third quarter, completely erasing the progress phoenix had made. During Green's stint on the floor, from 6:06 remaining in the second quarter until he was substituted out with 5:26 left in the third, the Suns were outscored by 18 points. And that was the last we saw of Jalen Green.

Berdasarkan laporan, once again, phoenix struggled to generate productive minutes with green on the floor, and i believe that gets to the heart of the problem. It's becoming increasingly difficult to identify how his presence complements the players around him, particularly when the team appears to function more effectively without him. And for a player the organization actively coveted as a centerpiece of the Kevin Durant trade, that's a pretty troubling development.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, no one is questioning jalen green's athleticism. No one is questioning his desire, his attitude, his likability, or his character. By all accounts, he's a stand-up guy who has reached the highest level of professional basketball largely because of his extraordinary physical gifts. His explosiveness, speed, and ability to create separation are undeniable.

Berdasarkan laporan, but when you reach the nba, physical gifts can only take you so far. At some point, the difference between being a good player and becoming a great one comes down to your ability to understand the game, recognize situations, make the right decisions, and contribute within the structure of a functioning offense.

Diungkapkan bahwa when you're the second highest paid player on the roster, earning $36. 3 million this season, the Phoenix Suns need you to be great. They need you on the floor in the fourth quarter, positively influencing the outcome of basketball games. They need you making intelligent decisions, creating opportunities for your teammates, and understanding when to attack and when to allow the offense to develop.

Sebagaimana diketahui, what they don't need is someone disrupting the offensive rhythm, launching ill-timed three-point attempts that have little connection to what the team is trying to accomplish, or throwing the basketball directly into the hands of the opposition. 0%), and 246th in NET +/- (-28. 8 points per game), 92nd in assists (3. Unfortunately, we've seen far too much of the latter. 1 assists), 189th in three-point percentage (27. Green, who ranks 53rd in salary this season, is ranked 113th in scoring (11. 0).

Diungkapkan bahwa the ringer's rob mahoney recently said on the bill simmons podcast that green has gone "from counterproductive to actively bad this season. " I can't say I disagree.

Diungkapkan bahwa perhaps some of these struggles can be attributed to the suns asking green to operate in a role he's never truly occupied before, that of a primary facilitator. It's a reasonable explanation, considering his development in Houston was largely centered around his ability to score rather than orchestrate an offense. But as the games have progressed, I'm beginning to wonder whether that's even what Phoenix is asking him to do anymore.

Diungkapkan bahwa his assist percentage currently sits at 17. Green's presence continues to look awkward within this offense's structure. Therein lies the problem. It feels more like the Suns want him to occasionally facilitate, score when opportunities arise, and somehow make everything fit together. That doesn't exactly suggest a player being tasked with consistently running the offense. 1%, placing him in the 44th percentile this season. His movements feel disconnected from those around him, his decisions frequently interrupt the flow of possessions, and his inability to consistently operate within the team's offensive framework has become increasingly detrimental.

Berdasarkan laporan, that's what makes this entire situation such a quagmire. Green is struggling to operate within the confines of everything happening around him, and much of what we're witnessing mirrors the problems we saw last season. At the time, we could point to his injuries, the late start, and the lack of continuity as reasonable explanations for his struggles. Those were legitimate factors, and they made it difficult to draw any definitive conclusions.

Berdasarkan laporan, but now? we're beginning to see some familiar patterns emerge. And the Suns, as they seem to be in almost every avenue concerning their ability to build for the future, find themselves stuck between a rock and a hard place.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, green's trade value isn't particularly encouraging at the moment. Any opposing team willing to absorb his $36. If Phoenix were to explore moving him, the return would likely be underwhelming. 3 million salary would have to believe there's something worth salvaging, and even with his contract becoming an expiring deal next season, there's a reasonable chance that team would want draft compensation to make the transaction worthwhile.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, what exactly are the suns supposed to offer? they don't have an abundance of desirable draft assets sitting around, waiting to be attached to another expensive contract in hopes of making a problem disappear. They used those up to get off of the Nurkic deal or to acquire Mark Williams and Miles Bridges. We've already watched this organization sacrifice enough of its future trying to correct mistakes from its past.

Berdasarkan laporan, so what do you do? one possibility is moving green to the bench, and quite honestly, that might be the most sensible solution available. We've seen a version of this experiment before. In January 2025, Mike Budenholzer finally came to the realization that pairing Devin Booker with another ball dominant shooting guard in Bradley Beal was creating more problems than it was solving. The overlapping skill sets were limiting the team's offensive ceiling, and something needed to change.

Diungkapkan bahwa we all remember how that went. Beal wasn't particularly receptive to the adjustment, and the situation became another chapter in the ongoing dysfunction surrounding that roster.

Diungkapkan bahwa green, to his credit, appears to have a different attitude toward making adjustments. Everything suggests he wants to fit in, wants to improve, and wants to become the player Phoenix envisioned when it acquired him. He's expressed a willingness to evolve his game, embrace more facilitating responsibilities, and has spent time working with Steve Nash to improve that aspect of his skill set. I don't question any of that. But wanting something to work doesn't necessarily mean it's going to work.

Berdasarkan laporan, when you're playing alongside devin booker, the fit becomes especially problematic. The players surrounding him should be enhancing those abilities, creating space for him to operate, and making his job easier. Those are his superpowers. Booker possesses an extraordinary ability to control an offense, manipulate defenses, and create scoring opportunities for himself and others. They shouldn't be obstacles he has to navigate.

Diungkapkan bahwa perhaps the answer is allowing green to find his footing with the second unit, where he can operate with greater freedom, develop some confidence, and establish a rhythm without constantly having to figure out how his game intersects with booker's. If he begins finding success in that role, maybe the comfort and confidence he develops can eventually carry over into shared minutes with the starters.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, of course, that raises another question. Goodwin might not be the traditional facilitator you're looking for, but he brings something this team desperately needs: a player who can positively influence the game on both ends of the floor without requiring the offense to revolve around him. But at this point, you could certainly sell me on Jordan Goodwin as well. Who starts in his place? Collin Gillespie would seem to be the most obvious candidate, given his familiarity with the offense, his ability to play alongside Booker, and the success Phoenix has experienced with him on the floor. That's a conversation worth exploring another day.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ultimately, as i sat there watching the fourth quarter against charlotte, knowing how ineffective green had been throughout his minutes, i found myself relieved that he wasn't on the floor. And I don't particularly enjoy admitting that. Here was a player the Suns actively pursued as part of the Kevin Durant trade, someone they envisioned becoming a significant part of their future, and I was genuinely pleased that he was sitting on the bench during the most important stretch of the game.

Diungkapkan bahwa instead, phoenix leaned on a group that looked much more familiar. Much of the lineup resembled the units that helped the Suns win so many games last season, with Luke Kennard occupying the role previously filled by Grayson Allen for much of the stretch. And what happened? The Suns played well. The offense flowed. Players understood their responsibilities, the ball moved with purpose, and Phoenix outscored Charlotte 29-20 in a fourth quarter that was void of his presence.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there was a familiarity to it, a sense that the players on the floor understood how to complement one another rather than compete for the same opportunities. They need him to succeed. The Suns have invested significant money, opportunity, and organizational belief in Jalen Green. And that's what makes this entire situation so frustrating. They want him to succeed. But right now, some of their most effective basketball is being played when he's watching from the sideline.

Berdasarkan laporan, eleven games into the season might not be enough data to make a definitive judgment about his future. But it's certainly enough to start asking some uncomfortable questions.
